source: "We now have 4-month-old mice that are non-diabetic that used to be diabetic," he added.

hypothesis: "Kamoe jinoe na tikus umu 4 buleun nyang hana diabetes nyang awai jih diabetes", tambahnya.

source: Dr. Ehud Ur, professor of medicine at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia and chair of the clinical and scientific division of the Canadian Diabetes Association cautioned that the research is still in its early days.

source: Like some other experts, he is skeptical about whether diabetes can be cured, noting that these findings have no relevance to people who already have Type 1 diabetes.

source: On Monday, Sara Danius, permanent secretary of the Nobel Committee for Literature at the Swedish Academy, publicly announced during a radio program on Sveriges Radio in Sweden the committee, unable to reach Bob Dylan directly about winning the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, had abandoned its efforts to reach him.
reference: Bak uroe Senin, Sara Danius, sekretaris teutap Komite Nobel Sastra bak Akademi Swedia, geuumumkan ngôn bak mandum ureuëng lam masa program radio di Radio Sveriges di Swedia komite nyan, han jeuet meusambông deungôn Bob Dylan ngôn lansông teuntang keumenangan Hadiah Nobel 2016 lam Sastra, ka geupeutinggai usaha keu meusambông deungôn gobnyan.
hypothesis: Bak uroe Senin, Sara Danius, sekretaris permanen Komite Nobel untuk Sastra di Swedish Academy, secara terbuka geupeugah seulama program radio di Sveriges Radio di Swedia bahwa komite nyan, hana jeut meurumpok langsung ngon Bob Dylan teuntang meunang Nobel 2016 dalam Sastra, ka geutinggai upaya jih untuk meurumpok ngon jih.

source: Danius said, "Right now we are doing nothing. I have called and sent emails to his closest collaborator and received very friendly replies. For now, that is certainly enough."
reference: Danius kheun, "Jinoe kamöe hana meubuet sapeue. Lôn ka lôn talipun ngön lôn kirém email keu kolaborator gobnyan nyan paléng rab ngôn lôn teurimöng balah nyang paléng ruméh. Jinoe, nyan ka sep.
hypothesis: Danius geupeugah, "Jinoe kamoe hana kamoe peubuet sapeue. Ulôn ka lon hubungi dan lon kirem email bak rekan nyang paleng rab ngon jih dan lon teurimong jawaban nyang that ramah. untuk saat nyoe, nyan pasti cukup".

source: Previously, Ring's CEO, Jamie Siminoff, remarked the company started when his doorbell wasn't audible from his shop in his garage.

source: While one experimental vaccine appears able to reduce Ebola mortality, up until now, no drugs have been clearly demonstrated suitable for treating existing infection.

source: One antibody cocktail, ZMapp, initially showed promise in the field, but formal studies indicated it had less benefit than sought in preventing death.

source: In the PALM trial, ZMapp served as a control, meaning scientists used it as a baseline and compared the three other treatments to it.

source: USA Gymnastics supports the United States Olympic Committee's letter and accepts the absolute need of the Olympic family to promote a safe environment for all of our athletes.

source: We agree with the USOC's statement that the interests of our athletes and clubs, and their sport, may be better served by moving forward with meaningful change within our organization, rather than decertification.

source: This not only confirms that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory already widespread, but provides details fossils generally cannot, such as color and three-dimensional arrangement.

source: . Scientists say this animal's plumage was chestnut-brown on top with a pale or carotenoid-colored underside.

hypothesis: Kareuna bulu dinosaurus hana na aci nyang berkembang, nyang geuboh nan rachis, teutapi na fitur laen nibak bulu  barb dan barbules  peneliti menyimpulkan bahwa rachis mungken adalah perkembangan evolusioner lheh nyan fitur laen nyoe.

source: The feathers' structure suggests that they were not used in flight but rather for temperature regulation or display. The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
reference: Struktur bulèe geupeutunyok bahwa bulèe hana geungui watèe teureubang teutapih keu ato hawa atawa piasan. Awak peneliti geupeugah bahwa, bahpih nyoe nakeuh iku dinosaurus muda, sampel geupeutunyok bulèe dewasa ngôn kon aneuek manoek.
hypothesis: Struktur bulu nyan dipeudeuh bahwa bulu nyan hana dipakek lam peuleungkapan, teutapi keu peuleungkapan atawa peuleumah suhu.

source: The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.

source: The Report opens with plea for open debate and the formation of a consensus in the United States about the policy towards the Middle East.
reference: Laporan geubuka ngôn peurmohonan keu dawa teubuka ngôn peumbeuntukan konsensus i Amerika Seurikat teuntang keubijakan keu Timu Teungöh.
hypothesis: Laporan nyan dimulai deungen peungajaran keu diskusi nyang terbuka dan peumbentuk konsensus di Amerika Serikat teuntang kebijakan teuntang Timur Teunggara.

source: The Report is highly critical of almost every aspect of the present policy of the Executive towards Iraq and it urges an immediate change of direction.
reference: Laporan nyoe kritis that nibak karap tiep aspek keubijakan Eksekutif jinoe keu Irak ngôn meukarat peurubahan arah lam sigra.
hypothesis: Laporan nyan sangat kritis terhadap hampir mandum aspek dari kebijakan saat ini dari eksekutif terhadap Irak dan jih mendesak perubahan arah segera.

source: First among its 78 recommendations is that a new diplomatic initiative should be taken before the end of this year to secure Iraq’s borders against hostile interventions and to re-establish diplomatic relations with its neighbors.
reference: Phôn antara 78 rekomendasi nyan keuh bahwa inisiatif diplomatik baro suwah geucok sigohlom akhée thôn nyoe keu geupeuaman peurbatasan Irak nibak intervensi peurmusuhan ngôn geupeudoeng lom sinambong diplomatic ngôn ureuëng lingkajih.
hypothesis: Nyang phon di antara 78 rekomendasi jih adalah bahwa inisiatif diplomatik baro harus dipeuget sigohlom akhe thon nyoe untuk meupeukong perbatasan Irak terhadap intervensi nyang hana galak dan untuk dipeudeng hubungan diplomatik ngen teutangga jih.

source: Current senator and Argentine First Lady Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner announced her presidential candidacy yesterday evening in La Plata, a city 50 kilometers (31 miles) away from Buenos Aires.
reference: Seunator jinoe ngôn Ibuk Nanggroe Argentina Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner geupeugoet maklumat peugoet dröe kandidat sebagoe presiden malam baroe i La Plata, kuta nyang jioh 50 kilometè (31 mil) nibak Buenos Aires.
hypothesis: Senator dan Ibu Negara Argentina Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner geupeumaklum keusaboh jih keu presiden malam baroe di La Plata, saboh banda 50 kilometer (31 mil) dari Buenos Aires.

source: Mrs. Kirchner announced her intention to run for president at the Argentine Theatre, the same location she used to start her 2005 campaign for the Senate as member of the Buenos Aires province delegation.
reference: Nyonya Kirchner geupeugoet maklumat niet jih geupeugoet dröe kandidat sebagoe presiden i Teater Argentina, lokasi nyang sama ngôn nyang geungui keu geupeuphôn kampanye 2005 keu Seunat sebagoe anggeeta delegasi provinsi Buenos Aires.
hypothesis: Bu Kirchner geupeumaklum niat jih keu meudaftar keu presiden di Teater Argentina, lokasi yang sama jih yang geu gunakan untuk memulai kampanye 2005 keu Senat seubagai anggota delegasi propinsi Buenos Aires.

source: The debate was sparked by controversy over spending on relief and reconstruction in the wake Hurricane Katrina; which some fiscal conservatives have humorously labeled "Bush's New Orleans Deal."
reference: Dawa geupicu le kontroversi ateuh peng tubiet keu bantuan ngön rekonstruksi oh lheuh Bade Katrina; nyang ladom konservatif fiskal geubri cap ngön lawak "Keusepakatan New Orleans Bush."
hypothesis: Debat nyan dipeuteubiet le kontroversi teuntang pengeluaran keu bantuan dan rekonstruksi seujak Badai Katrina; nyang le konservatif fiskal deungon lucu jih teulatip "New Orleans Deal Bush".

source: Liberal criticism of the reconstruction effort has focused on the awarding of reconstruction contracts to perceived Washington insiders.
reference: Kritik liberal keu upaya rekonstruksi ka meufokus bak geubi kontrak rekonstruksi keu ureuëng i Washington nyang geuanggap.
hypothesis: Kritik liberal terhadap upaya rekonstruksi tefokus bak pemberian kontrak rekonstruksi keu ureung dalam yang dianggap Washington.

source: Over four million people went to Rome to attend the funeral.
reference: Leubeh nibak peuët juta ureuëng geujak u Roma keu teuka lam bhôm.
hypothesis: Leubeh peuet juta ureueng geujak u Roma keu geujak peurayeuk lam upacara peunjara.

source: The number of people present was so large that it was not possible for everybody to gain access to the funeral in St. Peter's Square.
reference: Ramee that ureuëng nyang teuka sampöe hana mungkèn keu tiëp ureuëng meuteumèe akses u bhôm i Lapangan Santo Petrus.
hypothesis: Jeumeulah ureueng nyang na disinan that that le sampoe hana mungken mandum ureuëng jijak bak upacara peunjara di leuen St. Peter.

source: Several large television screens were installed in various places in Rome to let the people watch the ceremony.
reference: Ladôm layeue tivi rayôek geupasang dum pat i Roma mangat ureuëng-ureuëng kalön upacara nyan.
hypothesis: Na padum boh layar televisi rayeuk nyang geupeuduek di meubagoe teumpat di Roma mangat rakyat jeuet jikalon upacara nyan.

source: In many other cities of Italy and in the rest of the world, particularly in Poland, similar setups were made, which were viewed by a great number of people.
reference: Dumna jai kuta laèn i Itali ngôn ban sigom dônya, khasjih i Polandia, atôran nyang saban geupeugöt, nyang geungieng le ramee ureuëng.
hypothesis: Di le banda laen di Italia dan di ban saboh donya, terutama di Polandia, peuget-peuget nyang saban, nyang ditonton le that le ureung.

source: Historians have criticized past FBI policies for focusing resources on cases which are easy to solve, especially stolen car cases, with the intent of boosting the agency's success rate.
reference: Seujarawan ka geutham keubijakan FBI nyang awai keu geupeuteuntè sumberdaya bak peukara-peukara nyang mangat lheueh, keu phön that peukara moto cue, ngôn heut keu meupeurayeuk tingkat meuhasè a’gèn nyan.
hypothesis: Seujarah ka mengkritik kebijakan FBI masa lalu untuk fokus sumber daya bak kasus yang mudah dipecahkan, terutama kasus mobil curian, deungen tujuan untuk meningkatkan tingkat keberhasilan agensi.

source: Congress began funding the obscenity initiative in fiscal 2005 and specified that the FBI must devote 10 agents to adult pornography.
reference: Kongres geupeuphôn geubi peunayah inisiatif keucabulan bak thôn fiskal 2005 ngôn meupeuteutap bahwasajih FBI suwah geupeujôk 10 a’gèn keu pornografi ureuëng ka rayek.
hypothesis: Kongres mulai mendanai inisiatif obsesi bak fiskal 2005 dan geu tentukan bahwa FBI harus mendedikasikan 10 agen untuk pornografi dewasa.

source: Robin Uthappa made the innings highest score, 70 runs in just 41 balls by hitting 11 fours and 2 sixes.
reference: Robin Uthappa peugöt nilai tingkat palèng manyang, 70 plueng sit lam 41 bohla ngôn geupéh 11 ​​peuët ngôn 2 nam.
hypothesis: Robin Uthappa geu peuget skor paleng manyang dalam innings, 70 gol lam 41 bola deungon geupeutamong 11 gol keu peut dan 2 gol keu nam.

source: Middle order batsmen, Sachin Tendulkar and Rahul Dravid, performed well and made a hundred-run partnership.
reference: Middle order batsmen, Sachin Tendulkar ngôn Rahul Dravid, deuh göt ngôn geupeugöt sinambông sireutôh -plueng.
hypothesis: Balang-balan orde teungoh, Sachin Tendulkar dan Rahul Dravid, peuget buet nyang get dan peuget kemitraan 100 gol.

source: But, after losing the captain's wicket India only made 36 runs loosing 7 wickets to end the innings.
reference: Teutapih, 'oh lheuh gadöh gawang kapten India geupeugöt 36 plueng sagai gadöh 7 gawang keu peuseuneulheuh babak.
hypothesis: Teuma, lheuh ka geutinggai wicket kapten, India hanya meuhase 36 gol, ka geutinggai 7 wicket, sampoe tamat innings.

source: U.S. President George W. Bush arrived in Singapore the morning of November 16, beginning a week-long tour of Asia.
reference: Présidén AS George W. Bush teuka i Singapura beungöh tanggai 16 November, nyang peuphôn tur na meusigöe aleuhad i Asia.
hypothesis: Presiden Amerika George W. Bush trok u Singapura bak beungoh 16 November, geu mulai saboh kunjungan seminggu di Asia.

source: He was greeted by Singapore's Deputy Prime Minister Wong Kan Seng and discussed trade and terrorism issues with the Singapore Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong.
reference: Jih geusambôt lè Wakie Peurdana Meuntröe Singapura Wong Kan Seng ngôn geupeugah peurdagangan ngôn terorisme deungôn Peurdana Meuntröe Singapura Lee Hsien Loong.
hypothesis: Jih geu sambot le Wakil Perdana Menteri Singapura Wong Kan Seng dan geu bahas masalah perdagangan ngon terorisme deungon Perdana Menteri Singapura Lee Hsien Loong.

source: After a week of losses in the midterm election, Bush told an audience about the expansion of trade in Asia.
reference: Oh lheuh sialeuhad talôe lam peumilèh siteungöh watèe, Bush geukheun keu ureuëng nyang kalön hai peuluwah peurdagangan i Asia.
hypothesis: Lheuh seujumlah keulawan dalam pilkada, Bush geupeugah bak hadirin tentang ekspansi perdagangan di Asia.

source: Prime Minister Stephen Harper has agreed to send the government's 'Clean Air Act' to an all-party committee for review, before its second reading, after Tuesday's 25 minute meeting with NDP leader Jack Layton at the PMO.
reference: Peurdana Meuntröe Stephen Harper ka sapue kheun keu geukirèm 'Clean Air Act' pömeuréntah u komite bandum pihak keu geukalön lom, sigöhlöm geubaca keuduwa jih, ‘oh lheuh meurumpok 25 minét uröe Seulasa ngôn syheh NDP Jack Layton di PMO.
hypothesis: Perdana Menteri Stephen Harper ka geutem peutrok 'Aks Udara Bersih' keu komite mandum partai keu geu pareksa, seugolom baca nyang keudua, lheuh 25 menit meurumpok deungon pemimpin NDP Jack Layton bak PMO.

source: Layton had asked for changes to the conservatives' environmental bill during the meeting with the PM, asking for a "thorough and complete rewriting" of the Conservative party's environmental bill.
reference: Layton ka geulakée peurubahan bak qanun mukim konservatif watée meuteumée ngôn PM, "geulakée tulèh lömnyan mandum ngôn sampôrna" nibak qanunmukim Peurti Konservatif.
hypothesis: Layton ka geuminta peubah-peubah bak undang-undang lingkungan konservatif seulama pertemuan deungen PM, geuminta "penulisan ulang teuliti dan lengkap" dari undang-undang lingkungan konservatif.

source: Ever since the Federal Government stepped in to take over funding of the Mersey hospital in Devonport, Tasmania, the state government and some federal MPs have criticised this act as a stunt in the prelude to the federal election to be called by November.
reference: Mulapôn Pömeuréntah Federal teulibat keu cok lom peundanaan rumöh sakèt Mersey i Devonport, Tasmania, pömeuréntah nanggröe bahgian ngôn ladôm anggèeta parleumén federal ka geupeuteugah buet nyöe sebagöe geulagat awai nibak peumilèh federal nyang geu neuk peugöt bak buleuën November.
hypothesis: Seumeunjak Pemerintah Federal geutamong keu geu peutron pendanaan keu rumah sakit Mersey di Devonport, Tasmania, pemerintah negara bagian dan padum-padum droe anggota parlemen federal ka geu kritik tindakan nyoe seubagoe preludi keu pemilu federal nyang akan geupeuna bak November.

source: But Prime Minister John Howard has said the act was only to safeguard the facilities of the hospital from being downgraded by the Tasmanian government, in giving an extra AUD$45 million.
reference: Teutapi Peurdana Meuntröe John Howard ka kheun buet nyan sit keu kaloen beu gét teumpat rumöh sakèt mangat hana geutrôn peuringkat lè pömeuréntah Tasmania, ngôn geubri tamah AUD$45 juta.
hypothesis: Teuma Perdana Menteri John Howard ka geupeugah bahwa tindakan nyan hanya untuk meujaga fasilitas rumah sakit dari ji peugadoh le pemerintah Tasmania, deungon jibri tambahan AUD $ 45 juta.

source: According to the latest bulletin, sea level readings indicated a tsunami was generated. There was some definite tsunami activity recorded near Pago Pago and Niue.
reference: Meunuröt bulletin palèng barô, prakiraan laot meupeutunyôk tsunami kameuhasè. Na ladôm buet si uröe-uröe tsunami teuntèe nyang meutulèh rap Pago-Pago ngôn Niue.
hypothesis: Meunurot laporan terbaru, peuleumah tingkat laot geu peuleumah tsunami.

source: No major damage or injuries have been reported in Tonga, but power was temporarily lost, which reportedly prevented Tongan authorities from receiving the tsunami warning issued by the PTWC.
reference: Hana keurusakan rayek atawa ceudeura nyang geubri thèei i Tonga, teutapi listrèk len siat, nyang geubrithéei geupeu siblah pihak nyang mat kuwasaTonga teurimöng peuringatan tsunami nyang jipeutubiet le PTWC.
hypothesis: Hana na kerusakan atau luka-luka nyang rayek nyang teulat di Tonga, teutapi daya listrik nyan ka hana le, nyang ka dipeugah hana jeut pihak peumeurintah Tonga geuteurimong peringatan tsunami nyang geupeutubit le PTWC.

source: Fourteen schools in Hawaii located on or near coastlines were closed all of Wednesday despite the warnings being lifted.
reference: Peuët blah sikula i Hawaii nyang na nibak atawa rap garèh pantè geutôp mandum uröe Rabu bahpih peuingat ka geucabôt.
hypothesis: Peuet blah sekolah di Hawaii nyang na di atawa tô deungon panté teunggara teutap teutap teukeudi bah pih peungajaran ka ji peuhapus.

source: U.S. President George W. Bush welcomed the announcement.
reference: Présidén AS George W. Bush geusambôt maklumat nyan.
hypothesis: Presiden Amerika George W. Bush geu sambot deungon galak that peusan nyan.

source: Bush spokesman Gordon Johndroe called North Korea's pledge "a major step towards the goal of achieving the verifiable denuclearization of the Korean peninsula."
reference: Juru peugah haba Bush, Gordon Johndröe, kheun janji Korea Utara seubagöe "langkah rayek u tujuan geupeusampöe denuklirisasi nyang jeut iverifikasi i seumeunanjung Korea."
hypothesis: Juru bicara Bush Gordon Johndroe geuboh janji Korea Utara "saboh langkah rayek keu tujuan peuhase pendenuklearisasi semenanjung Korea".

source: The tenth named storm of the Atlantic Hurricane season, Subtropical Storm Jerry, formed in the Atlantic Ocean today.
reference: Badé keu siploh nibak musèm badé Atlantik, badé Subtropis Jerry, teuka nibak Samudra Atlantik uröe nyôe.
hypothesis: Badai keu siploh nyang ka na nan jih bak musem Badai Atlantik, Badai Subtropis Jerry, ka meu-ubah di La'ot Atlantik uroenyoe.

source: The National Hurricane Center (NHC) says that at this point Jerry poses no threat to land.
reference: National Hurricane Center (NHC) kheun bahwa jinöe Jerry hana meubahya u darat.
hypothesis: Pusat Badai Nasional (NHC) peugah bak saat nyoe Jerry hana ancaman keu darat.

source: The U.S. Corps of Engineers estimated that 6 inches of rainfall could breach the previously damaged levees.
reference: Korps Insinyur AS geupeukira bahwa curah ujeuën 6 inci jeut teumbôh ateuëng nyang sigöhlöm nyan reulöh.
hypothesis: Korps Insinyur Amerika geu kira bahwa 6 inci ujeun jeut ji peubeukah bendungan nyang ka rusak.

source: The Ninth Ward, which saw flooding as high as 20 feet during Hurricane Katrina, is currently in waist-high water as the nearby levee was overtopped.
reference: Bangsal keu Sikureuëng, nyang keunöng ie raya deungôn manyang 20 gaki lawèt badé Katrina, jinöe teudöng ie deungôn manyang bak keuieng sabab ateuëng nyang rab nyan meuruwah.
hypothesis: Keulapan Ward, nyang na banjir setinggi 20 kaki seulama Badai Katrina, saat nyo na dalam ie manyang pinggang kareuna bendungan di sekitar jih ka tergenang.

source: Water is spilling over the levee in a section 100 feet wide.
reference: Ie röe i ateuëh ateuëng nibak bahgian deungôn bideuëng 100 gaki.
hypothesis: Ié teungoh ji ile ateueh bendungan nyan lam saboh bagian nyang luwah jih 30 metée.

source: Commons Administrator Adam Cuerden expressed his frustration over the deletions when he spoke to Wikinews last month.
reference: Administrator Commons Adam Cuerden geupeudeuh rasa frustrasijih ateuh jili nyan watée jih peugah haba ngôn Wikinews buleun ka leupah.
hypothesis: Administrator Commons Adam Cuerden geupeugah keucewa jih keu penghapusan nyan watee gobnyan geumeudari bak Wikinews buleuen nyang ka u likot.

source: "He [Wales] basically lied to us from the start. First, by acting as if this was for legal reasons. Second, by pretending he was listening to us, right up to his art deletion."
reference: "Jih [Wales] nibak asaijih jimeusulèt keu tanyôe ka nibak phôn. Nyang phôn, ngôn geupuebuet sang-sang nyôe nakeuh keu daleh hukôm. Keduwa, ngôn meupura-pura jih deungö awak tanyôe, sampöe jili seunijih."
hypothesis: "Jihnyan [Wales] seucara prinsip jih meusulet bak kamoe dari awai. phon, deungon meubuet lagee nyoe adalah untuk alasan hukum. keudua, deungon berpura-pura jih deungo kamoe, sampoe jih peugadoh seni jih".

source: The community irritation led to current efforts to draft a policy regarding sexual content for the site which hosts millions of openly-licensed media.
reference: Keulompok nyang palak nyan meuubah meuheut keu geurancang keubijakan meusangkôt kontenseksual keu situs nyang tampông meujuta media deungôn lisensi teuhah.
hypothesis: Iritasi masyarakat nyan meupeulaku upaya saat nyo keu geu peuget kebijakan teuntang konten seksual untuk situs nyan nyang geu tuan rumah jutaan media nyang na izin terbuka.

source: The work done was mostly theoretical, but the program was written to simulate observations made of the Sagittarius galaxy.
reference: Keurija nyang geupubuet ladôm seucara teoretis, teutapi program nyôe geutulèh keu simulasi peungamatan nyang geupeugöt nibak galaksi Sagitarius.
hypothesis: Karya yang dipeuget sebagian rayek jih teoritis, teutapi program nyan dituleh untuk meusimulasikan pengamatan yeng dipeuget dari galaksi Sagitarius.

source: The effect the team was looking for would be caused by tidal forces between the galaxy's dark matter and the Milky Way's dark matter.
reference: Efek nyang geumita keulompok nyan mungkén geupeuwap lè geulagat ék trôen nibak materi galaksi seupôt ngôn mateuri Bima Sakti seupôt.
hypothesis: Efek yang dikeu tim akan disebabkan oleh kekuatan pasang antara materi gelap galaksi ngen materi gelap Bima Sakti.

source: Just like the moon exerts a pull on the earth, causing tides, so does the Milky Way exert a force on the Sagittarius galaxy.
reference: Saban lagèe buleuen nyang na gaya tarék keu bumoe, nyang geuakibat na geulumbang, meunan cit Bima Sakti bri gaya teunarék nibak galaksi Sagitarius.
hypothesis: Lagèë buleun na daya tarik nyang that rayek keu bumoe, meunan cit Bima Sakti na daya tarik nyang that rayek keu galaksi Sagitarius.

source: The scientists were able to conclude that the dark matter affect other dark matter in the same way regular matter does.
reference: Awak meu’ileumée jeuet geupeukieh bahwa mateuri seupôt geupeuleumah mateuri seupôt laènjih deungôn cara nyang sama lagée mateuri biyasa.
hypothesis: Para ilmuwan jeut menyimpulkan bahwa materi gelap meupeungaroh materi gelap laen lagee materi biasa.

source: This theory says that most dark matter around a galaxy is located around a galaxy in a kind of halo, and is made of lots of small particles.
reference: Tiori nyôe kheun bahwa ladôm mateuri seupôt i lingka galaksi na i lingka galaksi lam bagöe lingkaran cahya, ngôn meupeugöt nibak le partikel ubit.
hypothesis: Teori nyo dikheun bahwa sebagian rayek materi seupôt di seukitar galaksi na di seukitar galaksi dalam saboh jenis halo, dan terdiri dari le partikel ubit.

source: Television reports show white smoke coming from the plant.
reference: Laporan tivi meupeutunyok asap putèh nyang jitubiet nibak pabrèk.
hypothesis: Laporan TV dipeudeh asap puteh nyang jiteubiet dari peuneudong nyan.

source: Local authorities are warning residents in the vicinity of the plant to stay indoors, turn off air-conditioners and not to drink tap water.
reference: Pömeuréntah i sinan geupeuingat ureue di lingka pabrèk keu tinggai lam rumöh, peumate AC ngôn bek jeb ie kran.
hypothesis: Peumimpén lokal geu peuingat penduduk di sekitar peuneudong nyan mangat teutap di dalam rumoh, peugadoh peunyaket udara dan hana jijieb ie kran.

source: According to Japan's nuclear agency, radioactive caesium and iodine has been identified at the plant.
reference: Meunurôt badan nuklir Jeupang, cesium ngôn yodium radioaktif ka geuidentifikasi i pabrèknyan.
hypothesis: Meunurot agensi nuklir Jepang, cesium dan iod radioaktif ka jiidentifikasi bak peuneudong nyan.

source: Authorities speculate that this indicates that containers holding uranium fuel at the site may have ruptured and are leaking.
reference: Nyang mat kuwasa meuspekulasi bahwa nyôe meupeutunyok bahwa kontainer nyang keubah bahan bakar uranium i teumpat mungkèn ka beukah ngôn tirèh.
hypothesis: Peukuasa geu spekulasi bahwa nyoe geu tanda bahwa wadah nyang na bahan bakar uranium di situs nyan mungken ka patah dan meucre.

source: Dr. Tony Moll discovered the Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) in the South African region KwaZulu-Natal.
reference: Dr. Tony Moll geuteumée Ubat Nyang Keubai That Keu Tuberkulosis (XDR-TB) di wilayah Afrika Seulatan KwaZulu-Natal.
hypothesis: Dr. Tony Moll geu teume Tuberkulosis yang sangat resisten (XDR-TB) di wilayah Afrika Selatan KwaZulu-Natal.

source: In an interview, he said the new variant was "very highly troubling and alarming because of the very high fatality rate."
reference: Lam saboh wawancara, göbnyan jikheun varian barô "peususah that ngôn peugöt ye sabab tingkat matèe nyang rayek that."
hypothesis: Lam saboh wawancara, jih peugah bahwa varian baroe nyan "sangat meukeususah dan meukeusud kareuna tingkat kematian nyang that le".

source: Some patients might have contracted the bug in the hospital, Dr. Moll thinks, and at least two were hospital health workers.
reference: Ladôm ureuëng sakèt mungkèn meujangkèt peunyakèt nyan i rumöh sakèt, pikée Dr. Moll, ngôn nakeuh duwa peutugah keuséhatan rumöh sakèt.
hypothesis: Padum droe pasien mungken na terinfeksi bak rumoh sakét, menurut Dr. Moll, dan seutidak jih dua droe awak nyan awak kesehatan.

source: In one year's time, an infected person may infect 10 to 15 close contacts.
reference: Lam watée sithôn, ureuëng nyang teuinfeksi jeut geupeuinfeksi 10 sampöe 15 ureuëng nyang rab.
hypothesis: Lam sibuleun, sidroe ureuëng nyang ka keunong virus nyan, mungken ka jipeuteuka 10 sampoe 15 droe nyang ka kontak.

source: However, the percentage of XDR-TB in the entire group of people with tuberculosis still seems to be low; 6,000 of the total 330,000 people infected at any particular moment in South Africa.
reference: Teutapi, peurséntase XDR-TB bak bandum kawom nyang keunöng tuberkulosis deuhjih mantöng ubeut; 6.000 nibak mandum 330.000 ureuëng teuinfeksi bak meujan-jan watée i Afrika Seulatan.
hypothesis: Namun, persentase XDR-TB dalam mandum kelompok ureung yang na tuberkulosis manteng lagei that miyueb; 6.000 dari total 330.000 ureung yang terinfeksi bak saboh watee tertentu di Afrika Selatan.

source: The satellites, both of which weighed in excess of 1,000 pounds, and traveling at approximately 17,500 miles per hour, collided 491 miles above the Earth.
reference: Satelit, nyang ban dua na brat leubeh dari 1.000 pon, ngon meugrak lam kecepatan silingka 17.500 mil per jeum, teupok 491 mil di ateueh Bumoe.
hypothesis: Satelit nyan, yang bobot jih leubeh dari 1.000 pon, dan meulangkah seukitar 17.500 mil per jam, meuganto 491 mil di ateuh bumoe.

source: Scientists say the explosion caused by the collision was massive.
reference: Ureueng meueleumee geukheun beureutoh nyan nyang teujadi sabab meupok nyan nakeuh beureutoh nyang raya that.
hypothesis: Para ilmuwan peugah bahwa ledakan nyang geupeusabab le tabrakan nyan rayeuk that.

source: They are still trying to determine just how large the crash was and how the Earth will be affected.
reference: Awak nyan mantong geucuba geupeuteuntee ubena rayek meupok nyan ngon kiban Bumoe akan teupeungaba.
hypothesis: Awak nyan manteng ji coba peuteunteung padum jih kecelakaan nyan dan pakriban bumoe akan keunong.

source: The United States Strategic Command of the U.S. Department of Defense office is tracking the debris.
reference: Komando Strategis Amerika Serikat dari kanto Departemen Pertahanan AS teungoh geumita puing-puing nyan.
hypothesis: Panglima Strategis Amerika Serikat dari Kantor Departemen Pertahanan Amerika Serikat teungoh ji seulidek puing-puing nyan.

source: The result of plotting analysis will be posted to a public website.
reference: Hase analisis plot akan geuposting bak situs publik.
hypothesis: Hasil analisis plot akan diposting bak website publik.

source: A doctor who worked at Children's Hospital of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania will be charged with aggravated murder after her mother was found dead in the trunk of her car Wednesday, authorities in Ohio say.

reference: "Peukateun termal nyan hana pah lagèe guha-guha rayéuk i Bumôe nyang kayém geupeutheun cuwaca nyang sép konstan, teutapih konsisten deungôn nyôe jeut lam ruhung bak tanôh," geukhuen lé Glen Cushing nibak Tim Astrogeologi United States Geological Survey (USGS) ngônUniversitas Northern Arizona di Flagstaff, Arizona.
hypothesis: Perilaku termal awak nyan hana seubalék guha rayek di Bumo nyang seureng dipeutahan suhu yang relatif konstan, teutapi nyan konsisten deungen nyoe jeut keu lubang dalam tanoh, " kheun Glen Cushing dari United States Geological Survey (USGS) Astrogeology Team dan dari Northern Arizona University yang na di Flagstaff, Arizona.

source: In France, voting has traditionally been a low-tech experience: voters isolate themselves in a booth, put a pre-printed sheet of paper indicating their candidate of choice into an envelope.
reference: Di Peurancih, peumungutan su seucara tradisional nakeuh peungalaman deungôn tehnologi miyup: peumiléh geupeusiblah lam bilék, geupeutamông si'ôn keureutaih nyang ka geucita nyang meupeutunyôk kandidat peumiléhan awaknyan lam baluëm.
hypothesis: Di Prancis, pemungutan suara seucara tradisional adalah pengalaman teknologi rendah: peuniléh geuisolasi droe lam saboh booth, geu peutamong seutimbak kertas nyang ka lheueh dicetak nyang geutunyok calon nyang geupileh lam saboh amplop.

source: After officials verify the voter's identity, the voter drops the envelope into the ballot box and signs the voting roll.
reference: ‘Oh lheuh peutugas geutilék löm identitas peumiléh, peumiléh geupeutamöng amplop u lam plôk su ngon geutèkèn jadôi peumiléh.
hypothesis: Lheuh peugawée peumeurèntah geu peuyakén identitas peumeurèntah nyan, peumeurèntah nyan geupeutron surat lam kotak undi dan geu peutanda tanda peumeurèntah nyan.

source: French electoral law rather strictly codifies the proceedings.
reference: anun peumilu Peurancih geupeuatôe proses seucara keutat.
hypothesis: Hukom pilkada Prancis leubeh ketat dikodifikasi prosedur.

source: Since 1988, ballot boxes must be transparent so that voters and observers can witness that no envelopes are present at the start of the vote and that no envelopes are added except those of the duly counted and authorized voters.
reference: Phôn thôn 1988, kutak su suwah transparan beujeuet peumiléh ngön peungamat geukalöen bahwa hana amplop bak awai peumungutan su ngön hana amplop nyang geutamah keucuwali ata peumiléh nyang ka geubileung ngön geubri kuwasa.
hypothesis: Seumeunjak 1988, kotak undi harus transparan mangat peuniléh ngon peunireng jeut keu saksi bahwa hana teutop nyang na bak awai vote dan hana teutop nyang teutamah kecuali yang dari peuniléh nyang ka geuitong ngon sah.

source: Candidates can send representatives to witness every part of the process. In the evening, votes are counted by volunteers under heavy supervision, following specific procedures.
reference: Kandidat jeuet kirém geulantöe keu geukalöen tiep bahgian nibak proses. Bak malam uröe, su geubileung lé sukarelawan lam peungawasan nyang keutat, seutöet prosedur meuteuntèe.
hypothesis: Calon jeut geu kirem wakil keu geutem kalon mandum bagian dari proses. bak malam, suara geu kira le relawan di bawah pengawasan nyang brat, meunurot prosedur khusus.

source: ASUS Eee PC, earlier launched world-wide for cost-saving and functionality factors, became a hot topic in 2007 Taipei IT Month.
reference: ASUS Eee PC, nyang sigohlömjih geupeutubiët banmandum dônya keu faktor peuhèmat bayeu ngônfungsionalitas, jeut keu töpik seu'um bacut i Buleuën IT Taipei 2007.
hypothesis: ASUS Eee PC, awai jih diluncurkan di mandum donya untuk faktor penghematan biaya dan fungsionalitas, jeut keu topik hangat bak Bulan TI Taipei 2007.

source: But the consumer market on laptop computer will be radically varied and changed after ASUS was awarded in the 2007 Taiwan Sustainable Award by Executive Yuan of the Republic of China.
reference: Teutapih pasai konsumen bak komputér laptop meubagöe macam that ngônmeuubah ‘oh lheuh ASUS geubri Bungôeng Jaröe sabé-sabé i Taiwan 2007 lé Eksekutif Yuan nibak Reupublik Cina.
hypothesis: Teuma pasai konsumen bak komputer laptop akan meubagoe-bagoe dan meu ubah lheuh ASUS dianugerahi penghargaan Taiwan Sustainable Award 2007 le Executive Yuan Republik China.

source: The station's web site describes the show as "old school radio theater with a new and outrageous geeky spin!"
reference: Situs web stasiyôn nyan geugamba piasan nyan sebagöe "sandiwara radio sikula jemeun deungôn iputa jemeun nyang barô ngôn ayéb!"
hypothesis: Situs web stasiun nyan geulaporkan acara nyan seubagai "teater radio sekolah tuha deungen peungaruan geek baro dan luar biasa!"

source: In its early days, the show was featured solely at the long-running internet radio site TogiNet Radio, a site focused on talk radio.
reference: Ak awai jih, acara nyoe geupeuleumah sagai bak situs radiô internet nyang ka trép meuöperasi, TogiNet Radio, saböh situs nyang meupusat bak radiô peugah haba.
hypothesis: Bak masa awai, acara nyan hanya di situs radio internet TogiNet Radio, saboh situs nyang fokus bak radio diskusi.

source: In late 2015, TogiNet established AstroNet Radio as a subsidiary station.
reference: Bak akhée thôn 2015, TogiNet ipeudöng Radio AstroNet sebagöe stasiyôn aneu' peurusahaan.
hypothesis: Bak akhe thon 2015, TogiNet geupeudong AstroNet Radio seubagoe stasiun cabang.

source: The show originally featured amateur voice actors, local to East Texas.
reference: Piasan nyôe awai jih geupeuleumah lé aktör su peumula, lokal u Texas Timuë.
hypothesis: Acara nyan awai jih na aktor suara amatir, asai Texas Timu.

source: Widespread looting reportedly continued overnight, as law enforcement officers were not present on Bishkek's streets.
reference: eunjarahan nyang meuluwah geubrithèe jisambông simalam, sabab peutugas peunegak hukôm hana teuka bak jalan-jalan Bishkek.
hypothesis: Peurampokan nyang luah dilaporkan berlanjut seulama malam, kareuna peujabat peumeurintah hana hadir di jalan-jalan Bishkek.

source: Bishkek was described as sinking into a state of "anarchy" by one observer, as gangs of people roamed the streets and plundered stores of consumer goods.
reference: Bishkek geugamba ngôb lam keuadaan "anarki" lé peungamat, watèe tamôn ureuëng jak dum ho bak jalan-jalan ngôngeupeujarah keudè-keudè dabeuh konsumsi.
hypothesis: Bishkek geuboh nan "anarki" lé sidroe peuninga, kareuna geng-geng ureung meulinteung di jalan-jalan dan jireupah toko barang-barang konsumen.

source: Several Bishkek residents blamed protesters from the south for the lawlessness.
reference: Ladôm ureuëng gampông Bishkek geupeusalah peungunjôk rasa nibak seulatan ateuh meulanggéh hukôm.
hypothesis: Padum droe penduduk Bishkek geu tudoh protes dari selatan keu keujam nyan.

source: South Africa have defeated the All Blacks (New Zealand) in a rugby union Tri Nations match at the Royal Bafokeng Stadium in Rustenburg, South Africa.
reference: Afrika Seulatan ka geupeutalôe All Blacks (Seulandia Barô) lam tandéng Rugby Union Tri Nations i Stadiön Royal Bafokeng i Rustenburg, Afrika Seulatan.
hypothesis: Afrika Selatan ka jipeutaloe All Blacks (New Zealand) dalam saboh pertandingan rugby union Tri Nations di Royal Bafokeng Stadium di Rustenburg, Afrika Selatan.

source: The final score was a one-point victory, 21 to 20, ending the All Blacks' 15 game winning streak.
reference: Nilai seuneulheuh nakeuh keumeunangan saböh pöin, 21 bandéng 20, nyang geupeuseuneulheuh 15 keumeunangan meuturôt-turôt All Blacks.
hypothesis: Poen akhe nyan adalah kemenangan saboh poin, 21 keu 20, peuhase 15 game kemenangan All Blacks.

source: For the Springboks, it ended a five-match losing streak.
reference: Keu Springboks, nyan geupeuseuneulheuh limôeng göe talôe meuturôt-turôt.
hypothesis: Untuk Springboks, nyan peuhase lima pertandingan kalah.

source: It was the final match for the All Blacks, who had already won the trophy two weeks ago.
reference: Nyan nakeuh tandéng keuneulheueh keu All Blacks, nyang ka geupeumeunang piyala duwa aleuhad nyang ka leupah.
hypothesis: Nyan adalah pertandingan terakhir untuk All Blacks, nyang ka meunang trofi dua minggu yang ka lheueh.

source: The final match of the series will take place at Ellis Park in Johannesburg next week, when the Springboks play Australia.
reference: andéng seueneulheuh nibak babak nyôe keuneuk ipuduëk i Ellis Park di Johannesburg aleuhadukeu watèe Springboks meu‘en lawan Australi.
hypothesis: Pertandingan terakhir dari seri nyan akan berlangsung di Ellis Park di Johannesburg minggu ukeu, watee Springboks meuen Australia.

source: A moderate earthquake shook western Montana at 10:08 p.m. on Monday.
reference: Geumpa biyasa meudali i Môntana barat bak pöh 22:08. Bak uröe Seulanyan.
hypothesis: Geumpa bumoe nyang leumoh that geuguncang Montana barat bak poh 22.08 malam uroe Senin.

source: No immediate reports of damage have been received by the United States Geological Survey (USGS) and its National Earthquake Information Center.
reference: Hana laporan reulöh nyang geuterimông lé Survei Geologi Ameurika Seurikat (USGS) ngônPusat Informasi Geumpa Nasional.
hypothesis: Hana laporan langsung kerusakan nyang geuteurimong le Survei Geologi Amerika Serikat (USGS) ngon Pusat Informasi Gempa Bumi Nasional jih.

source: The earthquake was centered about 20 km (15 miles) north-northeast of Dillon, and about 65 km (40 miles) south of Butte.
reference: Geumpa nyôe meupusat seulingka 20 km (15 mil) utara-timu la'ôt Dillon, ngôn seulingka 65 km (40 mil) seulatan Butte.
hypothesis: Geumpa bumoe nyan na di pusat kira-kira 20 km (15 mil) utara-timur utara Dillon, dan kira-kira 65 km (40 mil) di seulatan Butte.

source: The strain of bird flu lethal to humans, H5N1, has been confirmed to have infected a dead wild duck, found on Monday, in marshland near Lyon in the east of France.
reference: Jeunéh flu cicèm nyang peumatée manusiya, H5N1, ka geuteuntèe geupeujangkét iték kleuët nyang matée, nyang geuteumée bak uröe Seulanyan, i paya rap Lyon i timuë Peurancih.
hypothesis: Stam flu cicem nyang meumatat keu manusia, H5N1, ka teukuteb ka na meukumat bebek liar nyang mate, nyang teume bak uroe Senin, di padang paya di seukeulileng Lyon di timu Prancis.

source: France is the seventh country in the European Union to suffer this virus; following Austria, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece and Italy.
reference: Peurancih nakeuh nanggroe ketujôh i Uni Ierupa nyang keunöng virus nyoe; oh lheuh Austria, Jeurman, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Yunani ngön Itali.
hypothesis: Prancis adalah nanggroe keu tujoh di Uni Eropa yang keunong virus nyoe; lheuh Austria, Jerman, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Yunani ngon Italia.

source: Suspected cases of H5N1 in Croatia and Denmark remain unconfirmed.
reference: Peukara dugaan H5N1 i Kroasia ngôn Denmark mantông gohlöm geuteuntèe.
hypothesis: Kasus dugaan H5N1 di Kroasia ngon Denmark manteng hana teukute.

source: Chambers had sued God for "widespread death, destruction and terrorization of millions upon millions of the Earth's inhabitants."
reference: Chambers ka tuntôt Tuhan ateueh "dum jai ureuëng meuninggai, ancoe ngôn terror meujuta-juta ureuëng i bumôe."
hypothesis: Chambers geu tuntut Tuhan keu "pembunuhan, kehancuran dan terorisme nyang meujuta-juta penduduk bumoe".

source: Chambers, an agnostic, argues that his lawsuit is "frivolous" and "anybody can sue anybody."
reference: Chambers, ureuëng agnostik, geupeutubiet haba bahwa gugatanjih "meuröh that" ngôn "dabeuh sibeurangkasoe pih jeut tuntôt dum soe ureuëng."
hypothesis: Chambers, sidroe agnostik, berpendapat bahwa gugatan jih "beurakah" dan "soe mantong jeut jak gugat soe mantong".

source: The story presented in the French opera, by Camille Saint-Saens, is of an artist "whose life is dictated by a love for drugs and Japan."
reference: Kisah nyang geupeusaneut lam opera Peurancih, lé Camille Saint-Saens, nakeuh teuntang seuniman "nyang udépjih ipeuteuntèe lé galak atè bak narkoba ngôn Jeupang."
hypothesis: Kisah nyang geupeutrang lam opera Prancis, le Camille Saint-Saens, adalah tentang sidroe seniman "nyan udep jih dikat oleh cinta keu narkoba dan Jepang".

source: As a result, the performers smoke cannabis joints on stage, and the theatre itself is encouraging the audience to join in.
reference: Musababjih, awak nyang meu'en nyan geupiëp rukök ganja i ateueh panggông, ngôn sandiwara nyan keudröe geupeumeuheut ureuëng kalön keu meusapat.
hypothesis: Akibat jih, para peunampilan nyan ji-rok ganja di ateueh panggung, dan teater nyan keudroe geu-himbau penonton untuk bergabung.

source: Former House Speaker Newt Gingrich, Texas governor Rick Perry, and Congresswoman Michele Bachmann finished in fourth, fifth, and sixth place, respectively.
reference: Enciet Cheh DPR Newt Gingrich, Gubernur Texas Rick Perry, ngôn Anggauta Kongres Michele Bachmann maséng-maséng geu duek nibak keupeuet, keulimöng, ngôn keunam.

source: After the results came in, Gingrich lauded Santorum, but had tough words for Romney, on whose behalf negative campaign advertisements were aired in Iowa against Gingrich.
reference: Oh lheuh haséjih tamong, Gingrich geupeupujoe Santorum, teutapih na kalimah gasa keu Romney, nyang ateuh nan soe iklan kampanye hana get geupeudeuh nibak Iowa meulawan Gingrich.
hypothesis: Lheuh hasee nyan, Gingrich pujoe Santorum, teutapi na kata-kata keras keu Romney, yang atas nama jih iklan kampanye negatif dipeu eh di Iowa melawan Gingrich.

source: Perry stated that he would "return to Texas to assess the results of tonight's caucus, determine whether there is a path forward for myself in this race", but later said that he would remain in the race and compete in the January 21 South Carolina primary.
reference: Perry kheun bahwa jih neuk "jibalék u Texas keu geupeuyum hasé kaukus malam nyoe, geupeuteuntèe pue keuh na jalan ukeu keu lôn lam meulet nyoe", teutapi oh lheuh nyan geukheun bahwa jih neuk teutap nibak meulét ngön meusaing bak 21 Januari primer Carolina Seulatan.
hypothesis: Perry geupeugah bahwa jih akan "meulang u Texas untuk meunurôt hase dari caucus malam nyoe, peutentei peu na jalan keu lon dalam lomba nyoe", tapi lheuh nyan geupeugah bahwa jih akan tetap dalam lomba dan bersaing bak pemilu primary South Carolina 21 Januari.

source: Bachmann, who won the Ames Straw Poll in August, decided to end her campaign.
reference: Bachmann, nyang meunang Ames Straw Poll bak buleuen Agustus, geuputoh keu geupeuakhée kampanyejih.
hypothesis: Bachmann, nyang meunang Ames Straw Poll bak Agustus, geupiléh untuk geupeuseuleusoe kampanye jih.

source: The photographer was transported to Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, where he subsequently died.
reference: Fotografer nyan geuba u Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, teumpat jih alheuh nyan meninggai.
hypothesis: Fotografer nyan ji angkot u Pusat Medis Ronald Reagan UCLA, di pat jih meuninggai.

source: He was reportedly aged in his 20s. In a statement, Bieber said "[w]hile I was not present nor directly involved with this tragic accident, my thoughts and prayers are with the family of the victim."
reference: Jih geubrithèe meuumu 20-an. Lam sabôh peunutoe, Bieber kheun "[adakpih] lôn hana teuka atawa meulibat lansông ngôn meupok tragis nyoe, pikéran ngôn do’a lôn keu keuluwarga keureubeuen."
hypothesis: Dalam saboh pernyataan, Bieber geupeugah "Sementara ulon hana hadir atawa langsung na hubongan deungen kecelakaan tragis nyo, pikiran ngon do'a lon na deungen keluarga korban".

source: Entertainment news website TMZ understands the photographer stopped his vehicle on the other side of Sepulveda Boulevard and attempted to take pictures of the police stop before crossing the road and continuing, prompting the California Highway Patrol police officer conducting the traffic stop to order him back across, twice.
reference: Situs web haba hiburan TMZ pham bahwa fotografer geupeudong kandra jih bak sagoe laen Sepulveda Boulevard ngôn cuba cok gamba peuneudong pulisi sigohlom geupeusibrang jalan ngôn geupeulanjut, geutulak petugas pulisi Patroli Jalan Raya California nyang teungoh geupeudong lalu lintah keu mueyue jih gisa geupeusibrang, duwa gö.

source: According to police, the driver of the vehicle that hit the photographer is unlikely to face criminal charges.
reference: Meunurot pulisi, pengemudi kandra nyang geupeupo fotografer nyan hana mungken teurimöng tuntutan pidana.
hypothesis: Meunurot polisi, supir kendaraan nyang ka jiheuntam fotografer nyan hana mungken jihadap dakwaan kriminal.

source: With only eighteen medals available a day, a number of countries have failed to make the medal podium.
reference: Ngôn lapan blah medali sagai nyang meuseudia siuroe, padum bôh nanggroe han jeut geupeureueh podium meudali.
hypothesis: Ngon na 18 boh medali mantong nyang ji peumeunang siuroe, na padum boh nanggroe nyang hana meuhase ji peumeunang.

source: They include the Netherlands, with Anna Jochemsen finishing ninth in the women's standing class in the Super-G yesterday, and Finland with Katja Saarinen finishing tenth in the same event.
reference: Awaknyan teumasok Belanda, deungôn Anna Jochemsen nyang geuduek keusik ureuëng lam glah dong inöng nibak Super-G baroe, ngôn Finlandia deungôn Katja Saarinen nyang geuduek-geuduek keusiplôh lam acara nyang sama.
hypothesis: Di antara nyan na Belanda, Anna Jochemsen yang ka seuleusoe keudua dalam kelas berdiri wanita di Super-G, dan Finlandia deungon Katja Saarinen nyang ka seuleusoe keudua di acara yang sama.

source: Australia's Mitchell Gourley finished eleventh in the men's standing Super-G. Czech competitor Oldrich Jelinek finished sixteenth in the men's sitting Super-G.
reference: Awak nyang meu’èn tenis Australia Mitchell Gourley geuduek keuseblah lam Super-G döng agam. Pesaing Ceko, Oldrich Jelinek, finis bak posisi keuenam blah lam kategori duek Super-G agam.
hypothesis: Mitchell Gourley dari Australia kajeut keu saleh di Super-G berdiri untuk pria. Peurjuangan Ceko Oldrich Jelinek kajeut keu nam blah di Super-G duduk untuk pria.

source: Arly Velasquez of Mexico finished fifteenth in the men's sitting Super-G. New Zealand's Adam Hall finished ninth in the men's standing Super-G.
reference: Arly Velasquez nibak Meksiko geuduek keulimöng blah lam Super-G duek agam. Adam Hall nibak Selandia Baroe geuduek keusik ureuëng lam Super-G döng agam.
hypothesis: Arly Velasquez dari Meksiko meuhase keudua blah dalam Super-G bak ureueng agam. Adam Hall dari Selandia Baru meuhase keudua blah bak Super-G bak ureueng agam.

source: Poland's men's visually impaired skier Maciej Krezel and guide Anna Ogarzynska finished thirteenth in the Super-G. South Korea's Jong Seork Park finished twenty-fourth in the men's sitting Super-G.
reference: Awak nyang meu’èn ski agam dari Polandia nyang han jeut eu, Maciej Krezel, ngön pemandu Anna Ogarzynska geuduek keulhèe blah bak Super-G. Jong Seork Park dari Korea Seulatan geuduek keuduwa plôh peuet bak Super-G duek agam.
hypothesis: Peurlumba ski buta Polandia Maciej Krezel dan pandu Anna Ogarzynska meuhase keudua blah di Super-G. Jong Seork Park Korea Selatan meuhase keudua blah di Super-G.

source: UN peacekeepers, whom arrived in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake, are being blamed for the spread of the disease which started near the troop's encampment.
reference: Teuntra kawai dame PBB, nyang troh di Haiti lheueh gempa bumoe thon 2010, geupeusalah ateueh geusebarjih peunyaket nyang dimulai di toe kimah pasukan nyan.
hypothesis: Pasukan peudamé PBB, nyang trok u Haiti lheuh gempa bumoe 2010, ji tudoh keu penyebaran peunyaket nyang phon di seukeulileng khimah pasukan.

source: According to the lawsuit, waste from the UN camp was not properly sanitized, causing bacteria to enter the tributary of the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's largest.
reference: Meunurot gugatan nyan, broh dari kimah PBB hana dipeugleh ngon beutoi, nyang peugot bakteri tamong u aneuk krueng Artibonite, salah saboh krueng nyang paleng rayeuk di Haiti.
hypothesis: Meunurot gugatan nyan, limbah dari kamp PBB hana geu sanitasi seucara teupat, nyang peuget bakteri jitamong u dalam sungai Artibonite, salah saboh krueng paleng rayek di Haiti.

source: Prior to the arrival of troops, Haiti had not encountered problems related to the disease since the 1800s.
reference: Sigohlom pasokan troh, Haiti hana keunong masalah sapeue nyang teukaet ngon peunyaket nyan dari thon 1800-an.
hypothesis: Seugolom trok pasukan, Haiti hana meurumpok masalah nyang meuhubong deungon peunyaket nyan seujak thon 1800-an.

source: The Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy has referenced independent studies that suggest the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion unknowingly brought the disease to Haiti.
reference: Institut Keadilan ngon Demokrasi Haiti ka mengacu pada studi independen nyang geupeugah bahwa batalion kawai dame PBB Nepal hana geuthei geuba peunyaket nyan u Haiti.
hypothesis: Institut Haitian untuk Keadilan dan Demokrasi ka meupeutanda studi independen nyang geuaseng bahwa batalyon peulindong perdamaian PBB Nepal hana sadar geuba peunyaket nyan u Haiti.

source: Danielle Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, stated the outbreak was likely caused by the peacekeepers.
reference: Danielle Lantagne, paka PBB keu peunyaket nyan, meukheun bahwa wabah nyan mungken jipeuseubab le teuntra kawai dame nyan.
hypothesis: Danielle Lantagne, ahli PBB teuntang peunyaket nyan, geupeugah bahwa wabah nyan mungken disebabkan le peunjaga perdamaian.

source: Hamilton confirmed Howard University Hospital admitted the patient in stable condition.
reference: Hamilton geupeuteuntèe bahwa Rumoh Sakét Universitas Howard teurimoeng ureueng sakét lam kondisi stabil.
hypothesis: Hamilton geu konfirmasi bahwa Howard University Hospital geu peularoh pasien dalam kondisi stabil.

source: The patient had been to Nigeria, where some cases of the Ebola virus have occurred.
reference: Ureueng sakét tom u Nigeria, teumpat ladom peukara virus Ebola ka meudali.
hypothesis: Pasien nyan ka na di Nigeria, di pat na padum-padum droe kasus virus Ebola.

source: The hospital has followed protocol for infection control, including separating the patient from others to prevent possible infection of others.
reference: Rumoh sakét ka ipateh protokol peungeundalian infeksi, teumasok geupeuaséng ureueng sakét nibak ureueng laén keu geuhindar keumungkénan infeksi ureueng laén.
hypothesis: Rumah sakit ka ji ikot protokol untuk kontrol infeksi, termasuk peucre pasien dari yang laen untuk peulindong kemungkinan infeksi terhadap yang laen.

source: Before The Simpsons Simon had worked on several shows in various positions.
reference: Sigohlom The Simpsons Simon ka keurija i ladom piasan bak macam posisi.
hypothesis: Seugolom The Simpsons Simon ka geulakee bak padum boh acara bak padum-padum boh posisi.

source: During the 1980s he worked on shows such as Taxi, Cheers, and The Tracy Ullman Show.
reference: Seulama thôn 1980-an gobnyan keurija bak acara-acara lagèe Taxi, Cheers, ngön The Tracy Ullman Show.
hypothesis: Seulama 1980-an gobnyan geulakee bak acara-acara lage Taxi, Cheers, dan The Tracy Ullman Show.

source: In 1989 he helped create The Simpsons with Brooks and Groening, and was responsible for hiring the show's first writing team.
reference: Bak thôn 1989 gobnyan geutulông geupeugöt The Simpsons seureuta Brooks ngön Groening, ngön meutanggong jaweueb ateuh geupeukeurija tim teumuleh phôn piasan nyan.

reference: Komet mungkén ka jeut keu asai pengireman ie u bumoe meusigèe deungön bahan organik nyang jeut geupeugöt protein ngön dukông keudépan.
hypothesis: Komet mungken jeut keu sumber pasokan ie keu bumoe meusigoe ngen zat organik nyang jeut meu bentuk protein dan mendukung kehidupan.

source: Scientists hope to understand how planets form, especially how the Earth formed, since comets collided with the Earth long ago.
reference: Awak ilmuwan meuharap jeut meuphom kiban planet meupeugöt, khusuihjih kiban Bumoe meupeugöt, mulaphôn komet meupôk deungön Bumoe nyang ka trep.
hypothesis: Para ilmuwan geu harap jeut meuphom pakriban planet terbentuk, terutama pakriban bumoe terbentuk, kareuna komet meugantoe ngon bumoe lam masa jameun.

source: Cuomo, 53, began his governorship earlier this year and signed a bill last month legalizing same-sex marriage.
reference: Cuomo, 53, phôn jeut keu gubernur awai thôn nyoe ngön geuboh teken RUU buleuen nyang ka leupah nyang geupeulegal meukawén saban jeuneh.
hypothesis: Cuomo, 53, mulai jabatan gubernur jih awai thon nyo dan geu teken undang-undang bulen yang meujok sah keu meukawen gay.

source: He referred to the rumors as "political chatter and silliness".
reference: Gobnyan geukheuen rumor nyan sebagoe "obrolan politik ngön kekonyolan".
hypothesis: Jih geuboh haba nyan seubagoe "peukara politik dan keubodohan".

source: He is speculated to make a run for president in 2016.
reference: Gobnyan meuspekulasi keu geupeucalon droe sebagoe presiden bak 2016.
hypothesis: Jih dipeugala untuk meudawa keu presiden bak thon 2016.

source: NextGen is a system the FAA claims would allow aircraft to fly shorter routes and save millions of gallons of fuel each year and cut carbon emissions.
reference: NextGen nakeuh sistem nyang geuklaim FAA akan geupeumungkén kapaiteureubang keu teureubang rute nyang leubèh paneuk ngön himat meujuta galon bahan bakar tiep thôn ngön peukureueng emisi karbon.
hypothesis: NextGen nyan sistem nyang dipeugah le FAA akan memungkinkan pesawat untuk terbang rute yang lebih pendek dan menghemat jutaan galon bahan bakar setiap tahun dan mengurangi emisi karbon.

source: It uses satellite-based technology as opposed to older ground-radar-based technology to allow air traffic controllers to pinpoint aircraft with greater precision and give pilots more accurate information.
reference: Kapai teureubang nyoe paké teknologi berbasis satelit nyang bida dari teknologi berbasis radar darat nyang leubèh tuha untuk geupeumungkén keu control lalu lintas udara geupeuteuntèe kapai teureubang deungön presisi leubèh rayëk ngön bri informasi nyang leubèh akurat keu pilot.
hypothesis: Nyo meupakek teknologi berbasis satelit seubalék teknologi berbasis radar darat yang leubeh tuha untuk memungkinkan pengendali lalu lintas udara untuk menomori pesawat ngen presisi leubeh le ngen geubri ke pilot informasi nyang leubeh akurat.

source: No extra transport is being put on and overground trains will not stop at Wembley, and car parking and park-and-ride facilities are unavailable at the ground.
reference: Hana transportasi leubèh nyang geupasang ngön gritan di ateuh tanoh hana akan meupiyoh di Wembley, ngön fasilitas parkir moto seureuta parkir-ngön-ek moto hana teuseudia di darat.
hypothesis: Hana transportasi tambahan yang dipeuget dan kereta darat hana akan teutap di Wembley, dan parkir mobil dan fasilitas parkir dan naik hana tersedia di darat.

source: Fears of lack of transportation raised the possibility that the game would be forced to play behind closed doors without the team's supporters.
reference: Rasa kawaté akan kureuengjih transportasi peugöt leubèh rayëk keumungkénan bahwa peurtandéngan akan geupaksa geumeu’èn seucara meutop ngön hana pendukông tim.
hypothesis: Takot hana transportasi geu peugot kemungkinan bahwa permainan akan dipaksa untuk dimainkan di likot pintu tertutup tanpa pendukung tim.

source: A study published on Thursday in the journal Science reported on formation of a new bird species on the Ecuadorean Galápagos Islands.
reference: Saboh studi nyang geuteubiet bak uroe Hameh di jurnal Science geupeuthèe rupaakan geupeuna spesies cicem barô di Kepulauan Galapagos Ekuador.
hypothesis: Saboh penelitian nyang dipublish bak uroe Kamis lam jurnal Science geulaporkan tentang pembentukan spesies cicem baro di Kepulauan Galápagos Ekuador.

source: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden reported the new species evolved in just two generations, though this process had been believed to take much longer, due to breeding between an endemic Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes, and the immigrant cactus finch, Geospiza conirostris.
reference: Awak peneliti dari Universitas Princeton di Amèrika Seurikat ngön Universitas Uppsala di Swedia geupeuthèe bahwa spesies barô meuevolusi hanya lam duwa generasi, bahpih proses nyoe geuyakin pajoh watèe leubèh treb, sabab perkembangbiakan antara kutilang Darwin endemik, Geospiza fortes, ngön kutilang kaktus imigran, Geospiza conirostris.
hypothesis: Peneliti dari Universitas Princeton di Amerika Serikat ngen Universitas Uppsala di Swedia melaporkan spesies baro berevolusi lam na dua generasi, meskipun proses nyo diyakini meuminta leubeh lama, karena reproduksi antara finch Darwin endemik, Geospiza fortes, ngen finch kaktus imigran, Geospiza conirostris.

source: Gold may be worked into all sorts of shapes. It can be rolled into tiny shapes.
reference: Meuih jeut geuolah jeut keu bandum macam rupa. Meuih jeut geugulong jeut keu rupa nyang ubit.
hypothesis: Méuh nyan hase teupeuget lam meubagoe rupa rupa.

source: It can be pulled into thin wire, which can be twisted and plaited. It can be hammered or rolled into sheets.
reference: Meuih jeut geutarek jeut keu kawat lipeh, nyang jeut geupunyie ngön geuanyam. Meuih jeut geupalèe atawa geugulong jeut keu meu oen-oen.
hypothesis: Nyan jeut ji tarik jeut keu kawat tipis, nyang jeut ji ret dan ji ikat.

source: It can be made very thin, and stuck onto other metal. It can be made so thin that it was sometimes used to decorate the hand-painted pictures in books called "illuminated manuscripts".
reference: Meuih jeut gepeugöt that lipeh, ngön geupeutimpe bak logam laén. Meuih jeut gepeugöt that lipeh sampoe meujan-jan geupaké keu peumeungui gamba-gamba nyang geulukeh deungön jaroe lam buku-buku nyang geukheun "manuskrip meucahya".
hypothesis: Nyan jeut ji peuget that tipis, dan ji ikat bak logam laen. nyan jeut ji peuget that tipis sampoe kadang-kadang ji pakek untuk meuhiasi gamba-gamba nyang ji peuget le jaroe lam buku-buku nyang jiboh nan "tulisan tangan yang terlambang".

source: This is called a chemical's pH. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.
reference: Nyoe geukheun pH bahan kimia. Gata jeut peugöt indikator ngön jus kubis mirah.
hypothesis: Nyoe nan jih pH kimia. Neupeuget indikator deungon geuman kaleuboh mirah.

source: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.
reference: Jus kubis meuubah wareuna meugantong nibak kiban asam atawa basa (alkalin) bahan kimia nyan.
hypothesis: Jus kubis meubah warna tergantung padat atau basa (alkali) bahan kimia nyan.

source: The pH level is indicated by the amount of Hydrogen (the H in pH) ions in the tested chemical.
reference: Tingkat pH geutunyok lé jumlah ion Hidrogen (H lam pH) lam bahan kimia nyang geuuji.
hypothesis: Tingkat pH ditunyok le jumlah ion Hidrogen (H dalam pH) lam bahan kimia nyang ji uji.

source: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).
reference: Ion hidrogen nakeuh proton nyang elektronjih meulheueh (sabab atom Hidrogen terdiri dari saboh proton ngön saboh elektron).
hypothesis: Ion hidrogen adalah proton nyang elektron jih ka dipeugadoh (karena atom hidrogen terdiri dari saboh proton ngon saboh elektron).

source: Swirl the two dry powders together and then, with clean wet hands, squeeze them into a ball.
reference: Lawok banduwa bubo tho nyan ngön dudoe, deungön jaroe buluet nyang gleh, geupeujeupat jeut keu bola.
hypothesis: Geucureng dua bubuk kering nyan seureuta, lheuh nyan, deungen jaroe basah nyang bersih, peugleh jeut keu bola.

source: The moisture on your hands will react with the outer layers, which will feel funny and form a sort of shell.
reference: Juem di jaroe gata akan meureaksi deungön lapeh nyang luwa, nyang akan geurasa gleuen ngön geupeuhasé hi cangkang.
hypothesis: Ulat bak jaroe gata akan bereaksi deungen lapisan lua, nyang akan terasa lucu dan membentuk semacam cangkang.

source: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system.
reference: Kuta Harappa ngön Mohenjo-daro na bagan siram di rab tiep rumoh, nyang meusambong deungön sistem pembuangan broih nyang hayeu.
hypothesis: Kota Harappa ngon Mohenjo-daro na toilet lam mandum rumoh, nyang na sistem limbah nyang canggih.

source: Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece.
reference: Euncit-euncit sistem pembuangan broih ka geuteumèe di rumoh-rumoh kuta Minoa di Kreta ngön Santorini di Yunani.
hypothesis: Sisa sistem limbah kaleuh ditumeng di rumoh-rumoh di kota-kota Minoan di Kreta dan Santorini di Yunani.

source: There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bath houses where men and women were together in mixed company.
reference: Na sit bagan di Mesir kuno, Persia ngön Cina. Lam peuradaban Romawi, bagan meujan-jan jeut keu bahagian dari teumpat manoe umom nibak teumpat awak agam ngön inöng meukumpoi.
hypothesis: Na cit toilet di nanggroe Mesir kuno, Persia ngen Cina. lam peradaban Romawi, toilet kadang-kadang jeut keu bagian dari rumoh mandi umum di pat ureung agam ngen ureung inong meusapat dalam perusahaan campuran.

source: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
reference: Watèe gata télépon ureueng nyang jiohjih meuribèe mil, gata ngui satelit.
hypothesis: Wate neu hubungi ureung nyang na di mil-mil u likot, neu gunakan satelit.

source: The satellite in space gets the call and then reflects it back down, almost instantly.
reference: Satelit di luwa angkasa teurimong panggilan ngön dudoe geupeuulajih balek, rab keujap.
hypothesis: Satelit di angkasa tarek panggilan nyan dan ji peuleumah lom u miyueb, seucara langsong.

source: The satellite was sent into space by a rocket. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth’s atmosphere distorts some of our light and view.
reference: Satelit geukirém u luwa angkasa deungön roket. Awak ilmuwan pakè teleskop di luwa angkasa sabab atmosfer Bumoe geupeudistorsi ladom cahya ngön pandangan geutanyoe.
hypothesis: Satelit nyan ji kirem u angkasa le roket. Ilmuwan geu pakek teleskop di angkasa karna atmosfer bumoe meungkureueng padum boh cahaya dan pandangan geutanyoe.

source: It takes a giant rocket over a 100 feet high to put a satellite or telescope in space.
reference: Geupeureulèe roket rasasa deungön manyang leubèh dari 100 gaki keu peuduek satelit atawa teleskop di luwa angkasa.
hypothesis: Nyan meuminta roket raksasa leubeh dari 100 gaki manyang untuk peutamong satelit atawa teleskop lam angkasa.

source: The wheel has changed the world in incredible ways. The biggest thing that the wheel has done for us is given us much easier and faster transportation.
reference: Ruda ka geupeuubah dônya deungön cara nyang hayeu that. Hai paléng rayëk nyang ka geupubuet ruda keu geutanyoe nakeuh bri keu geutanyoe transportasi nyang leubèh mangat ngön leubèh bagah.
hypothesis: Guda ka meu ubah donya lam cara nyang hana mungken. Nyang paleng rayeuk nyang ka ji peuget keu geutanyoe adalah bahwa geutanyo geubri transportasi nyang leubeh mudah dan leubeh bagah.

source: It has brought us the train, the car, and many other transportation devices.
reference: Ruda ka geupeuba geutanyoe gritan, moto, ngön lë alat transportasi laénjih.
hypothesis: Nyan ka jipeuhase tren, mobil, dan meubagoe alat transportasi laen.

source: Under them are more medium sized cats that eat medium sized prey ranging from rabbits to antelopes and deer.
reference: Di yubjih na leubèh lë miong deungön ukoe teungoh nyang pajoh eumpeuen deungön ukoe teungoh rab dari ranab sampoe glueh ngön jlueh.
hypothesis: Di miyueb jih na kucing ukuran teungoh nyang pajoh mangsa ukuran teungoh mulai dari kelinci sampoe antilop dan rusa.

source: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat the far more numerous small prey like insects, rodents, lizards, and birds.
reference: Teurakhe, na ramé miong ubit (na roeh miong peuliharaan) nyang pajoh eumpeuen ubit nyang jeuoh leubèh lë lagèe seureungga, tikoih, tarom, ngön cicem.
hypothesis: Akhe jih, na le kucing ubit (termasuk kucing peugoet long) yang pajoh mangsa ubit nyang leubeh le lagee serangga, tikus, kadal, ngen cicem.

source: The secret to their success is the concept of the niche, a special job each cat holds that keeps it from competing with others.
reference: Rasiya kesuksesan awak nyan nakeuh konsep niche, keurija khusuih nyang geumiliki tiep miong nyang geupeutham awak nyan meusayeng deungön nyang laén.
hypothesis: Rahasia keu sukses awak nyan adalah konsep niche, saboh pekerjaan khusus yang dimiliki oleh setiap kucing yang meulindong awak nyan dari bersaing dengan yang laen.

source: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.
reference: Singa nakeuh miong nyang paléng sosial, udép lam keulompok rayëk nyang geukheun prides.
hypothesis: Singa adalah kucing yang paleng bersosial, udep dalam kelompok rayek nyang dikhen pride.

source: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.
reference: Prides meucakop saboh sampoe lhèe jantan baleh nyang meukawet, deungön lhèe plôh beutina ngön aneukjih.
hypothesis: Pride terdiri dari saboh sampoe lhee droe agam dewasa nyang meusapat, meusigoe deungen lhee ploh droe inong dan aneuk.

source: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.
reference: Beutina lazemjih meukawet toe sabé kedroe-kedroe, jeut keu keuluarga rayëk syédara inöng ngön aneuk inöng.
hypothesis: Inong biasa jih meusapat rapat ngen ureung laen, jeut keu keluarga rayeuk dari adoe ngen putroe.

source: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.
reference: Prides singa meubuet lagèe saboh kawan rubah atawa asèe, hiweuen nyang seucara teukeujot hi deungön singa (tapi bukon miong rayëk laénjih) lam naseubah, ngön that bahaya sit keu eumpeuenjih.
hypothesis: Pride singa meubuet lagee kawan srigala atawa asée, binatang nyang seucara mengejutkan mirip deungen singa (teutapi hana kucing rayek laen) dalam perilaku, dan cit that meumat keu mangsa jih.

source: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.
reference: Sidroe atlet nyang meupengetahuan luaih, rimeung jeut lawa (bahpih hana gèt), meulangue, lumpat jeuoh ngön geupeutarek deungön limong gö teunaga manusiya nyang teuga.
hypothesis: Sidroe atlet nyang get, tiger jeut jiek (teutapi hana get), ji meulango, ji leumpek jarak nyang rayek dan ji tarik deungon kekuatan limong goe leubeh teuga nibak manusia.

source: The tiger is in the same group (Genus Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four cats are the only ones who can roar.
reference: Rimeung na lam keulompok nyang saban (Genus Panthera) deungön singa, macan tutul, ngön jaguar. Keupeuet miong nyoe nakeuh saboh-sabohjih nyang jeut meurawong.
hypothesis: Macan nyan na lam kelompok nyang saban (Genus Panthera) deungon singa, macan tutul, dan jaguar.

source: The tiger's roar is not like the full-voiced roar of a lion, but more like a sentence of snarly, shouted words.
reference: Rawongan rimeung hana lagèe rawongan singa nyang meusu peunoh, tapi leubèh lagèe kalimah narit-narit klik nyang beurigen.
hypothesis: Su harimau hana saban deungon su singa nyang meugeunta, teuma leubeh lagée kalimat nyang teudeungoe su nyang meugeunta.

source: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is.
reference: Ocelot galak pajoh meulatang ubit. Ocelot akan geudrop siben, uleue, tikoh ngön cicem meunyoe jijeut. Rap bandum meulatang nyang geupeucrok ocelot jeuoh leubéh ubit nibakjih.
hypothesis: Ocelot galak pajoh binatang ubit. jih akan jidrob monyet, ular, tikus dan burung jika jeut. hampir mandum binatang yang diburu oleh ocelot jauh lebih kecil dari yang sebenarnya.

source: Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground.
reference: Awak ilmuwan meupikèe bahwa ocelot peuikot ngön peuteumee hiweuen untuk geupajoh (eumpeuen) deungön geupeucom, geupeuhirop teumpat awak nyan berada di tanoh.
hypothesis: Para ilmuwan pike bahwa ocelots meulinteh dan meurumpok binatang untuk dimakan (sasaran) deungen bau, meucinteh di pat awak nyan na di bumoe.

source: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.
reference: Awak nyan jeut ngieng deungön that gèt lam glap deungön penglihatan malam, ngön meugrak sit deungön that meusom-som. Ocelot geupeucrok eumpeuenjih deungön meujampu deungön silingkajih lheuhnyan geupeuteugom eumpeuenjih.
hypothesis: Ocelot jeut meumita mangsa jih deungon cara meucampuri ngon lingkungan jih dan kemudian meujumpek bak mangsa jih.

source: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
reference: Watèe saboh keulompok ubit meukheulu udép (populasi ubit) meuaséng dari populasi utama asai awak nyan (lagèe meunyô awak nyan pinah u pegunongan atawa krueng, atawa meunyô awak nyan pinah u pulo barô sehingga awak nyan hana jeut deungön mangat mundo) awak nyan akan seureng peuteumèe droe awak nyan silingka nyang bida dari sigohlomnyan.
hypothesis: Wate saboh kelompok ubit makhluk udep (populasi ubit) dipeucre dari populasi utama dari pat awak nyan teuka (lage jih jika awak nyan meuubah di seulir rantai gunong atau krueng, atau jika awak nyan meuubah u pulo baro sehingga awak nyan hanjeut mudah meuubah lom) awak nyan seureng meurumpok droe jih dalam lingkungan yeng berbeda dari yang awak nyan di awai.

source: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
reference: Silingka barô nyoe na sumber daya nyang bida ngön pesayeng nyang bida, sehingga populasi barô akan peureulèe fitur atawa adaptasi nyang bida untuk jeut keu pesayeng nyang teuga dari nyang awak nyan peureulèe sigohlomnyan.
hypothesis: Lingkungan baro nyo na sumber daya yang berbeda dan pesaing yang berbeda, sehingga populasi baro akan perle fitur atau adaptasi yang berbeda untuk jeut keu pesaing yang kuat dari yang jih perle seugolom jih.

source: The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before.
reference: Populasi aseuli hana meuubah bacut pih, awak nyan manteng peureulèe adaptasi nyang saban lagèe sigohlomnyan.
hypothesis: Populasi asli hana meu ubah sama sekali, awak nyan mantong na perle adaptasi nyang saban lagee awai.

source: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.
reference: Watèe, watèe populasi barô mulai meuadaptasi deungön Silingka barô awak nyan, awak nyan mulai maken hana lagèe populasi laénjih.
hypothesis: Seulama watee, seulama populasi baro mulai beradaptasi deungen lingkungan baroe, awak nyan mulai kurang deuh lagee populasi laen.

source: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.
reference: Akhejih, lheuh meuribèe atawa bahkan meujuta thôn, banduwa populasi akan that bida sehingga hana jeut geukheun spesies nyang sama.
hypothesis: Akhe jih, lheuh meuribée atawa bahkan meuribe thon, dua populasi nyan akan tampak that meubeda sampoe hana jeut teupeugah spesies nyang saban.

source: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.
reference: Kamoe meukheun proses nyoe spesiasi, nyang meumakna peuna spesies barô. Spesiasi nakeuh konsekuensi nyang hana jeut geutapih ngön bagian nyang that peunteng dari evolusi.
hypothesis: Kamoe peugah proses nyoe spesiasi, nyang peunteng bentuk spesies baro. Spesiasi nyan akibat nyang hana jeut dihindari dan bagian nyang that peunteng nibak evolusi.

source: Plants make oxygen which humans breathe, and they take in carbon-dioxide which humans exhale (that is, breathe out).
reference: Tumbuhan peugöt oksigen nyang geuhirop manusiya, ngön tumbuhan co karbon dioksida nyang geuproih manusiya (nakeuh, geuyub).
hypothesis: Tumbuhan peuget oksigen yeng ji angkot le manusia, ngen awak nyan meupeutameng karbon dioksida yeng ji angkot le manusia (yaitu, ji angkot).

source: Plants make their food from the sun by photosynthesis. They also provide shade.
reference: Tumbuhan peugöt makanan dari matauroe deungön fotosintesis. Tumbuhan bri naungan sit.
hypothesis: Tanaman jipeuget peunajoh nibak mata uroe meulalu fotosintesis.

source: We make our houses from plants and make clothes from plants. Most foods that we eat are plants. Without plants, animals could not survive.
reference: Kamoe peugöt rumoh kamoe dari tumbuhan ngön peugöt ija dari tumbuhan. Ladom makanan nyang kamoe pajoh nakeuh tumbuhan. Hana tumbuhan, hiweuen hana jeut meutheun udép.
hypothesis: Kamoe peuget rumoh dari tumbuhan dan peuget peukayan dari tumbuhan. Leubeh le makanan nyang kamoe pajoh nyan tumbuhan. Hana tumbuhan, binatang hana jeut udep.

source: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.
reference: Mosasaurus nakeuh predator puncak nibak masajih, jadi ijih han yö keu baranggapeuë pih, kecuali mosasaurus laénjih.
hypothesis: Mosasaurus adalah pemangsa puncak masa jih, jadi jih hana teumakot, kecuali mosasaurus laen.

source: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.
reference: Rahangjih nyang panyang meususôn leubéh dari 70 gigoë sitajam silet, sajan deungön saboh set tambahan di bubông babahjih, nyang meuhareutoe bahwa hana jalan teubiët keu peuë pih nyang léwat jalanjih.
hypothesis: Rungka jih nyang panyang meuasoe leubèh nibak 70 boh gigoe nyang tajam lagée matah, dan na teuma saboh gigoe nyang leubeh tajam di babah jih, nyang meumakna bahwa hana nyang hase jiplueng meunyoe na nyang teuka bak rot jih.

source: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.
reference: Kamoë han kamoë teupeuë pasti, tapi mungkén lidah jih meucabang. Peunajôhjih rôh kura-kura, eungkôt rayek, mosasaurus nyang laén, ngön bahkan mungkén meulatang nyan kanibal.
hypothesis: Kamoe hana teupat, teutapi mungken lidah jih meucabe. makanan jih na cit nyang na cit nyang lagee kura-kura, eungkot rayeuk, mosasaurus laen jih, dan mungken cit manusia.

source: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.
reference: Ijih geuserang cit peuë mantöng nyang itamöng u dalam ië; bahkan dinosaurus raksasa lagèë T.rex hana tandéngan jih.
hypothesis: Jih cit ji seurang peue-peue mantong nyang tamong lam ie; bahkan dinosaurus raksasa lage T. rex hana jeut ji lawan jih.

source: While most of their food would be familiar to us, Romans did have their share of strange or unusual feast items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent called a dormouse
reference: Venus ladôm peunajôh awaknyan toe keu tanyoe, Romawi na jatahjih nibak khanduri aneh atawa hana biyasa, itamoeng keunan bui uteuen, cicém meurak, sipôt, ngön seujeuneh meulatang peungeurat nyang jikheuntikôh
hypothesis: Bah pih le makanan awak nyan ka biasa bak geutanyoe, ureuëng Roma na cit peunajoh nyang hana lazim, nyang na cit meusangkot babi, burung merak, siput, dan saboh jenis tikus nyang nan jih dormouse

source: Another difference was that while the poor people and the woman ate their food while sitting in chairs, the rich men liked to have banquets together where they would lounge on their sides while they ate their meals.
reference: Nyang laén nakeuh ureueng gasien ngön ureueng inoeng geupajôh peunajôh nyan sira geuduek bak kursi, ureueng kaya geu idang peunajôh ban mandum ureueng nyan geupeurasat seura geuseumajôh.
hypothesis: Perbedaan laen jih adalah bahwa seudangkan ureung gasien ngon ureung inong nyan pajoh makanan jih watee jih duek bak kurusi, ureung kaya galak bak banquet bersama di pat awak nyan akan duduk bak sisi awak nyan seudangkan awak nyan pajoh makanan jih.

source: Ancient Roman meals couldn't have included foods that came to Europe from America or from Asia in later centuries.
reference: Peunajoh Romawi jameun hana itamöng keunan nyang trôk u Eropa nibak Amerika atawa nibak Asia bak abad-abad ukeunyan.
hypothesis: Pakan Romawi jameun hanjeut na makanan yang teuka u Eropa dari Amerika atau dari Asia bak abad-abad lheuh nyan.

source: For instance, they didn't have corn, nor tomatoes, nor potatoes, nor cocoa, and no ancient Roman ever tasted a turkey.
reference: Tamsejih, ureueng nyan hana jagông geuh, atawa boh tumat, atawa boh gantang, atawa boh coklat, ngön hana ureueng Romawi jameun geurasa sie manok kalkun.
hypothesis: Miseu jih, awak nyan hana na jagong, atawa tomato, atawa kentang, atawa kakao, dan hana ureung Romawi jameun nyang pernah geu rasa kalkun.

source: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god.
reference: Ureueng Babilonia geupeudöng dewa droe geuh keudroe saboh kuil phon nyang jianggap seubagoe rumoh dewa.
hypothesis: Ureueng Babel geupeudong saboh kuil utama keu ban dum dewa awaknyan nyang dianggap sebagai rumoh dewa nyan.

source: People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals.
