reference: Ureueng geuneuk jôk keureubeuen keu dewa ngön awak peundeta geuuseuha peusep peu nyang peureulee lé dewa röt upacara ngön khanduri rayeuk.
hypothesis: Ureueng akan jiba korban keu dewa-dewa dan teungku-teungku imeum akan mencoba untuk memenuhi kebutuhan dewa-dewa melalui upacara dan festival.

source: Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter.
reference: Tiep-tiep kuil na leun kuil nyang meuhalak ngön lheueh nyan na saboh kuil lam kuil nyan jeuet tamöng keunan peureutei peundeta-peundeta.
hypothesis: Tieb-tieb kuil na le leuen Baét TUHAN nyang teuhah, dan na cit leuen Baét TUHAN nyang teubuka.

source: Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples.
reference: Meujan-jan meunara nyang meubeuntok piramida, nyang ikheun ziggurat, ipeudöng beujeuet keu saboh bagoe nibak candi.
hypothesis: Kadang-kadang menara bentuk piramida khas, yeng dikhen ziggurat, dipeuget untuk jeut keu bagian dari kuil-kuil.

source: The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.
reference: Pucak meunara nakeuh teumpat meusom keu dewajih.
hypothesis: Puncak meunara nyan nakeuh teumpat suci khusus keu dewa nyan.

source: In the warm climate of the Middle East, the house was not so important.
reference: Bak cuwaca seuuem bacut i Timue Teungoeh, rumoh nyan hana that peunténg.
hypothesis: Lam iklim nyang seu-uem di Timur Teunggara, rumoh hana that peunteng.

source: Most of the life of the Hebrew family happened in the open air.
reference: Ladom keuluwarga Ibrani udep i angѐn meuhalak.
hypothesis: Ureueng Ibrani nyan kayém that tinggai di luwa.

source: Women did the cooking in the yard; stores were just open counters looking into the street. Stone was used for building houses.
reference: Ureueng inöng geumaguen i leun; keudѐ nyankeuh pat bayeu teuhah nyang deuh u jalan. Batѐe geungui keu geu peugöt rumoh.
hypothesis: Ureueng inong peugot peunajoh di dalam meuligoe; toko-toko nyan cuma meubeukaih nyang deuh jih u jalan.

source: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so wood was extremely expensive.
reference: Hana uteuen rayeuk i tanoh Kanaan, jadi kayѐe sép meuh’ai.
hypothesis: Di nanggroe Kanaan hana le uteun, nyang kheueh sabab jih kayée ceumara nyan lumpah meuhái.

source: Greenland was settled sparsely. In the Norse sagas they say that Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and when travelling further west, found Greenland and named it Greenland.
reference: Greenland jiduek seucara jareueng-jareueng. Lam hikayat Norse awaknyan jipeugah bahwasajih Erik si Mirah jiböh nibak Islandia sabab seumeupoh, ngön watѐe neujak jiôh-jiôh u barat, neutumee Greenland ngön geupeunan jih Greenland.
hypothesis: Greenland hana le ureung tinggai. lam saga Norse, awak nyan peugah bahwa Erik si Merah geu peucrebre dari Islandia kareuna pembunuhan, dan watee geujak u barat, meurumpok Greenland dan geuboh nan Greenland.

source: But regardless of his discovery, Eskimo tribes were already living there at the time.
reference: Adakpih lheueh nibak geutumee nyan, ureueng Eskimo ka geutinggai hideh bak masa nyan.
hypothesis: Tapi hana peduli penemuan jih, suku Eskimo ka na tinggai di sinan bak masa nyan.

source: Though each country was 'Scandinavian', there were many differences between the people, kings, customs and history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland.
reference: Adakpih tiep nanggroe nyankeuh ‘Skandinavia’ na dum meubeda nibak ureueng, Raja, adat istiadat ngön hikayah Denmark, Swedia, Norwegia ngön Islandia.
hypothesis: Meskipun tiep nanggroe nyan 'skandinavian', na le perbedaan antara rakyat, raja, adat istiadat dan sejarah Denmark, Swedia, Norwegia dan Islandia.

source: If you have watched the movie National Treasure, you may think a treasure map was written on the back of the Declaration of Independence.
reference: Meunyö neukalön filem National Treasure, droeneuh mungken neupikee peuta hareuta karun kalheueh meutuleh i likot Maklumat Meurdheka.
hypothesis: Meunyoe gata ka takalon filem National Treasure, mungken gata pike bahwa di bagian likot Deklarasi Kemerdekaan na saboh peta harta.

source: However, that is not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map.
reference: Beuranggadum, nyan hana beutôi. Adakpih na sipue-pue nyang ituleh i likot naseukah nyan, nyan könsaboh peuta hareuta.
hypothesis: Teuma, nyan hana beutôi, sabab bah pih na nyang teutuléh di likot surat nyan, nyan bukon saboh peta hareuta.

source: Written on the back of the Declaration of Independence were the words "Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776". The text appears on the bottom of the document, upside down.
reference: Nyang ituleh i likôt Maklumat Meurdheka nyankeuh "Maklumat Meurdheka Aseuli tanggai keu-4 buleuen Juli thon 1776". Matan nyan deuh i miyup nibak maklumat nyan, meubalek.
hypothesis: Di bagian likot Deklarasi Kemerdekaan na teutuleh "Deklarasi Kemerdekaan Asli tanggal 4 Juli 1776". Teks nyan deuh bak bagian bawah dokumen, terbalik.

source: While no one knows for certain who wrote it, it is known that early in its life, the large parchment document (it measures 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage.
reference: Sabab hana ureueng nyang tupeue deungön teuntѐe soe nyang tuléh nyan, nyang itupeue nyankeuh watѐe awai udépjih, na saboh keureutah maklumat rayeuk (ukoranjih 29¾ eunci ngön 24½ eunci) nyang igulông keu ikeubah.
hypothesis: Bah pih hana meusidroe pih nyang teupeu deungon pasti soe nyang tuléh nyan, teuma nyang geuturi na kheueh bahwa seugolom nyan, dokumen parchment nyang rayeuk nyan (ukuran jih 293⁄4 inci keu 241⁄2 inci) ji-ulat-ulat keu jipeutamong.

source: So, it is likely that the notation was added simply as a label.
reference: deungön meunan, nyan mungkén cara teumuléh keu peunandajih.
hypothesis: Jadi, mungken notasi nyan geu tambahkan seubeutoi jih seubagoe label.

source: The D-Day landings and the following battles had freed the north of France, but the south still wasn't free.
reference: Uroe trôh ngön prang-prang lheueh nyan ka ipeulheueh Peurancih blah baroh, teutapi blah tunoeng gohlom ipeulheueh.
hypothesis: Pendaratan uroe D dan pertempuran lheuh nyan ka geupeubeubaih utara Prancis, tapi selatan teutap hana beubaih.

source: It was ruled by the "Vichy" French. These were French people who had made peace with the Germans in 1940 and worked with the invaders instead of fighting them.
reference: Nyan ipeurintah Ureueng Peurancih "Vichy". Nyoekeuh Ureueng Peurancih nyang kalheueh meudame deungön Ureueng Jeurman nibak thon 1940 ngön ikeureuja deungön ureueng nyang reubot teuma ibandeng iprang awak nyan.
hypothesis: Nyan geu peumeurintah le "Vichy" Prancis. nyan ureung Prancis nyang ka geupeugot damé ngen Jerman bak thon 1940 dan geubantu peunghasut daripada geulawan awaknyan.

source: On 15 August 1940, the Allies invaded southern France, the invasion was called "Operation Dragoon".
reference: Bak tanggai 15 Agustus 1940, awak sekutu ireubot Peurancih blah tunoeng, hajat nyan ipeunan “Operasi Dragoon”.
hypothesis: Bak 15 Agustus 1940, Sekutu jiseurang Prancis seulatan, invasi nyan geuboh nan "Operasi Dragoon".

source: In just two weeks the Americans and Free French forces had liberated southern France and were turning towards Germany.
reference: Lam watѐe 2 minggu sagai teuntra Amerika ngön Peurancih Meurdheka geupeulheueh Peurancih blah tunong teuma ijak u Jeurman.
hypothesis: Lam padum minggu, Amerika dan pasukan Prancis Bebas ka jipeubeubaih Prancis seulatan dan ka jipileh u Jerman.

source: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.
reference: Saboh peuradaban nyankeuh saboh budaya nyang iweuek nibak saboh kawom ureueng nyang rayeuk nyang itinggai ngön ikeureuja meusajan, saboh masyarakat.
hypothesis: Peradaban adalah budaya tunggal yeng di bagi le kelompok rayek yang signifikan yang udep ngen bekerja secara kooperatif, masyarakat.

source: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning civil, related to the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and that also somehow defines the size of the society.
reference: Tutoe peuradaban nyan asaijih nibak Basa Laten civilis, nyang artijih sipil, meusambong ngön Basa Laten civis, nyang artijih ureueng gampong, ngön civitas, nyang artijih kuta atawa nanggroe-kuta, ngön nyan pih meujan-jan ipeumakna ukoran nibak masyarakat.
hypothesis: Kata peradaban berasal dari bahasa latin civilis, makna sipil, terkait deungen bahasa latin civis, makna warga, ngen civitas, makna kota atau kota-negara, dan nyan cit deungen cara tertentu meudefinisikan ukuran masyarakat.

source: City-states are the precursors of nations. A civilizational culture implies the passing on of knowledge across several generations, a lingering cultural footprint and fair dissemination.
reference: Nanggroe-kuta nyankeuh nyang puphon nanggroe-nanggroe. Saboh budaya peuradaban nyan peutunyok rot keu ipeutroen illeumee keu padum-padum boh masa, saboh euncit budaya nyang han gadoh ngön meusipreuk deungön ade.
hypothesis: Negara kota adalah pendahulu bangsa. budaya peradaban menyiratkan pengamatan pengetahuan di beberapa generasi, jejak budaya yang berlanjut dan penyebaran yang adil.

source: Minor cultures often vanish without leaving relevant historic evidence and fail to be recognized as proper civilizations.
reference: Budaya nyang ubeut nyan kayem gadoh deungön han ipeutinggai tanda seujarah nyang na ngön nyan han jeuet ikheun seubagoe peuradaban nyang patot.
hypothesis: Budaya-budaya ubit seureng that lenyap tanpa meutubiet bukti seujarah nyang relevan dan hana ji akui seubagai peradaban nyang beutoi.

source: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation.
reference: Seulama Prang Revolusi, lhee blah nanggroe bahgian phon that geupeugoet pomeurentah pusat nyang leumoh-deungön Koengres seubagoe saboh-sabohjih komponen- imiyup Anggaran Koenfederasi.
hypothesis: Seulama Perang Revolusi, lhee blah nangroe phon that geu bentuk pemerintah pusat yang leumoh  deungon Kongres seubagoe komponen yang seubeuna jih  di bawah Pasal Konfederasi.

source: Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts.
reference: Koengres kön poe teunaga neuk peukeunong pajak, ngön, sabab hana eksekutif atawa yudikatif nasional, nyan meunurot bak otoritas nanggroe, nyang kayem that hana koorperatif, neuk peuteugak mandum buet.
hypothesis: Kongres hana meukuasa untuk geupeutamong pajak, dan, kareuna hana eksekutif nasional atau kehakiman, nyan meugantung bak otoritas negara bagian, yeng seureng hana kooperatif, untuk geu peuget mandum tindakan jih.

source: It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states.
reference: Nyan pih kön poe keurajeuen neuk peusiblah qanun-qanun pajak ngön engkoeh nibak nanggroe bahgian.
hypothesis: Jih cit hana hak untuk meupeubate hukum pajak ngen tarif antara negara bagian.

source: The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.
reference: Pasai-pasai nyan peureule saboh kheun nibak mandum nanggroe bahgian seugolom jeuet geu ubah ngön nanggroe bahgian geuanggap hina pomeurentah pusat sampoe wakie awak nyan kayem that hana deuh.
hypothesis: Artikel nyan peurle persetujuan unanimous dari mandum negara bagian seugolom jeut ji peubah dan negara bagian ji anggap pemerintah pusat seucara hanjeut that bahwa perwakilan awak nyan seureng hana hadir.

source: Italy's national football, along with German national football team is the second most successful team in the world and were the FIFA World Cup champions in 2006.
reference: Sipak bhan nasional Italia, sajan deungön keulompok sipak bhan nasional Jeurman na keuh keulompok paléng meuhase keuduwa i donya ngön nyan keuh juara Piala Donya FIFA nibak thon 2006.
hypothesis: Tim nasional bola sepak Italia, meusigoe ngon tim nasional bola sepak Jerman nakeuh tim nyang keudua paleng meuhase di donya ngon jeut keu juara Piala Dunia FIFA bak thon 2006.

source: Popular sports include football, basketball, volleyball, water-polo, fencing, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, roller hockey and F1 motor racing.
reference: Ulahraga meusyeuhue itamoeng keuh sipak bhan, bola basket, bola poli, polo ie, angga, rugby, weng itangen, hoki eh, hoki roller, ngön balap moto F1.
hypothesis: Olahraga populer termasuk bola sepak, bola basket, bola voli, polo air, jeumeulah, rugbi, bersepeda, hoki es, hoki roller dan balap motor F1.

source: Winter sports are most popular in the Northern regions, with Italians competing in international games and Olympic events.
reference: Ulahraga musem leupie paléng meusyuhue i wilayah Utara, deungön ureueng Italia meulomba lam tandeng internasional ngön acara Olimpiade.
hypothesis: Olahraga musem nyan paleng populer di daerah utara, deungen ureung Italia yang meupeuran dalam permainan internasional dan acara Olimpiade.

source: Japans holds nearly 7,000 islands (the biggest being Honshu), making Japan the 7th largest island in the world!
reference: Jeupang geumat karap 7.000 pulo (paléng rayeuk nakeuh Honshu), peugoet Jepang jeuet pulo rayeuk keu 7 bak donya!
hypothesis: Jepang na kira-kira 7.000 pulo (paling rayek jih nakeuh Honshu), nyang peuget Jepang jeut keu pulo keu-7 rayek di donya!

source: Due to the cluster/group of islands Japan has, Japan is often referred to, on a geographical stance, as an "archipelago"
reference: Kareuna klaster/keulompok nibak pulo Jepang, Jepang kayem dipeugah, bak posisi geografis, sebagoe "kepuloan"
hypothesis: Kareuna keulompok pulau Jepang, Jepang seureng dikhen, dari posisi geografis, seubagai "arsipel"

source: Taiwan beginning start way back in 15th century where European sailors passing by record the island’s name as Ilha Formosa, or beautiful island.
reference: Taiwan pu phon jak teuma bak abad keu 15 dipat ureueng meulaôt Eropa roet geutuleh nan pulo nyan sebagoe Ilha Formosa, atawa pulo lagak.
hypothesis: Taiwan dimulai bak abad keu-15 watee peuneurah Eropa yang lewat di sinan geu catat nan pulo nyan seubagoe Ilha Formosa, atawa pulo nyang indah.

source: In 1624,Dutch East India Company establishes a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating a transformation in aboriginal grain production practices and employing Chinese laborers to work on its rice and sugar plantations.
reference: Bak thon 1624, Kanto India Timu Beulanda peudong basis bak Taiwan Baratdaya, pu phon transformasi lam meuhase bijeh-bijeh aseuli ngön geujok buet kuli Cina keu keureuja bak blang ngön lampoh saka.
hypothesis: Bak thon 1624, Dutch East India Company dipeudeng pangkalan di barat daya Taiwan, dipeuphon transformasi dalam praktek produksi gandum asli ngen dipeugöt buruh Cina untuk bekerja di perkebunan beras dan gula.

source: In 1683, Qing dynasty (1644-1912) forces take control of Taiwan’s western and northern coastal areas and declared Taiwan as a province of the Qing Empire in 1885.
reference: Bak thon 1683, pasukan Dinasti Qing (1644-1912) geumat kuasa wilayah bineh barat ngön utara Taiwan ngön deklarasi Taiwan sebagoe propinsi poemeurintah Qing bak thon 1885.
hypothesis: Bak thon 1683, pasukan dinasti Qing (1644-1912) geu kontrol wilayah pantai barat ngon utara Taiwan ngon geu deklarasi Taiwan seubagoe propinsi Keukaisaran Qing bak thon 1885.

source: In 1895, after defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signs the Treaty of Shimonoseki, by which it cedes sovereignty over Taiwan to Japan, which rules the island until 1945.
reference: Bak thon 1895, oh lheueh taloe lam Prang Sino-Jeupang Phon (1894-1895), pomeurentah Qing geuteken peurjanjian Shimonoseki, nyang toh dijok keudaulatan ateueh Taiwan u Jeupang, nyang mat poemerentah sampoe 1945.
hypothesis: Bak thon 1895, lheuh kalah lam Prang Sino-Jepang phon (1894-1895), pemerintah Qing geu teken Perjanjian Shimonoseki, deungen nyan ji peu lom keukuasaan ateueh Taiwan keu Jepang, nyang ji peurintah pulo nyan sampoe thon 1945.

source: Machu Picchu consist of three main structures, namely Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Room of the Three Windows.
reference: Machu Picchu nyan na lhee boh geudong, nyang geukheun Intihuatana, Kuil Mata Uroe, ngön Kama Lhee Boh Tingkeup.
hypothesis: Machu Picchu terdiri dari lhee struktur utama, yaitu Intihuatana, Kuil Mata Uroe, ngen Ruang Lhee Tingkap.

source: Most of the buildings on the edges of the complex have been rebuilt in order to give tourists a better idea of how they originally appeared.
reference: Le nibak geudoeng nyang na ibineh peurumahan ka i peudoeng keu duwa goe ngön makeusud keu geubie keu jamee saboh peumandangan nyang leubeh beutôi pakriban hi geudoeng nyoe nyang seubeutôijih.
hypothesis: Sebagian rayek bangunan di sagoe kompleks ka geupeugot lom mangat jeut keu peunumpang jeut keu ide nyang leubeh get tentang penampilan awai jih.

source: By 1976, thirty percent of Machu Picchu had been restored and restoration continues till today.
reference: Lam thon 1976, lhee persen dari Machu Picchu ka ipeugoet lom ngön buet pueget nyoe mantoeng jipubuet sampoe uroenyo.
hypothesis: Bak thon 1976, lhee ploh persen dari Machu Picchu ka dipulihkan dan restorasi nyan manteng berlanjut sampoe uroe nyoe.

source: For example, the most common still image photography format in the world is 35mm, which was the dominant film size at the close of the analog film era.
reference: Tamseejih, ukoe gamba foto teudoeng nyan paléng ladem lam donya nakeuh 35mm, nyan keuh ukoe pilem nyang paléng le nyang toe ngön masa pilem analog.
hypothesis: Miseu jih, format foto gambar teutap yang paleng umum di donya adalah 35mm, yeng merupakan ukuran pilem dominan bak akhe era pilem analog.

source: It is still produced today, but more importantly its aspect ratio has been inherited by digital camera image sensor formats.
reference: Nyoe mantoeng dipeuna sampoe ino hat, tapi nyang leubeh peunténg aspek rasiojih nyang ka dipeuwareh lam ukoe sensor gamba nibak kamera digital.
hypothesis: jih manteng di peuget uroe nyoe, teutapi leubeh peunteng rasio aspek jih ka diwareh le format sensor gambar kamera digital.

source: The 35mm format is actually, somewhat confusingly, 36mm in width by 24mm in height.
reference: Ukoe 35mm nyan seubeutôijih, nyang mumangjih, 36mm lam panyang meusampeng ngön 24mm manyang.
hypothesis: Format 35mm nyan seucara yang agak membingungkan, 36mm luwah 24mm manyang.

source: The aspect ratio of this format (dividing by twelve to obtain the simplest whole-number ratio) is therefore said to be 3:2.
reference: Aspek rasio lam ukoe nyoe (nyang jibagi lam duwablah keu tatumee dum-numboi rasi nyang paléng biyasa) nakeuh dikheun 3:2.
hypothesis: Rasio aspek format nyo (pembagian deungen dua blah untuk meumiliki rasio bilangan bulat yeng paleng sederhana) karena nyan dikheun 3:2.

source: Many common formats (APS family of formats, for example) are equal to or closely approximate this aspect ratio.
reference: Jai format nyan biyasa (keuluwarga APS keu format, keu tamsee) nyan seubandeng atawa leubeh toe keunira u aspek rasio nyo.
hypothesis: Le format umum (misal jih keluarga format APS) sama atau seucara rapet ngen rasio aspek nyo.

source: The much-abused and often-ridiculed rule of thirds is a simple guideline creating dynamism while keeping a measure of order in an image.
reference: Hukom keulhee nyang paléng jai dipeureuloh ngön nyang paléng jai dikheun keu brok nakeuh saboh peutunyok nyang biyasa keu peuna peurobahan oh watѐe peuteutap ukoe nyang meujalen lam saboeh gamba.
hypothesis: Aturan pertiga yang that di peubrok dan seureng jih di peuhina adalah pedoman sederhana yang geu peuget dinamisme seumentara geukeubah saboh ukuran tatanan dalam saboh gamba.

source: It states that the most effective place for the main subject is at the intersection of lines dividing the image into thirds vertically and horizontally (see example).
reference: Nyoe jipeugah bahwasajih teumpat nyang paléng jroeh keu beunda nyang phon nakeuh bak simpang nibak meubagoe gareh nyang bagi gamba lam keulhee gareh linteueng ateueh ngön meusampeng (neukalon tamsee).
hypothesis: Nyo dipeugah bahwa teumpat paleng efektif untuk subjek utama adalah di simpang gareh yeng meubagi gambar jeut keu pertiga secara vertikal ngen horizontal (lihat contoh).

source: During this period of European history, the Catholic Church, which had become rich and powerful, came under scrutiny.
reference: Seulama periode seujarah Eropa nyoe, Geureja Katolik, nyang ka kaya ngon meukuasa, meuteumeung sorotan.
hypothesis: Bak masa nyan, Gereja Katolik ka kaya dan meukuasa, dan nyan kheueh nyang teupeuteuka keusosahan nyang paleng rayeuk di Eropa.

source: For over a thousand years the Christian religion had bound European states together despite differences in language and customs. I
reference: Seulama leubeh dari siribee thon agama Kristen ka lheueh meuikat nanggroe-nanggroe Eropa mandum adak pih na meubeda basa ngon adat istiadat. Lon
hypothesis: Seulama leubeh dari siribée thon agama Kristen ka meucatat bansa-bansa Eropa meskipun na perbedaan bahasa ngon adat istiadat.

source: Its all-pervading power affected everyone from king to commoner.
reference: Kuasajih nyang meucakop sigalajih ipeungaroh mandum ureueng dari raja sampoe rakyat jeulata.
hypothesis: Kuasa jih nyang meucareh meupeungaroh mandum, dari raja sampoe rakyat biasa.

source: One of the main Christian tenets is that wealth should be used to alleviate suffering and poverty and that the monetary funds of the church are there specifically for that reason.
reference: Salah saboh peurinsep utama Kristen nakeuh bahwa keukayaan haroh jingui keu peukureueng deurita ngon kemisikinan ngon bahwa peng moneter geureja na khusus keu alasan nyan.
hypothesis: Salah saboh ajaran Kristen nyang phon adalah bahwa keukayaan nyan harôh jipeuguna keu peuseuleusoe peundeuritaan ngon gasien dan bahwa dana-dana keu gereja nyan na lam donya nyoe khusus keu alasan nyan.

source: The central authority of the church had been in Rome for over a thousand years and this concentration of power and money led many to question whether this tenet was being met.
reference: Otoritas pusat geureja kalheueh na di Roma seulama leubeh dari siribee thon ngon pemusatan kekuasaan ngon peng nyoe jipeuget le ureng teumanyong peu peurinsep nyoe teupeunuhi.
hypothesis: Otoritas pusat gereja na di Roma seulama leubeh dari siribée thon dan konsentrasi kekuasaan dan uang nyo geu peuget le ureung keu ragu peu kheueh prinsip nyo ka dipeuteupat.

source: Soon after the outbreak of hostilities, Britain initiated a naval blockade of Germany.
reference: Hana trep oh leuh bicah prangnyan, ureueng Britania ggeupuphon peutheun rauh i laôt keu ureueng Jeurman.
hypothesis: Hana treb le lheuh nyan, Britania geupeuphon bloe peutahanan lam kapai prang Jerman.

source: The strategy proved effective, cutting off vital military and civilian supplies, although this blockade violated generally accepted international law codified by several international agreements of the past two centuries.
reference: Reuncana nyan beutôi keu jeuet meuhase, nyan jipeuputoh peukakah keu ureueng militer ngön masyarakat, adakpi peutheun rauh nyoe meulanggeh ngön hukom Donya nyang ka geuteurimong le mandum nyang dipeugöt le ladom nyang meusaboh pakat duwa reutoh thon nyang ka ulikot.
hypothesis: Strategi nyan terbukti efektif, dipeuputoh pasokan militer dan sipil nyang peunteng, meskipun blokade nyoe melanggar hukum internasional nyang umum jih diakui dan dikodifikasi le perjanjian internasional dua abad nyang ka u likot.

source: Britain mined international waters to prevent any ships from entering entire sections of ocean, causing danger to even neutral ships.
reference: Ureueng Britain geujaga wilayah laôt le bansa keu peutheun mandum kapai nak bek jeuet jitamoeng lam wilayah laôt nyang dumpat na, nyan jeuet keu sabab ceulaka bahpih kapai biyasa.
hypothesis: Inggreh dipeugöt ranto darat di laot internasional keu peugadoh kapai-kapai nyang geutamong u laot nyan, nyang jeut keu bahaya keu kapai-kapai nyang hana meupihak.

source: Since there was limited response to this tactic, Germany expected a similar response to its unrestricted submarine warfare.
reference: Nibak phon nyoe dit nyang na jipakoe keu reuncana nyoe, ureueng Jeurman geupreh saboh reuncana nyang rap saban u kapai seulam prang ureueng nyan nyang bibeuh.
hypothesis: Kareuna na tanggapan nyang terbatas bak taktik nyo, Jerman geu harapkan tanggapan yang sama keu perang kapal selam yang hana dibatasi.

source: During the 1920s, the prevailing attitudes of most citizens and nations was that of pacifism and isolation.
reference: Oh thon 1920an, peukateun nyang paléng deuh lam dum masyarakat ngön bansa-bansa nakeuh pileh keu dame ngön udep peuaseng droe.
hypothesis: Seulama 1920-an, sikap nyang meukuasa nibak seubagian rayek rakyat dan bansa adalah bahwa pasifisme dan isolasi.

source: After seeing the horrors and atrocities of war during World War I, nations desired to avoid such a situation again in the future.
reference: Aleuh guekalon peumandangan nyang yo ngön zalem nibak prang lam masa prang donya I, bansa-bansa ka geugesee keu peutheun keudaan lagѐe nyan lam watѐe nyang ukeu.
hypothesis: Óh ka lheueh jikalon keujadian nyang keujam dan keujam nyang teujadi seulama Perang Donya I, bansa-bansa nyan meuheut mangat hai nyang lagée nyan bék teujadi lom bak masa ukeue.

source: In 1884, Tesla moved to the United States of America to accept a job with the Edison Company in New York City.
reference: Lam thon 1884, Tesla geuminah u Amerika keu geuteurimong saboh buet nibak kilang Edison di Kuta New York.
hypothesis: Bak thon 1884, Tesla geuek u Amerika Serikat keu geutem jak keureuja bak Perusahaan Edison di New York City.

source: He arrived in the US with 4 cents to his name, a book of poetry, and a letter of recommendation from Charles Batchelor (his manager in his previous job) to Thomas Edison.
reference: Gobnyan teuka i Amerika ngön 4 sen peng ateueh nan gobnyan, saboh buku puisi, ngön saboh surat rekom nibak Charles Batchelor (manajer gobnyan nibak buet awai geuh) u Thomas Edison.
hypothesis: Jih trok u Amerika Serikat deungen 4 sen keu nan jih, saboh buku puisi, ngen surat rekomendasi dari Charles Batchelor (manajer jih bak pekerjaan awai jih) keu Thomas Edison.

source: Ancient China had a unique way of showing different time periods; each stage of China or each family that was in power was a distinctive dynasty.
reference: Cina masa jameun na saboh cara nyang khas keu peuleumah masa nyang meubeda; tiep masa nibak Cina atawa tiap keuluwarga nyang teungoh lam kuwasa nakeuh lam dinasti nyang jioh meupisah.
hypothesis: Cina jameun na cara unik untuk peuleumah periode watee yang berbeda; tiep tahap China atau tiep keluarga yang na kuasa adalah dinasti khas.

source: Also between each dynasty was an unstable age of divided provinces. The best-known of these periods was the Three Kingdoms epoch taking place for 60 years between the Han and the Jin Dynasty.
reference: Nacit meuhapit lam tiep dinasti nyan saboh masa nyang hana timang ngön daerah-daerah nyang meupisah-pisah. Hai nyang paléng jituri lam masa nyoe nakeuh masa Lhee Boh Keurajen nyang na lam masa 60 thon meuhapit lam masa Han ngön masa Dinasti Jin.
hypothesis: Di antara setiap dinasti na masa yang hana stabil dari provinsi yang dibagi. yang paleng terkenal dari periode nyoe adalah masa Tiga Kerajaan yang berlangsung selama 60 thon antara Dinasti Han dan Jin.

source: During these periods fierce warfare took place between many nobles fighting for the throne.
reference: Lam watѐe masa nyoe prang nyang rayeuk nibak ramee ampon nyang geumeulhoe sabe keudro-droe keu mita teumpat duek keu raja.
hypothesis: Seulama periode nyo terjadi perang sengit antara le bangsawan yang meuprang untuk takhta.

source: The Three Kingdoms was one of the bloodiest eras in Ancient China’s history thousands of people died fighting to sit in the highest seat in the grand palace at Xi’an.
reference: Lhee Boh Keurajen nyan nakeuh saboh masa nyang paléng lee roe darah lam seujarah Cina Jameun meuribee droe ureueng matee keu mita teumpat duek lam teumpat duek paléng manyang lam meuligoe rayeuk I Xi’an.
hypothesis: Lhee Keurajaan nyan salah saboh masa nyang paleng meurajah lam seujarah Cina Kuno. Meuribée-ribée droe ureueng meuninggai lam perjuangan keu geuduek di kurusi paleng manyang di meuligoe rayek di Xi'an.

source: There are a lot of social and political effects such as the use of metric system, a shift from absolutism to republicanism, nationalism and the belief the country belongs to the people not to one sole ruler.
reference: Disinan le akibat sosial ngön politek lage lam geu ngui keu cara ukoe-meuukoe, meubah cara nibak seumike cara mutlak keu republik, peurasaan meubansa ngön pateh keu nanggroe nyang poejih nakeuh masyarakat ngön kon sidroe ureueng seubagoe nyang mat kuwasa.
hypothesis: Na le efek sosial dan politik lage penggunaan sistem metrik, pergeseran dari absolutisme keu republikanisme, nasionalisme dan keyakinan bahwa nanggroe nyan milik rakyat dan bukon keu sidroe penguasa.

source: Also after the Revolution occupations were open to all male applicants allowing the most ambitious and successful to succeed.
reference: Nacit oh leuh revolusi buet ube na ka jipuetaba u mandum ureueng agam nyang peureulee keu buet nyoe jipeuhah saboh luweng u tiep ureueung nyan paléng na meuheut ngön nyang paléng meuwasee keu leubeh meuwasee lom.
hypothesis: Meunan cit lheuh Revolusi, pekerjaan nyan teubuka keu mandum peuneunjang agam yang memungkinkan yang paleng ambisius dan sukses untuk berhasil.

source: Same goes for the military because instead of army rankings being based on class they were now based on cailaber.
reference: Sabancit na bak militer sabab nibak phon pangkat lam militer nyan jipeusadeu bak glah jino atranyan ka jipeusadeu bak soe nyang na teuleubeh.
hypothesis: Meunan cit keu militer karena dari pangkat militer yang berorientasi ke kelas, awak nyan jinoe berorientasi ke cailaber.

source: The French Revolution also inspired many other repressed working class people of other country's to began their own revolutions.
reference: Revolusi Peurancih nyan na cit jibie inspirasi keu rame ureueng nyan udep lam buet nyang hek lam nanggroe luwa keu ureueng nyan geupeugöt revolusi cit.
hypothesis: Revolusi Prancis cit geu inspirasi le ureung kelas pekerja yang tertekan di nanggroe laen untuk memulai revolusi awak nyan keudroe.

source: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation.
reference: Muhammad nyang leubeuh meuheut geuh nibak hai-hai nyang di luwa udep nyang biyasa nyoe. Gobnyan kayem geuh lam guha nyang dudoe dituri deungön guha “Hira” di ateueh gunong “Nur” (cahya) keu teumpat meukalut.
hypothesis: Muhammad that tertarik keu hai-hai nyang lubeh nibak kehidupan donya nyoe. jih biasa jak bak saboh guha yang ka jeut keu terkenal seubagoe Hira di Gunong Noor (peungeuh) untuk merenung.

source: he cave itself, which survived the times, gives a very vivid image of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations.
reference: Gobnyan geudom lam guha, nyang gobnyan jeuetudep keu lam ladom watѐe, nyang bi gamba nyang jeulaih keu Muhammad neuk toe ngön roh.
hypothesis: guha nyan keudroe, nyang na di masa nyan, geubri gambaran nyang that nyata tentang kecenderungan rohani Muhammad.

source: Resting on the top of one of the mountains north of Mecca, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world.
reference: Geuduek di ateueh saboh nibak bak gunong lam wilayah utara Mekah, guha nyan keubit meupisah nibak donya luwa.
hypothesis: Meureuhat bak puncak saboh gunong di utara Mekah, guha nyan sama sekali terisolasi dari donya.

source: In fact, it is not easy to find at all even if one knew it existed. Once inside the cave, it is a total isolation.
reference: Nyatajih, nyoe hana mudah keu tateume adakpi meunyö sidroe ureueng jituepue na guha nyan, guha nyoe keubit meupisah.
hypothesis: Bahkan, hana mudah keu meurumpok bahkan jika sidroe ureung teungeut bahwa nyan na.

source: Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.
reference: Hana meusapue nyang deuh seulaén langet nyang gleh, ceudah di ateueh ngön le gunong meulingka. Bacut hai nyang jeuet takalon ngön tadeungoe nibak dalam guha nyoe.
hypothesis: Hana sapeue nyang jeut deuh seulaen langet nyang jeureunéh ngon indah di ateuh dan le gunong-gunong nyang na di seukeulileng nyan.

source: The Great Pyramid at Giza is the only one of the seven wonders that is still standing today.
reference: Piramida Raya i Giza nyankeuh saboh sagai nibak tujoh hai-hai nyang peugöt hireuen nyang mantong didong uroe nyoe.
hypothesis: Piramida rayek di Giza adalah saboh-saboh jih dari tujoh keajaiban nyang manteng teudong sampoe jinoe.

source: Built by the Egyptians in the third century BCE, the Great Pyramid is one of many large pyramid structures built to honor dead Pharaoh.
reference: Dipeudong le Ureueng Meuseee bak abad keu lhee BCE, Piramida Raya nyankeuh saboh nibak jai geudoeng piramida nyang dipeugöt keu jitabek Firaun nyang ka mate.
hypothesis: Piramida rayek nyan dipeuget le ureung Mesir bak abad keu-3 SM, nyan salah saboh dari le struktur piramida rayek yang dipeuget keu menghormati Firaun nyang ka meuninggai.

source: The Giza Plateau, or "Giza Necropolis" in the Egyptian Valley of the Dead contains several pyramids (of which the great pyramid is the largest), several small tombs, several temples, and the great Sphinx.
reference: Tanoh Manyang Giza, atawa "Lampoh Jeurat Giza" bak Panton Mate Ureueng Meuse nyan na padum boh piramida (teuma piramida raya nyan nyankeuh nyang paléng raya), padum boh jeurat ubeut, padum boh teumpat keuramat, ngön Sphinx nyang raya.
hypothesis: Dataran Tinggi Giza, atau "Necropolis Giza" di Lembah Mati Mesir na padum boh piramida (di antaranya piramida rayek adalah yang paleng rayek), padum boh makam ubit, padum boh kuil, ngen Sphinx rayek.

source: The great pyramid was created to honor the Pharaoh Khufu, and many of the smaller pyramids, tombs, and temples were built to honor Khufu's wives and family members.
reference: Piramida raya nyan dipeugöt keu dihoreumat Firaun Khufu, ngön jai piramida-piramida nyang leubeh ubeut, jeurat-jeurat, ngön teumpat-teumpat keuramat nyang dipeugöt keu dihoreumat peurumoh Khufu ngön anggota wali karongjih.
hypothesis: Piramida rayek dipeuget keu menghormati Firaun Khufu, ngen le piramida, kuburan, ngen kuil yeng lubeh ubit dipeuget keu menghormati peurumoh ngon anggota keluarga Khufu.

source: The "up bow" mark looks like a V and the "down bow mark" like a staple or a square missing its bottom side.
reference: Tanda "panah ateueh" deuh lagѐe saboh V ngön "tanda panah yup" lagѐe saboh krak atawa balok nyang gadoh gareh yupjih.
hypothesis: Tanda "up bow" deuh jih lage V ngen "down bow mark" lage saboh staple atau persegi yang hana sisi bawah jih.

source: Up means you should start at the tip and push the bow, and down means you should start at the frog (which is where your hand is holding the bow) and pull the bow.
reference: Ateueh meukeusudjih gata suwah puphon bak pucok ngön teugon panahjih, ngön yup meukeuseudjih gata suwah puphon bak kot (teumpat nibak jaroe gata meumat panah) ngön meutarek panah.
hypothesis: Uju meuarti awak harus mulai bak ujong ngen menek busur, ngen ubawah meuarti awak harus mulai bak katak (yang adalah tempat jaroe awak memegang busur) ngen menarik busur.

source: An up-bow usually generates a softer sound, while a down-bow is stronger and more assertive.
reference: Panah ateueh biasajih peugöt su yang leubeh halôh, teuma panah yup nyankeuh leubeh teuga ngön leubeh kreueh.
hypothesis: Seudangkan su nyang ji-up-bow biasa jih leubeh leumoh, seudangkan su nyang ji-down-bow leubeh teuga dan leubeh teuga.

source: Feel free to pencil in your own marks, but remember the printed bowing marks are there for a musical reason, so they should usually be respected.
reference: Bek chok keu neu top bak tanda droe, tapi neuingat tanda meucetak nyang bungkok nyan na hideh keu sabab musik, teuma awak nyan biasajih suwah ditabek.
hypothesis: Seudeh that keu tapeutamong tanda droe teuh, tapi ingat tanda sujud nyang teutameng na alasan musik, jadi jih harus dipeuteupat.

source: The terrified King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette their two young children (11 year old Marie Therese and four year old Louis-Charles) and the King's sister, Madam Elizabeth, on the 6th October 1789 were forced back to Paris from Versailles by a mob of market women.
reference: Raja Louis XVI nyang teumakot, Ratu Marie Antoinette, duwa boh sinyak awak nyan nyang mantoeng ubeut (Marie Therese nyang 11 thon umu ngön Louis-Charles nyang peut thon umu) ngön syehdara inoeng Raja nyan, tuan Putroe Elizabeth, bak tanggai 6 Oktober 1789 geupaksa lom u Paris nibak Versailles lé saboh kawan ureueng inoeng pasai.
hypothesis: Raja Louis XVI, Ratu Marie Antoinette, dua droe aneuk agam jih (Marie Therese nyang umu 11 thon ngon Louis-Charles nyang umu 4 thon) dan syedara inong raja nyan, Madame Elizabeth, bak 6 Oktober 1789 dipaksa pulang u Paris dari Versailles le saboh kawan inong pasai.

source: In a carriage, they traveled back to Paris surrounded by a mob of people screaming and shouting threats against the King and Queen.
reference: Bak geurbong, awaknyan ijak lom u Paris ikeulileng le keulompok ureueng nyang geukrie-krie ngön geusurak geu ancam Raja ngön Ratu.
hypothesis: Dalam saboh gerbong, awak nyan geuwoe u Paris dikeue le ureung yang geudumpek dan geucarong ancaman terhadap Raja dan Ratu.

source: The mob of people forced the King And Queen to have their carriage windows wide open.
reference: Kawan awaknyan ureueng ipaksa Raja ngön Ratu keu geupeuhah tingkap beurayeuk.
hypothesis: Ureueng ramé nyan dipaksa Raja dan Ratu untuk jipeuhah tingkap geuritan awaknyan.

source: At one point a member of the mob waved the head of a royal guard killed at Versailles in front of the terrified Queen.
reference: Bak saboh titek, sidroe anggouta ureueng ramee geudada ulee aneuk buah keurajaan nyang ka ipoeh i Versailles ikeu Ratu nyang geusuen.
hypothesis: Bak saboh teumpat, sidroe anggota dari geng nyan jibeuôt-beuôt ulée sidroe peungawai raja nyang ka jipoh maté di Versailles dikeue Ratu nyang ka teumakot nyan.

source: The war expenditures of U.S. imperialism in the conquest of the Philippines were paid for by the Filipino people themselves.
reference: Ipeutubiet prang Imperialisme AS lam prang Filipina ibayeu le Filipina ureueng nyan keudroe.
hypothesis: Pengeluaran prang imperialisme Amerika Serikat dalam penaklukan Filipina di bayeu le rakyat Filipina keudroe.

source: They were compelled to pay taxes to the U.S. colonial regime to defray a major part of the expenditures and the interest on bonds floated in the name of the Philippine government through the Wall Street banking houses.
reference: Awaknyan teupaksa ibayeu pajak bak razem colonial AS keu ibayeu ladom peng tubiet ngön bungoeng ipeuwajeb i layang ateueh nan pomeurentah Filipina roet rumoh peurbankan Wall Street.
hypothesis: Awak nyan dipaksa untuk meu bayar pajak keu rezim kolonial Amerika Serikat untuk meu tanggong sebagian rayek dari pengeluaran dan bunga atas obligasi yang meulangkah dalam nama pemerintah Filipina melalui bank-bank Wall Street.

source: Of course, the superprofits derived from the protracted exploitation of the Filipino people would constitute the basic gains of U.S. imperialism.
reference: Nyan teuntee, laba rayeuk nyang geutumee nibak trep-trep eksploitasi keu ureueng Filipina nyankeuh laba asai Imperialisme AS.
hypothesis: Teutapi, keuntungan yang luar biasa dari eksploitasi rakyat Filipina yang berkepanjangan akan merupakan keuntungan dasar imperialisme AS.

source: To understand the Templars one must understand the context that prompted the creation of the order.
reference: Keu tameuphom Templar, sidro-droe ureueng suwah geu meuphom pue nyang meudali nyang ipoek jeuet saboh atoeran.
hypothesis: Untuk meuphom Templar, ureung nyan harus meuphom konteks yang geu peuget orde nyan.

source: The age where the events took place is commonly referred as the High Middle Ages the period of European history in the 11th, 12th, and 13th centuries (AD 1000–1300).
reference: Bak jameun dipat keujadian nyan biyasa geukheun sebagoe Abad Peurteungahan Manyang, masa seujarah Eropa bak abad keu 11, 12, ngön 13 (1000-1300 M).
hypothesis: Zaman di pat peristiwa nyan terjadi biasa jih dikhen sebagai Abad Pertengahan Tinggi periode sejarah Eropa bak abad keu 11, 12, ngen 13 (AD 10001300).

source: The High Middle Ages were preceded by the Early Middle Ages and followed by the Late Middle Ages, which by convention ends around 1500.
reference: Abad Peurteungahan Manyang ipuphon bak awai Abad Peurteungahan ngön iseutöt le Abad Peurteungahan Akhee, nyang meunurot konveksi seuleusoe sangkira thon 1500.
hypothesis: Abad Pertengahan Tinggi di awai le Abad Pertengahan Awal ngen di ikot le Abad Pertengahan Akhir, yeng deungen konvensi berakhir sekitar 1500.

source: Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology.
reference: Determinisme teknologi nakeuh istilah nyang mencakup meubagoe ide lam praktek, dari dorongan teknologi atawa keharusan teknologi trôh ban hareutoe nyang ketat bahwa teukeudi manusia idorong lé logika dasar nyang teuhubông deungön hukôm ilmiah ngön manifestasijih lam teknologi.
hypothesis: Determinisme teknologi adalah istilah yeng mencakup berbagai gagasan dalam praktek, dari dorongan teknologi atau imperatif teknologi sampoe arti ketat bahwa nasib manusia didorong le logika mendasar yeng meuhubungan deungen hukom ilmiah ngen manifestasi awak nyan dalam teknologi.

source: Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has "effects" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned.
reference: Sebagian rayek interpretasi determinisme teknologi teubagi u lam dua gagasan umum: nyang phôn, bahwa perkembangan teknologi nyan geuikôt jalan nyang sebagian rayek na di luwa pengarôh budaya atawa puliték. Ngön kedua, bahwa teknologi nibak giliranjih na "efek" nibak masyarakat nyang melekat secara sosial.
hypothesis: Sebagian rayek interpretasi determinisme teknologi meubagi dua ide umum: bahwa pengembangan teknologi nyan keudroe meuturot jalan yang lubeh rayek di lua pengaruh budaya atau politik, dan bahwa teknologi nyan bak giliran jih na "peungaroh" bak masyarakat yang inheren, daripada dikondisikan secara sosial.

source: For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads.
reference: Keu contoh, ladom peugah bahwa kendaraan bermotor pasti mengarah nibak perkembangan jalan raya.
hypothesis: Miseu jih, sidroe jeut jipeugah bahwa mobil motor pasti meupeulaku keu pengembangan jalan.

source: However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership.
reference: Tapi, jaringan jalan nasional h'an layak secara ekonomi hanya keu padum boh moto, jadi metode produksi barô ipeukeumang keu peukureueng biaya po moto.
hypothesis: Namun, jaringan jalan nasional hana layak secara ekonomi untuk hanya seujumlah saboh-saboh mobil, jadi metode produksi baro dikembangkan untuk mengurangi biaya kepemilikan mobil.

source: Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies.
reference: Kepemilikan moto massal pih jeut keu seubab leubéh le insiden kecelakaan di jalan, nyang meuarah nibak teuneumèe teknik barô lam perawatan kesehatan keu peugöt tubôh nyang reulöh.
hypothesis: Keuragaman mobil secara massal cit meupeulaku bak inciden nyang leubeh rayek nibak kecelakaan di jalan, nyang meupeulaku bak penemuan teknik baro dalam perawatan kesehatan untuk meupeugadeh awak nyang rusak.

source: Romanticism had a large element of cultural determinism, drawn from writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel.
reference: Romantisisme nakeuh peungaroh rayeuk bak determinisme budaya, nyang geucok le ureueng tuleh lagѐe Gothe, Fichte, ngön Schlegel.
hypothesis: Romantikisme na elemen rayeuk determinisme budaya, yang ditarik dari penulis lage Goethe, Fichte, dan Schlegel.

source: In the context of Romanticism, the geography molded individuals, and over time customs and culture related to that geography arose, and these, being in harmony with the place of the society, were better than arbitrarily imposed laws.
reference: Lam konteks Romantisisme, geografi geupeugoet sidroe ureueng, ngön kayem bak adat ngön budaya nyang meusangkôt ngön geografi nyan itubiet, ngön nyoe, saban-saban ngön teumpat ureueng ramee, leubeh get dari hukom yang jipaksa pakriban nyang galak.
hypothesis: Dalam konteks Romantikisme, geografi meu bentuk individu, ngen seulama watee adat istiadat ngen budaya yeng meuhubong deungen geografi nyan meu muncul, ngen nyo, yeng seurupa deungen teumpat masyarakat, lubeh get dari hukom yeng dituntut seucara sewenang-wenang.

source: In the manner that Paris is known as the fashion capital of the contemporary world, Constantinople was regarded as the fashion capital of feudal Europe.
reference: Kareuna Paris jikeunai seubagoe ibu kota mode donya kontemporer, Konstantinopel jianggap seubagoe ibu kota mode Eropa feodal.
hypothesis: Dalam cara Paris dikhen seubagoe ibu kota mode donya kontemporer, Konstantinopel dianggap seubagoe ibu kota mode Eropa feudal.

source: Its renown for being an epicenter of luxury began in about 400 A.D. and lasted up until about 1100 A.D.
reference: Teumpat nyan jituri seubagoe pusat keumewahan mulai bak kira-kira 400 M ngon meulangsong sampoe kira-kira 1100 M.
hypothesis: Keumuliaan jih seubagoe pusat mewah dimulai bak thon 400 M. dan meuteun sampoe thon 1100 M.

source: Its status declined during the twelfth century mainly due to the fact that Crusaders had returned bearing gifts such as silks and spices that were valued more than what Byzantine markets offered.
reference: Statusjih geutren seulama abad keudua blah teuutama kareuna fakta bahwa Teuntra Saleb kalheueh geuwoe deungon jime hadiah lagee sutra ngon rempah-rempah yang meunilai leubeh dari peu nyang jipeutaba le pasar Bizantium.
hypothesis: Status jih meupeutren selama abad keu duabeulapan terutama karena fakta bahwa pejuang salib ka geuwoe geuba hadiah lage sutra dan rempah-rempah yang leubeh meuharga dari peue nyang ditawarkan le pasai Bizantium.

source: It was at this time that the transfer of the title of Fashion Capital from Constantinople to Paris was made.
reference: Bak watee nyan keuh geupinah gelar Fashion Capital dari Konstantinopel keu Paris.
hypothesis: Bak watèe nyan keuh geuminah nan Ibu Kota Mode dari Konstantinopel u Paris.

source: Gothic style peaked in the period between the 10th - 11th centuries and the 14th century.
reference: Aleh gaya Gothic ipeusapat bak masa antara abad keu 10-11 ngön abad keu-14.
hypothesis: Gaya Gotik meu puncak bak periode antara abad keu-10 - 11 ngen abad keu-14.

source: At the beginning dress was heavily influenced by the Byzantine culture in the east.
reference: Phon that bajee sep brat i peungaroh le Budaya Byzantium i timue.
hypothesis: Bak awai jih pakaian sangat dipengaruhi le budaya Bizantium di timu.

source: However, due to the slow communication channels, styles in the west could lag behind by 25 to 30 year.
reference: Beuranggandum, roet peugah haba nyang trep, gaya blah barat i tinggai 25 sampoe 30 thon.
hypothesis: Namun, kareuna saluran komunikasi yeng lambat, gaya di barat jeut keu di likot le 25 sampoe 30 thon.

source: towards the end of the Middle Ages western Europe began to develop their own style. one of the biggest developments of the time as a result of the crusades people began to use buttons to fasten clothing.
reference: Karab akhee bak Abad Teungoh Eropa Barat ipuphon peukeumang aleh awaknyan. Salah saboh keumajuan rayek pada jameun nyan seubagoe sabab ureueng prang saleb geupuphon ngui boh tip keu geuganceng bajee geuh.
hypothesis: bak akhe abad pertengahan Eropa barat mulai mengembangkan gaya awak nyan keudroe. salah saboh perkembangan rayek watee nyan akibat dari prang salib ureung mulai menggunakan tombol untuk mengikat pakaian.

source: Subsistence agriculture is agriculture carried out for the production of enough food to meet just the needs of the agriculturalist and his/her family.
reference: Peurtanian subsisten nakeuh buet meutani nyang ipubuet keu meuhase peunajoh siuroe-uroe beu sep keu tapeusep peu nyang ipeureule le ureueng meutani ngön keuluwarga si agam/si inoeng.
hypothesis: Pertanian subsisten adalah pertanian yeng dipeuget untuk produksi makanan yeng cukup untuk memenuhi kebutuhan petani ngen keluarga jih.

source: Subsistence agriculture is a simple, often organic, system using saved seed native to the ecoregion combined with crop rotation or other relatively simple techniques to maximize yield.
reference: Peurtanian subsisten nakeuh sistem peurtanian seudeurhana, kayemjih organik, nyang geungui bijeh asli dari kawasan eko nyang geukeubah ngön geupeusapat deungön rotasi tanaman atawa cara laén nyang seudeurhana keu meurumpok wase nyang get.
hypothesis: Pertanian subsisten adalah sistem sederhana, seureng organik, yeng meupakek benih yeng dipeuhibur asli keu ekoregion dikombinasikan deungen rotasi tanaman atau teknik yeng relatif sederhana laen untuk memaksimalkan hasil.

source: Historically most farmers were engaged in subsistence agriculture and this is still the case in many developing nations.
reference: Seucara historis ladom peutani roh lam peurtanian subsisten ngön nyoe mantoeng na dumpat nanggroe nyang ka maju.
hypothesis: Seujarah jih sebagian rayek petani meukat bak pertanian subsisten dan nyoe manteng terjadi di le nanggroe berkembang.

source: Subcultures bring together like-minded individuals who feel neglected by societal standards and allow them to develop a sense of identity.
reference: Subkultur geu peusaboh ureueng nyang saboh pham nyang meurasa droe geuh hana ipeurumeun le ureueng ramee ngön mungken awaknyan meungeumbangkan rasa taturie droe teuh.
hypothesis: Subkultur geupeusapat individu-individu yang berpikiran sama yang merasa terlupakan oleh standar masyarakat dan memungkinkan mereka untuk mengembangkan rasa identitas.

source: Subcultures can be distinctive because of the age, ethnicity, class, location, and/or gender of the members.
reference: Subkultur jeuetkeu meubeda sabab umue, etnis, glah, teumpat, ngön/atawa jeuneh meunale keulompok.
hypothesis: Subkultur jeut khas karena umur, etnis, kelas, lokasi, ngen/atau jenis kelamin anggota.

source: The qualities that determine a subculture as distinct may be linguistic, aesthetic, religious, political, sexual, geographical, or a combination of factors.
reference: Kualitah-kualitah nyang meupeuteunte saboh subkultur seubagoe nyang meubeda na keuh lagѐe basa, estetika, agama, politek, seksual, giografis, atawa meusapat sabab musabab.
hypothesis: Kualitas yeng meupeutentei subkultur seubagai berbeda jeut linguistik, estetika, agama, politik, seksual, geografis, atau kombinasi faktor.

source: Members of a subculture often signal their membership through a distinctive and symbolic use of style, which includes fashions, mannerisms, and argot.
reference: Keulompok subkultur kayem geutanda keulompok awaknyan rhoet peunungui aleh nyang khas ngön simbolis, nyang itamoeng meuneungui, peukateun, ngön cara tametutoe.
hypothesis: Anggota subkultur seureng geu peu tanda keanggotaan jih melalui penggunaan gaya yang khas dan simbolis, yeng mencakup mode, mannerisme, ngen argot.

source: One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up.
reference: Salah saboh cara nyang paléng umumjih jingui keu ilustrasi peunténg sosial na keuh deungön geupeuguna padum boh dalie aneuk miet nyang malang, rhot hana geupeureumeun, hana get naseb, atawa seungaja jipeuleceh, han geumaklumat le ureueng rayeuk oh ka rayeuk geuh.
hypothesis: Salah saboh metode yang paleng umum yang dipakek untuk menggambarkan peunteng sosialisasi adalah untuk meucuntoh bak kasus-kasus malang aneuk miet nyang, karena kelalaian, musibah, atau penyalahgunaan sengaja, hana di sosialisasi le ureung rayeuk seulama awak nyan meutamah rayeuk.

source: Such children are called "feral" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment.
reference: Padum droe aneuk miet jikheun "kleut" atawa juwah. Padum droe aneuk miet kleut jikuroeng le ureueng (biasajih le ureueng syikjih); lam padum boh dalie, aneuk nyoe hana ipeureumeun sabab ureueng syikjih han geutung reuloh utak atawa tuboh aneuk miet nyan.
hypothesis: Padum-padum droe aneuk nyang galak nyan ka jiboh keu ureung (biasan jih ureung tuha droe jih); lam padum-padum boh kasus peutuwoe aneuk nyan karena ureung tuha nyan hana geutem keu cacat intelektual atawa fisik aneuk nyan.

source: Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away.
reference: Aneuk-aneuk kleut mungken na keunong peulecehan atawa teumakot aneuk miet segohlom ikubah atawa iplueng.
hypothesis: Aneuk-aneuk nyang hana teutap teutap ka keunong keujam nyang parah atawa trauma seugolom jipeulaloe atawa jiplueng.

source: Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own.
reference: Na sangkira laén jipeurayeuk le meulatang; na padum droe sit ka udep i alam rimba keudroe ih.
hypothesis: Laen jih jipeugah bahwa nyang jipeulara lé beulatang; la'en jih jipeugah bahwa nyang tinggai di padang pasi keudroe.

source: When completely brought up by non-human animals, the feral child exhibits behaviors (within physical limits) almost entirely like those of the particular care-animal, such as its fear of or indifference to humans.
reference: Watѐe abeh ipeurayeuk le meulatang kon manusiya, aneuk miet kleut jipeudeuh peukateun (bak batah tuboh) karap mandumjih lagѐe saboh-saboh meulatang keumuemiet, lagѐe teumakot atawa hana peureumeun keu manusiya.
hypothesis: Wate sepenuhnya dipeurayeuk le binatang non-manusia, aneuk buih dipeudeh perilaku (dalam batas fisik) hampir mandum lagee binatang peurawat tertentu, lage takot atau ketidakpedulian terhadap manusia.

source: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond.
reference: Suementara meureunoe meudasai proyek suwah geupeuget meureunoe nyang leubeh mudah ngon leubeh lagak, ureueng peurancah meulangkah leubeh jioh.
hypothesis: Seudangkan pembelajaran berbasis proyek harus meuulitkan pembelajaran leubeh mudah dan leubeh menarik, perancah leubeh leupah dari nyan.

source: Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project.
reference: Peurancah kon keuh metode peumeureunoe meulaén soe tuloeng geutem keu tip ureueng nyang barô peungalaman geumeurunoe lagѐe geungui program komputer barô atawa puphon proyek barô.
hypothesis: Scaffolding kon metode pembelajaran tapi leubeh dari nyan alat yang geu bantu individu yang teungoh meupeuruno pengalaman pembelajaran baro lage geu pake program komputer baro atau geu mulai proyek baro.

source: Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office.
reference: Peurancah jeuet lagѐe virtual ngön nyata, deungön kalimah laén, sidroe gure na keuh bentoek nibak peurancah teutapi meunan sit awak seupet kertah ubeut i Microsoft Office.
hypothesis: Scaffold jeut virtual ngon nyata, deungon kata laen, sidroe guru adalah saboh bentuk scaffold tapi meunan cit manusia kecil yang na bak Microsoft Office.

source: Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.
reference: Peurancah Virtual jipeutamong lam peurangkat lunak ngön jimeukusud neuk jimeutanyong, meulake, ngön meusurah prosedur nyang mungken payah keu aneuk sikula neuk peulakue sidroe ih.
hypothesis: Scaffold Virtual geu internalisasi lam perangkat lunak dan dimaksudkan untuk geu tanyong, geu prompt, ngon geu jelaskan prosedur nyang mungken payah keu mahasiswa untuk geu tangani keudroe.

source: Children are placed in Foster Care for a wide variety of reasons that range from neglect, to abuse, and even to extortion.
reference: Aneuk miet jipeuduek bak Panti Asuhan sabab meubagoe daliee, nibak hana ureueng peureumeun, peulecahan, ngön bahpih jirampok.
hypothesis: Aneuk-aneuk dipeutamong lam peungawasan peurawat keu meubagoe macam alasan, mulai dari peubateu, keu peunindasan, dan bahkan keu peucarong.

source: No child should ever have to grow up in an environment that is not nurturing, caring, and educational, but they do.
reference: Hana aneuk miet nyang suwah rayeuk lam dairah droe ih nyang hana soe peulhara, peureumeun, ngoe jipeurunoe, ngön teutapih awak nyan peubuet.
hypothesis: Hana aneuk miet nyang haroh rayeuk lam lingkungan nyang hana peurayeuk, hana peurayeuk, dan hana geupeuruno, tapi aneuk miet nyan pih na.

source: We perceive the Foster Care System to be a safety zone for these children.
reference: Kamoe meukira Sistim Peungasuhan Aneuk miet seubagoe zona nyang sanyum keu aneuk miet nyoe.
hypothesis: Kamoe pike sistem peunampông keu aneuk miet nyoe adalah saboh zona aman.

source: Our foster care system is supposed to provide safe homes, loving caregivers, stable education, and reliable health care.
reference: Sistim Peungasuhan Aneuk miet kamoe suwah meupeusaneut rumoh nyang aman, peungasoh nyang geumaseh, peumeureunoe nyang get, ngön peurawat kesihatan nyang pah.
hypothesis: Sistem perawatan angkat kamoe diyakini meujok rumoh aman, peurawat yang meucinta, pendidikan nyang stabil, dan perawatan kesehatan nyang teupat.

source: Foster care is supposed to provide all the necessities that were lacking in the home they were previously taken from.
reference: Peungasuhan anukmiet payah geupeumeusaneut mandum peu nyang peurle nyang kurueng nibak rumoh awak nyan sugohlom jiasuh.
hypothesis: Peulara angkat nyan diyakini akan meujok mandum kebutuhan yang hana na di rumoh yang ka ji cok dari awak nyan.

source: The Internet combines elements of both mass and interpersonal communication.
reference: Internet geugabong unsur-unsur komunikasi massa ngon interpersonal.
hypothesis: Internet geu gabongkan elemen komunikasi massa ngon interpersonal.

source: The distinct characteristics of the Internet lead to additional dimensions in terms of the uses and gratifications approach.
reference: Sipheuet nyang meubeda dari Internet meuakibat dimensi tambahan dalam hai pendekatan penggunaan ngon gratifikasi.
hypothesis: Karakteristik nyang berbeda nibak Internet meupeutunyok dimensi tambahan dalam hal pendekatan penggunaan ngon keugagasan.

source: For example, “learning” and “socialization” are suggested as important motivations for Internet use (James et al., 1995).
reference: Miseuejih, “meurunoe” ngon “sosialisasi” jisaran seubagoe motivasi peunteng keu ngui Internet (James et al., 1995).
hypothesis: Miseu jih, pembelajaran ngon sosialization dipeugah seubagai motivasi peunteng keu penggunaan Internet (James et al., 1995).

source: “Personal involvement” and “continuing relationships” were also identified as new motivation aspects by Eighmey and McCord (1998) when they investigated audience reactions to websites.
reference: “Keterlibatan droe” ngon “hubongan nyang meulanjot” jipeutentee cit seubagoe aspek motivasi baro le Eighmey ngon McCord (1998) watee awaknyan jisudi reaksi peserta keu situs web.
hypothesis: "Penglibatan pribadi" ngon "mumat hubungan" cit jiidentifikasi seubagai aspek motivasi baro le Eighmey ngen McCord (1998) wate awak nyan ji seulidek reaksi penonton bak situs web.

source: The use of video recording has led to important discoveries in the interpretation of micro-expressions, facial movements which last a few milliseconds.
reference: Peunungui reukaman video jeuet meuhase soe nyang tumee peunteng lam intepretasi ekpresi mikro, grak muka nyang meugrak padum milidetik.
hypothesis: Penggunaan rekaman video ka meujok penemuan peunteng lam interpretasi ekspresi mikro, gerakan muka nyang meuteun padum-padum milisegund.

source: In particular, it is claimed that one can detect whether a person is lying by interpreting micro-expressions correctly.
reference: Seucara khas, jicap bahwajih sidroe ureueng jeuet jitupue pue keuh sidroe ureueng meusulet deungön geutakse ekpresi mikro deungön beutôi.
hypothesis: Khusus jih, diklaim bahwa sidroe jeut mengidentifikasi peu ureung nyan boeh dengan menafsirkan ekspresi mikro secara beutoi.

source: Oliver Sacks, in his paper The President's Speech, indicated how people who are unable to understand speech because of brain damage are nevertheless able to assess sincerity accurately.
reference: Olver Sacks, lam makalahjih Ceuramah Presiden, jipeutunyok kiban ureueng nyang han meuphom tapeugah haba sabab reuloh utak teutap jeuet jinilai sep trang.
hypothesis: Oliver Sacks, lam makalah jih The President's Speech, geu peutunyok pakriban ureung nyang hana jeut meuphom haba kareuna luka otak pih jeut geu peuhakém keujujoran ngon teupat.

source: He even suggests that such abilities in interpreting human behavior may be shared by animals such as domestic dogs.
reference: Gobnyan malah jibri peunutoh bahwasajih meuphom nyang lagѐe nyan lam meumakna peukateun manusiya na sit bak meulatang lagѐe asee teupeulhara.
hypothesis: Jih bahkan geu sarankan bahwa kemampuan lage nyan dalam menafsirkan perilaku manusia mungken jibagi le binatang lage aseng domestik.

source: Twentieth century research has shown that there are two pools of genetic variation: hidden and expressed.
reference: Peunelitian abad keuduwa ploh ka geupeuleumah bahwa na duwa keulompok jeuneh genetik: teusom ngön nyata.
hypothesis: Penelitian abad keu-20 ka dipeudeh na dua boh jenis variasi genetik: tersembunyi ngon diungkapkan.

source: Mutation adds new genetic variation, and selection removes it from the pool of expressed variation.
reference: Mutasi meutamah jeuneh genetik barô, ngön seleksi peugadoh nibak jeuneh meusapat nyang nyata.
hypothesis: Mutasi geu tambah variasi genetik baro, ngen seleksi geu peuek dari kumpulan variasi nyang geu peujeut.

source: Segregation and recombination shuffle variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
reference: Segregasi ngön rekombinasi meukacok jeuneh ukeu u likot antara duwa kulam deungön tiep generasi.
hypothesis: Segregasi ngen rekombinasi menggeser variasi ke balah keunoe antara dua kelompok deungen setiap generasi.

source: Out on the savanna, it is hard for a primate with a digestive system like that of humans to satisfy its amino-acid requirements from available plant resources.
reference: Di luwa bak sabana, payah keu saboh primata deungön sistem ceurna lagee manusiya keu peupunoh masam-aminojih nibak sumber daya bak kayee nyang na teuseudiya.
hypothesis: Di dalam savan, sulet that keu primata nyang na sistem pencernaan lage manusia untuk memenuhi kebutuhan asam amino dari sumber daya tumbuhan nyang na.

source: Moreover, failure to do so has serious consequences: growth depression, malnutrition, and ultimately death.
reference: Seulaén nyan, hana wase keu peubuet na akibat gasui: depresi meutimoh, keureueng gizi, ngön akhejih matee.
hypothesis: Seulaen nyan, hana peuget nyan na akibat nyang parah: depresi pertumbuhan, kekurangan gizi, dan akhe jih mate.

source: The most readily accessible plant resources would have been the proteins accessible in leaves and legumes, but these are hard for primates like us to digest unless they are cooked.
reference: Sumber daya bak kayee nyang paléng mangat diteume nakeuh protein nyang teuseudiya bak ôn ngön kacang-kacang, tapi nyoe payah dicerna primata lagѐe geutanyoe kecuali miseu geutagun.
hypothesis: sumber daya tanaman nyang paleng mudah diakses adalah protein nyang na lam dahan ngon kacang-kacangan, tapi nyoe payah keu primata lage geutanyoe untuk dicerna kecuali jika di masak.

source: In contrast, animal foods (ants, termites, eggs) not only are easily digestible, but they provide high-quantity proteins that contain all the essential amino acids.
reference: Seubalekjih, umpeuen meulatang (sidom, kamue, boh) kön sagai mangat dicerna, tapi cit geusediya protein lam kadar nyang le nyang na mandum masam amino esensial.
hypothesis: Seubalek jih, makanan binatang ( semut, rayek, telur) kon mantong mudah dicerna, tapi jih cit meuaso protein nyang le that nyang na mandum asam amino nyang peunteng.

source: All things considered, we should not be surprised if our own ancestors solved their "protein problem" in somewhat the same way that chimps on the savanna do today.
reference: Mandum hai geupeutimang, geutanyoe hana peureule hireuen miseu nek geutanyoe keudroe peuseuleuso "masalah protein" awak nyan deungön cara nyang saban lagѐe nyang dipuebuet simpanse di sabana uroe nyoe.
hypothesis: Seucara umum, tanyoe hana haroh jika indatu tanyoe geu peuseuleusoe "masalah protein" jih seucara lagee nyang ji peuseuleusoe le simpanse di padang gurun uroe nyoe.

source: Sleep interruption is the process of purposefully awakening during your normal sleep period and falling asleep a short time later (10–60 minutes).
reference: Peuputoh eh nakeuh proses meujaga deungön seungaja watѐe masa eh normal gata ngön eh padum watѐe oh lheueh nyan (10-60 meunet).
hypothesis: Pengecehan tidur adalah proses tujuan bangun seulama periode tidur normal awak dan tertidur seulama watee singkat (10 60 menit).

source: This can be easily done by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to bring you to consciousness without fully waking you.
reference: Nyoejeuet deungön mangat dipuebuet deungön geungui jeum alarm nyang hana su keu jiba gata u watѐe jaga adak hana beutôi-beutôi peubeudoh gata.
hypothesis: Nyan jeut ji peuget deungon mudah deungon cara ji pakek geulanteue nyang relatif hana ji peugah haba keu ji peuglah awak nyan tanpa ji peujaga awak nyan.

source: If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, it can be placed on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off.
reference: Miseu gata meuteume droe neuato jeum dari phon lam teungeuet gata, nyanjeuet dipuduek bak kama laén, geupaksa gata keu tron nibak teumpat eh keu peumatee.
hypothesis: Meunyo awak nyan ka neugantoe jam bak watee awak nyan teungoh teungét, jam nyan jeut ji peuduek bak saboh sisi laen, ngon nyan awak nyan dipaksa keu teubiet nibak kama mangat ji mat jih.

source: Other biorhythm-based options involve drinking lots of fluid (particularly water or tea, a known diuretic) prior to sleep, forcing one to get up to urinate.
reference: Pilehan ateueh asai-bioritme nyang laén jitamong lam buet jep ie caye (keu phon ie atawa te, nyang diteupeu cit seubagoe diuretik sigohlom eh, geupaksa sidroe ureueng jaga keu geu to ie iek.
hypothesis: Pilihan laen nyang berbasiskan bioritme na keuh minum le cairan (khusus jih ie atawa teh, diuretik nyang terkenal) seugolom geu éh, nyang dipaksa sidroe ureung untuk bangun keu geu urine.

source: The amount of inner peace a person possesses correlates oppositely to the amount of tension in one’s body and spirit.
reference: Jumlah dame baten nyang na bak sidroe ureueng meubandeng meubalek deungön jumlah ceukang lam tuboh ngön baten sidroe ureueng.
hypothesis: Tingkat kedamaian batin yang dimiliki sidroe ureung meuhubungkan seucara bertentangan deungen tingkat ketegangan dalam tuboh dan jiwa seseorang.

source: The lower the tension, the more positive the life force present. Every person has the potential to find absolute peace and contentment.
reference: Maken diet ceukang, maken positif teuga udep nyang na. Tiep ureueng na potensi keu meuteume dame ngön pueh mutlak.
hypothesis: Seumaken leumoh ketegangan, seumaken positif kekuatan udep. tiep-tiep ureung na potensi untuk meurumpok deungon damai dan kepuasan yang mutlak.

source: Everyone can achieve enlightenment. The only thing standing in the way of this goal is our own tension and negativity.
reference: Tiep ureueng jeuet geuteume trang baten. Saboh hai nyang peuhalang tujuan nyoe nakeuh ceukang ngön hai negatif geutanyoe keudroe.
hypothesis: Mandum ureung jeut mencapai pencerahan. yang meutanggong jaoh dalam tujuan nyoe adalah ketegangan dan negatifitas kita sendiri.

source: The Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of Buddha, but were extended by the mahayana path of love and by a lot of techniques from Indian Yoga.
reference: Agama Buddha Tibet nakeuh asai bak euleumee nyang geupeuruno le Buddha, tapi dipeluah nibak rauh gaseh Mahayana ngön le teknik nibak Yoga India.
hypothesis: Buddhisme Tibet didasarkan bak ajaran Buddha, tapi dipeukembang le jalan cinta mahayana dan le teknik dari yoga India.

source: In principle the Tibetan Buddhism is very simple. It consists of Kundalini Yoga, meditation and the path of all-embracing love.
reference: Bak prinsipjih Agama Buddha Tibet nyan seuderhana that. Nyoe salah saboh nibak Yoga Kundalini, meditasi ngön rauh gaseh nyang geuuem mandum.
hypothesis: Pada prinsip jih Buddhisme Tibet that sederhana. jih terdiri dari Kundalini Yoga, meditasi dan jalan cinta yang mencakup mandum.

source: With Kundalini Yoga the Kundalini energy (enlightenment energy) is awakened through yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantras and visualizations.
reference: Deungön Yoga Kundalini, teunaga Kundalini (teunaga trang baten) nakeuh geubangket teuma postur yoga, latihan naphah, mantra, ngön visualisasi.
hypothesis: Deungen Kundalini Yoga, energi Kundalini (energi pencerahan) geu peugoe melalui postur yoga, latihan pernapasan, mantra dan visualisasi.

source: The center of Tibetan meditation is the Deity Yoga. Through the visualization of various deities the energy channels are cleaned, the chakras are activated and the enlightenment consciousness is created.
reference: Pusat meditasi nibak Tibet nakeuh Deity Yoga. Röt visualisasi nibak meubagoe dewa lhueng teunaga nyan jipeugleh, chakra jipeu aktif ngön keusadaran trang baten ka jipeugöt.
hypothesis: Pusat meditasi Tibet adalah Deity Yoga. Melalui visualisasi berbagai dewa saluran energi geu rhah, chakra geu aktifkan ngon kesadaran pencerahan geu peuget.

source: Germany was a common enemy in World War 2, leading to cooperation between the USSR and USA. With the end of the war the clashes of system, process and culture led to the countries falling out.
reference: Jeurman nakeuh musoh sajan lam Prang Donya 2, nyang arah bak keureujasama antara Uni Soviet ngön Amerika Serikat. Deungön meuakhe prang meuhantan sistem, proses ngön budaya jeuet seubab nanggroe-nanggroe rhot.
hypothesis: Jerman adalah musoh bersama lam Prang Donya II, yang meupeulaku bak kerjasama antara USSR ngen AS. deungen akhe prang, bentrokan sistem, proses dan budaya meupeulaku bak nanggroe-nanggroe nyan meucre.

source: With two years of the end of the war, the former allies were now enemies and the Cold War began.
reference: Deungön duwa thon meuakhe prang, euntee syarikat jinoe jeuet musoh ngön Prang Leupie ka jipuphon.
hypothesis: Dua thon lheuh akhe prang, mantan sekutu jinoe jeut keu musoh dan Perang Dingin mulai.

source: It was to last for the next 40 years and would be fought for real, by proxy armies, on battlefields from Africa to Asia, in Afghanistan, Cuba and many other places.
reference: Nyan akan meulangsong lam 40 thon u keu ngön akan geupeujuang ngön nyata, le teuntra dari cabeung, bak wilayah prang nibak Afrika trôh u Asia, bak Afghanistan, Kuba, ngön le teumpat laén.
hypothesis: Nyan akan meuteun selama 40 thon ukeu dan akan dipeurjueng nyata, le tentara proxy, di medan prang dari Afrika sampoe Asia, di Afghanistan, Kuba ngon le teumpat laen.

source: By September 17, 1939, the Polish defense was already broken, and the only hope was to retreat and reorganise along the Romanian bridgehead.
reference: Lam 17 September 1939, petheuen Polandia ka reuloh, ngön saboh harapan nakeuh surot ngön geususon teuma lam sipanyang titie Rumania.
hypothesis: Bak 17 September 1939, pertahanan Polandia ka patah, dan saboh-saboh jih harapan adalah untuk mundur dan meupeurorganisasi lom di seureuta teuntang Rumania.

source: However, these plans were rendered obsolete nearly overnight, when over 800,000 soldiers from the Soviet's Union Red Army entered and created the Belarussian and Ukrainian fronts after invading the eastern regions of Poland in violation of the Riga Peace Treaty, the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, and other international treaties, both bilateral and multilateral.
reference: Beuranggandum, peugah nyoe jeuet useueng karap lam simalam, watѐe leubeh nibak 800.000 teuntra nibak Teuntra Mirah Uni Soviet jitamong ngön peugöt blah Belarusia ngön Ukraina oh lheueh geujak invasi wilayah timu Polandia nyang sakeue kanun Dame Riga, Pakta Hana-Agresi Soviet-Polandia, ngön kanun internasional laén, jeuet bilateral atawapih multilateral.
hypothesis: Namun, rencana nyo di peugadoh hampir seugolom malam, wate leubeh dari 800.000 tentara dari Union Soviet's Red Army geutamong ngon geu peuget front Belarus ngen Ukraina lheuh geu serang wilayah timu Polandia seucara melanggar Perjanjian Perdamaian Riga, Pakta Non-Agresi Soviet-Polandia, ngen perjanjian internasional laen jih, baik bilateral maupun multilateral.

source: Using ships to transport goods is by far the most efficient way to move large amounts of people and goods across oceans.
reference: Ngui kapai keu angkôt dabeuh trôh jinoe nakeuh cara paléng efisien keu peupinah ramѐ ureueng ngön dabeuh rhët laôt.
hypothesis: Menggunakan kapai untuk mengangkut barang adalah cara yang paleng efisien untuk mengangkut jumlah rayek ureung ngen barang di seutiara laot.

source: The job of navies has traditionally been to ensure that your country maintains the ability to move your people and goods, while at the same time, interfering with your enemy's ability to move his people and goods.
reference: Buet angkatan laôt ngön cara tradisional peuteuntѐe bahwa nanggroe gata jeuet peutheun keu peupinah ureueng ngön dabeuh gata, sementara bak watѐe nyang saban, peukaru musôh gata keu jeuet peupinah ureueng ngön dabeuh.
hypothesis: Tugas angkatan laut seucara tradisional adalah untuk memastikan bahwa nanggroe awak nyan meukuasa untuk memindahkan rakyat dan barang awak nyan, seumentara nyan, meungganggu kemampuan musuh awak nyan untuk memindahkan rakyat dan barang awak nyan.

source: One of the most noteworthy recent examples of this was the North Atlantic campaign of WWII. The Americans were trying to move men and materials across the Atlantic Ocean to help Britain.
reference: Salah saboh tamse nyang paléng barô nyang paléng peunténg nibak nyoe nakeuh kampanye Atlantik Utara nibak WWII. Amerika geucuba keu peupinah ureueng ngön dabeuh rhët Samudra Atlantik keu tulông Inggreh.
hypothesis: Salah saboh contoh nyang paleng peunteng nibak masa nyoe adalah kampanye Atlantik Utara seulama Perang Dunia II. Amerika mencoba untuk menggerakkan manusia dan bahan-bahan di seubuah samudra Atlantik untuk membantu Britania.

source: At the same time, the German navy, using mainly U-boats, was trying to stop this traffic.
reference: Bak watѐe nyang sama, teuntra laôt Jerman, phôn jingui kapai seulam, useuha keu jipeudöng lalu lintah nyoe.
hypothesis: Bak masa nyan, angkatan laut Jerman, nyang peuguna U-boat, ji coba peuhakek peudeng nyoe.

source: Had the Allies failed, Germany probably would have been able to conquer Britain as it had the rest of Europe.
reference: Miseu seukutu-seukutu jih talô, Jeurman mungkén jeuet jitaklok Inggreh lagѐe hai nyan keuh mandum Eropa laén.
hypothesis: Meunyo Allies gagal, Jerman mungken jeut keu peumeunang Britania lage jih peumeunang di Eropa.

source: Goats seem to have been first domesticated roughly 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.
reference: Kamѐng deuh jih nyang keuphôn jipeuseuit nibak 10.000 thon nyang ka ulikôt bak gunoeng Zagros Iran.
hypothesis: Kambing deuh jih phon that dipeuluah kira-kira 10.000 thon yang ka u likot di Gunong Zagros di Iran.

source: Ancient cultures and tribes began to keep them for easy access to milk, hair, meat, and skins.
reference: Budaya ngön suku jameun geupeuphôn kubah keu nak mudah meutume susu, bulѐe, sie ngön kulѐt.
hypothesis: Budaya dan suku jameun mulai meukubu untuk akses mudah keu susu, rambut, daging, ngen kulot.

source: Domestic goats were generally kept in herds that wandered on hills or other grazing areas, often tended by goatherds who were frequently children or adolescents, similar to the more widely known shepherd. These methods of herding are still used today.
reference: Kamѐng seuit umumjih jipeulhara lam kawan nyang meuwét-wét i buket atawa jipeurabee bak tempat laén, kayém jipeurabee lé awak peurabee Kamѐng nyan biyasajih aneuk miet atawa aneuk muda, hie lagѐe awak peurabee nyang kayém iturie. Cara peumrabee nyoe mantông jingui sampoe oh jinoe.
hypothesis: Kambeng domestik umum jih dipeulara lam kawan nyang meulinteung di bukit-bukit atawa daerah-daerah meurabe laen, seureng dipeulara le tukang meurabe nyang kayem jih aneuk miet atawa remaja, lagee tukang meurabe nyang leubeh that terkenal. Metode meurabe nyoe manteng dipakek jinoe.

source: Wagonways were built in England as early as the 16th Century.
reference: Jalan geuritan jipeudoeng i Inggreh bak awai Abad keu-16.
hypothesis: Wagonway dipeuget di Inggreh seugolom abad keu-16.

source: Although wagonways merely consisted of parallel planks of wood, they allowed horses pulling them to achieve greater speeds and pull larger loads than on the slightly more rough roads of the day.
reference: Adakpih jalan geuritan apui jipeugot nibak papeun kaye nyang meusambong, awak nyan jibi idin keu guda tarék awak nyan nak bagah troek nyang leubѐh rayeuk ngön tarék beuban nyang leubѐh rayeuk nibak rauh nyang bacut leubѐh gasa bak uroe nyan.
hypothesis: Meskipun wagonway hanya terdiri dari papan kayu paralel, awak nyan memungkinkan kuda yang ditarik untuk mencapai kecepatan yang leubeh rayek dan menarik beban yang leubeh rayek daripada di jalan-jalan yang agak leubeh kasar bak uroe nyan.
