source: Crossties were introduced fairly early to hold the tracks in place. Gradually, however, it was realised that tracks would be more efficient if they had a stip of iron on the top.
reference: Crossties jipeuturie sep awai keu ngön peutheun moto geurubak bak teumpat. Bahpih, bacut-bacut, jithee bahwa moto geurubak leubѐh get meuseu na ujoeng busoe diateueh jih.
hypothesis: Tapeutamong bandeng peu saboh untuk meukulet bak teumpat. Beutôi-beutôi, ji peujeut bahwa jalur akan leubeh efisien jika na stang beuso di ateuh.

source: This became common practice, but the iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons.
reference: Nyoe jeuet geupeubuet langsông le ureueng ramee, tapih busoe wab leubѐh bagah thoe ruda kayee geurubak.
hypothesis: Nyan kajeut keu adat, teuma beuso nyan leubeh that meupeureupah bak ruda-ruda geuritan nyan.

source: Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by iron wheels. In 1767, the first full-iron rails were introduced.
reference: Akhéjih, ruda kayee jigantoe deungön ruda busoe. Bak thon 1767, rel busoe phôn jipeuturi.
hypothesis: Akhe jih, roda kaye ji ganti ngen roda beuso. bak thon 1767, rel phon yang meuasoe beuso ji peuget.

source: The first known transportation was walking, humans began walking upright two million years ago with the emergence of Homo Erectus (meaning upright man).
reference: Transportai nyang keuphôn jituri na keuh jak ngön gaki, ureueng geu jak teudong dua juta thon nyang ka ulikot deungön na lahe Homo Erectus (meumakna ureueng teudong).
hypothesis: Transportasi phon nyang jituri adalah geujak, manusia mulai geujak tegak dua juta thon yang ka u likot deungen muncul jih Homo Erectus (meumakna manusia tegak).

source: Their predecessors, the Australopithecus did not walk upright as habitually.
reference: Ureueng dile awak nyan, Australopithecus hana ijak teudong lage biasajih.
hypothesis: Phon awai jih, Australopithecus hana berjalan tegak lage biasa.

source: Bipedal specializations are found in Australopithecus fossils from 4.2-3.9 million years ago, although Sahelanthropus may have walked on two legs as early as seven million years ago.
reference: Bipedal Spesial jiteume bak posil Australopithecus nibak 4,2-3,9 juta thon nyang ka ulikot, adakpih Sahelanthropus mungkén ka ijak deungön dua gaki nibak tujoeh juta thon nyang ka ulikot.
hypothesis: Spesialisasi bipedal ditumeng bak fosil Australopithecus dari 4,2-3,9 juta thon yang ka, meskipun Sahelanthropus mungken geujak bak dua gaki seugolom tujoh juta thon nyang ka.

source: We can start living more friendly to the environment, we can join to the environmental movement, and we can even be activists in order to reduce the future suffering in some degree.
reference: Tanyoepuphôn udep rumeh deungön teumpat tinggai, tanyoe jeuet meusapat deungön geurakan lingkungan, meusuejeuet sit tanyoebeujeuetkeu aktivis keu peukureung deurita bak masa ukeu bak tingkat meutente.
hypothesis: Tanyoe jeut ta mulai udep nyang leubeh ramah keu lingkungan, geutanyoe jeut ta gabung keu gerakan lingkungan, dan tanyoe jeut cit jeut keu aktivis untuk mengurangi penderitaan masa ukeu seucara tertentu.

source: This is just like symptomatic treatment in many cases. However, if we do not only want a temporary solution, then we should find the root of the problems, and we should deactivate them.
reference: Nyoe lagѐe peukara ubat bak jai peukara, Beuranggandum, meuseu tanyoe hana galak teuh tapeuseuleusoe siat, makajih tanyoe wajeb ta seutot ukheu peukara, ngön tanyoe peureulee ta peumateejih.
hypothesis: Nyan saban lagee pengobatan sintomatik lam le kasus, tapi meunyoe tanyoe hana hanya ingin solusi sementara, maka tanyoe harus meurumpok punca masalah, dan tanyoe harus deaktivasi masalah nyan.

source: It is obvious enough that the world has changed much because of humankind's scientific and technological advancements, and problems have become greater because of overpopulation and mankind's extravagant lifestyle.
reference: Sep deuh ka bahwasajih donya nyoe jai ka meuubah sabab maju ileume peungetahuan ngön tehnologi umat manusiya, ngön peukara leubѐh jai sabab leubѐh jai ka ureueng ngön aleh udep ureueng nyang eumpah ampeeh.
hypothesis: Nyan nyata bahwa donya ka meu-ubah kareuna kemajuan sains dan teknologi, dan masalah-masalah nyan meutamah-tamah kareuna le that ureuëng tinggai dan cara udeb manusia nyang meujampu.

source: After its adoption by Congress on July 4, a handwritten draft signed by the President of Congress John Hancock and the Secretary Charles Thomson was then sent a few blocks away to the printing shop of John Dunlap.
reference: watѐe kaleuh geuteurimong le Kongres oh tanggai 4 Juli, saboh kheuet kageuboh teken le Presiden Kongres John Hancock ngön Sekretaris Charles Thomson leuhnyan kirѐm geukirѐm u saboh keude salen nyang hana that jioh nibak sinan ata John Dunlap.
hypothesis: Lheuh ji adopsi le Kongres bak 4 Juli, saboh draft nyang geutuleh le Presiden Kongres John Hancock dan Sekretaris Charles Thomson ji kirem le padum boh blok u warong cetak John Dunlap.

source: Through the night between 150 and 200 copies were made, now known as "Dunlap broadsides".
reference: watѐe malam nyan troh 150 sampoe 200 salen ka geupeuna, jino nyan kadituri seubagoe "Dunlap pamplet".
hypothesis: Seulama malam nyan antara 150 ngon 200 salinan dipeuget, jinoe dikhen "Dunlap broadsides".

source: The first public reading of the document was by John Nixon in the yard of Independence Hall on July 8.
reference: Geubaca asoe dokumen dikeu ureueng rame keuphôn that dipeulaku le John Nixon bak lampoh keu Geudong Kemerdekaan bak tanggai 8 Juli.
hypothesis: Bacaan publik phon dari dokumen nyan oleh John Nixon di halaman Independence Hall bak 8 Juli.

source: One was sent to George Washington on July 6, who had it read to his troops in New York on July 9. A copy reached London on August 10.
reference: Saboh ka geukirѐm u George Washington bak tanggai 6 Juli, nyang geubaca di keu pasukan teuntra gobnyan i New York watѐe tanggai 9 Jui. Saboh salen teuk troeh u London bak tanggai 10 Agustus.
hypothesis: Saboh surat nyan ji kirem bak George Washington bak tanggai 6 Juli, nyang bak tanggai 9 Juli, surat nyan ji baca bak pasukan jih di New York.

source: The 25 Dunlap broadsides still known to exist are the oldest surviving copies of the document. The original handwritten copy has not survived.
reference: Ban 25 boh pamplet Dunlap nyang mantông na nyan keuh dokumen salen nyang paleng tuha nyang seulamat. Kheuet jaroe nyang aseuli salen phôn ka hana seulamat.
hypothesis: 25 Dunlap broadsides nyang mantong na nakeuh salinan tertua dari dokumen nyan.

source: Many paleontologists today believe that one group of dinosaurs survived and is alive today. We call them birds.
reference: Rame ahli paleontologi uroenyoe nyang yakin saboh keulompok dinasaurus na nyang seulamat ngön udep sampoe uroenyoe. Geutanyoe tabi nan nyan cicem.
hypothesis: Le ahli paleontologi jinoe peucaya bahwa saboh kelompok dinosaurus nyang mantong udep sampoe jinoe.

source: Many people don't think about them as dinosaurs because they have feathers and can fly.
reference: Le ureueng nyang hana dipikee keu awaknyan seubagoe dinosaurus sabab awaknyan na bule ngön jeuet dipoe.
hypothesis: Le ureueng hana pike awak nyan sebagai dinosaurus kareuna awak nyan na bulu dan jeut terbang.

source: But there are a lot of things about birds that still look like a dinosaur.
reference: Tapi le that hai teuntang cicem nyang mantông hie dengön dinosaurus.
hypothesis: Teuma na le that hal nyang na bak cicem nyang manteng lagee dinosaurus.

source: They have feet with scales and claws, they lay eggs, and they walk on their two back legs like a T-Rex.
reference: Cicem na gaki ngön sisek ngön gukee, jitoh boh, ngön jijak ngön duwa boh gateh lagѐe T-Rex.
hypothesis: Awak nyan na gaki deungon sisik ngon cakar, awak nyan jipeugöt telur, dan awak nyan jijak bak dua gaki likot jih lagee T-Rex.

source: Virtually all computers in use today are based on the manipulation of information which is coded in the form of binary numbers.
reference: Lam hakekatjih mandum komputer nyang dingui uroenyoe nakeuh asai nibak cara geu atoe informasi nyang di boh lam sandi lam rupa lumboi biner.
hypothesis: Hampir mandum komputer nyang dipakek jinoe didasarkan bak manipulasi informasi nyang dikode dalam bentuk bilangan biner.

source: A binary number can have only one of two values, i.e. 0 or 1, and these numbers are referred to as binary digits - or bits, to use computer jargon.
reference: Saboh lumboi biner nyan na duwa nibak saboh nilai, tamsejih 0 atawa 1, ngön lumboi nyoe dum dikheun sebagoe numboi biner – atawa bits, keujeuet takheun istilah komputer.
hypothesis: Saboh bilangan biner jeut na saboh dari dua nilai, yaitu 0 atau 1, ngen angka nyo dikhen sebagai digit biner - atau bit, untuk dipakek jargon komputer.

source: Internal poisoning may not be immediately apparent. Symptoms, such as vomiting are sufficiently general that an immediate diagnosis cannot be made.
reference: Tuba nyang keunong lam tuboh nyan han deuh sigra. Hai-hai nyang meuteuka, lage muntah nakeuh umumjih saboh hai keupariksa nyang bagah hanjeut tapeuna.
hypothesis: Meunurot peuneurita, bak watee nyan na saboh peunyaket nyang hana teukira, nyang na keuhaderan bak peunyaket nyan na kheueh:

source: The best indication of internal poisoning may be the presence of an open container of medication or toxic household chemicals.
reference: Hai nyang paleng meuteuka nibak tuba lam tuboh nakeuh na jiteume plok ubat nyang teuhah atawa racoen kimia lam rumoh.
hypothesis: Tanda nyang paleng get keu keracunan internal jeut keuhada jih wadah nyang teubuka nyang na ubat atawa bahan kimia rumoh nyang beracun.

source: Check the label for specific first aid instructions for that specific poison.
reference: Neukaloen label keu cara tulong keu tuba khusoih nyan.
hypothesis: Neutilek bak label instruksi pertolongan phon khusus keu racun tertentu.

source: The term bug is used by entomologists in a formal sense for this group of insects.
reference: Istilah bug ingui lé ahli entomologi lam lingka formal keu kawan seureungga nyoë.
hypothesis: Istilah kewan peulet dipakek le ahli entomologi dalam arti formal keu kelompok serangga nyoe.

source: This term derives from ancient familiarity with Bed-bugs, which are insects highly adapted to parasitize humans.
reference: Istilah nyoë meuasai dari keakraban jameun deungön pijét, nyang meuhareutoë seureungga nyang that beradaptasi jeut keu parasit nibak manusia.
hypothesis: Istilah nyo meuasai dari kebiasaan kuno deungen Bed-bugs, nyang merupakan serangga yang sangat beradaptasi untuk parasit manusia.

source: Both Assassin-bugs and Bed-bugs are nidicolous, adapted to living in nest or housing of their host.
reference: Göt gutèë pembunuh atawa pit sama-sama nidicolous, meuadaptasi keu tinggai di sarang atawa peugöt rumoh di inangjih.
hypothesis: Bandua kewan Assassin ngen kewan Bed adalah kewan yang berburu, diadaptasi untuk tinggai di sarang atau perumahan inang jih.

source: Across the United States of America, there are approximately 400,000 known cases of Multiple Sclerosis (MS), leaving it as the leading neurological disease in younger and middle aged adults.
reference: Bak Amerika Serikat, nakeuh leubѐh kureueng nibak 400.000 keujadian Multiple Sclerosis (MS), nyang peutinggai nyan keu saboh peunyaket saraf nibak aneuk muda ngön ureueng nyang karap tuha.
hypothesis: Di Amerika Serikat, na kira-kira 400.000 kasus nyang jituri dari Multiple Sclerosis (MS), nyang peuget jih jeut keu peunyaket neurologis nyang phon bak ureueng rayeuk nyang muda ngon tuha.

source: MS is a disease that affects the central nervous system, which is made up of the brain, the spinal cord and the optic nerve.
reference: MS nyan keuh saboh peunyaket nyang keunong bak system saraf nyang diteungoh, nyang peuna keu utak, saraf bak tuleung rhueng ngön saraf mata.
hypothesis: MS nyan keuh saboh peunyaket nyang keunong bak sistem saraf pusat, nyang terdiri dari otak, sumsum tulang belakang ngon saraf optik.

source: Research has found that females are two times more likely to have MS then males.
reference: Peuneulitian ka geuteume bahwasajih ureueng inong leubѐh mudah keunong MS duwa goe lipat nibak ureueng agam.
hypothesis: Penelitian ka meuteume bahwa ureung inong dua goe leubeh le keunong MS daripada ureung agam.

source: A couple may decide it is not in their best interest, or in the interest of their child, to raise a baby.
reference: Saboh peudampeng geupeuputoh nyoe koen paleng meuheut, atawa lam meuheut aneuk awak nyan, keu peurayeuk aneuk.
hypothesis: Sidroe lakoe binoe mungken jipeuputôh bahwa hana kheueh nyang leubeh jroh keu awaknyan atawa keu aneuëk awaknyan, meunyoe awaknyan jipeulahé sidroe aneuëk.

source: These couples may choose to make an adoption plan for their baby.
reference: Peudampeng nyoejeuet geupileh keu peugot saboh reuncana adopsi aneuk awak nyan.
hypothesis: Pasangan nyoe mungken geupiléh rencana keu peuramphon aneuk jih.

source: In an adoption, the birth parents terminate their parental rights so that another couple may parent the child.
reference: Lam adopsi, ureueng chiek droe abeh hak seubagoe ureueng chiek sampoe peudampeng laen jeuet geuasuh aneuk nyan.
hypothesis: Lam saboh adopsi, ureung tuha nyang seucara seucara seucara lahé geupeuputôh hak keu ibu ngon ayah mangat pasangan nyang laen jeuet keu ayah ngon ma aneuëk nyan.

source: Science’s main goal is to figure out the way the world works through the scientific method. This method in fact guides most scientific research.
reference: Makeusud ilmee utama nakeuh neuk jiteupue cara donya keurija rhot cara alami. Deuh takaloen cara nyoe geupeumeuho bak peuneulitian ladom.
hypothesis: Tujuan utama sains adalah untuk meuphom cara donya bekerja melalui metode ilmiah. Metode nyo seucara nyata meupeutunyok sebagian rayek penelitian ilmiah.

source: It isn’t alone though, experimentation, and an experiment is a test that is used to eliminate one or more of the possible hypotheses, asking questions, and making observations also guide scientific research.
reference: Kon nyan sagai, eksperimen, ngön saboh eksperimen nakeuh saboh ujoe cuba dingui keu peugadoh saboh atawa leubѐh nyang mungkén, geuteumanyong ngön geupeugot peungamatan cit geupeumeuho peunelitian alami.
hypothesis: Nyan hanjeut sidroe, eksperimen, ngen eksperimen adalah tes yeng dipakek untuk meupeugadoh saboh atau leubeh hipotesis yeng mungken, meutuleh pertanyaan, ngen meujok pengamatan yeng cit meupeutunyok penelitian ilmiah.

source: Naturalists and philosophers focused on classical texts and, in particular, on the Bible in Latin.
reference: Naturalis ngön filusuf fokusjih bak tulesan jameun ngön, nyang meuteunte, bak Bible lamLaten.
hypothesis: Para ahli alam ngon filsuf geu peugöt teunuléh-teunuléh klasik, nyang paleng peunteng Alkitab lam basa Latin.

source: Accepted were Aristotle's views on all matters of science, including psychology.
reference: Diteurimong nakeuh peu nyang jipike Aristoteles bak mandum hai ilmee, jitamoeng cit pisikologi.
hypothesis: Pandangan Aristoteles tentang mandum peukara sains, teumasok psikologi, ji akseptasi.

source: As knowledge of Greek declined, the West found itself cut off from its Greek philosophical and scientific roots.
reference: Watѐe eleumee bah ureueng Yunani jitulak, Barat meureumpok droejih putoh nibak ukheu filosofi ngön ilmiah Yunani.
hypothesis: Seiring meukureung jih pengetahuan bahasa Yunani, Barat teurasa droe jih terputus dari akar filsafat dan sains Yunani.

source: Many observed rhythms in physiology and behavior often crucially depend on the presence of endogenous cycles and their production through biological clocks.
reference: Le ritme nyang geukalon lam fisiologi ngön sifeut kayém meusangkot bak na siklus endogen ngön geupeugoet lom rot jeum biologis.
hypothesis: Le ritme nyang ji amati lam fisiologi ngon perilaku seureng that meugantung bak na siklus endogen ngen produksi jih melalui jam biologis.

source: Periodic rhythms, which are not simply responses to external periodic cues, have been documented for most living beings, including bacteria, fungi, plants, and animals.
reference: Ritme periodik, nyang koen pah geusuot keu isyarat periodik iluwa, ka ireukam keu ladom makhlouk hudep, geutamoeng cit kumeun, kulat, bak kayee, ngön meulatang.
hypothesis: Ritme periodik, yeng han jeut keu tanggapan bak isyarat periodik eksternal, kaleuh didokumentasikan untuk sebagian rayek makhluk udep, termasuk bakteri, jamur, tumbuhan, ngen binatang.

source: Biological clocks are self sustaining oscillators which will continue a period of free-running cycling even in the absence of external cues.
reference: Jeum biologis nakeuh osilator geualami droe nyang neuk geulanjut saboh masa nibak lheuh-plueng bahpih hana syarat diluwa.
hypothesis: Jam biologis adalah osilator nyang dipeutahan droe yang akan melanjutkan periode siklus bebas bahkan tanpa adanya isyarat eksternal.

source: The Hershey and Chase experiment was one of the leading suggestions that DNA was a genetic material.
reference: Ujoecuba Hershey ngön Chase nakeuh salah saboh peundapat meuceuhu DNA nyan nakeuh saboh materi genetik.
hypothesis: Eksperimen Hershey ngen Chase adalah salah saboh saran utama bahwa DNA nyan adalah material genetik.

source: Hershey and Chase used phages, or viruses, to implant their own DNA into a bacterium.
reference: Hershey ngön Chase geungui fag, atawa virus, keu geutanoem DNA awak nyan lam kumeun.
hypothesis: Hershey ngen Chase meupakek fag, atau virus, keu ji implan DNA awak nyan keudroe lam bakteri.

source: They did two experiments marking either the DNA in the phage with a radioactive phosphorus or the protein of the phage with radioactive sulfur.
reference: Awak nyan geupubuet duwa ujoecuba geutanda DNA lam fag deungön fosfor radioaktif atawa protein nibak fag deungön sulfur radioaktif.
hypothesis: Awak nyan jipeuget dua eksperimen yang dipeutanda DNA lam fag ngen fosfor radioaktif atau protein fag ngen belerang radioaktif.

source: Mutations can have a variety of different effects depending on the type of mutation, the significance of the piece of genetic material affected and whether the cells affected are germ-line cells.
reference: Mutasijeuet na saboh jinѐh musabab meubeda meunuroet bak jinѐh mutasi, bagoe nyang peurteng nibak materi genetik jipeungaroh ngön pue sel nyang keunong nakeuh sel kumeun-gareh.
hypothesis: Mutasi jeut na macam-macam efek yeng meubeda tergantung bak jenis mutasi, signifikansi seutilah materi genetik yeng teurasa dan peu sel-sel yang teurasa adalah sel-sel garis germ.

source: Only mutations in germ-line cells can be passed on to children, while mutations elsewhere can cause cell-death or cancer.
reference: Sit mutasi bak sel kumeun-gareh jeuet geupeulewat keu aneuk, sangkira mutasi i teumpat laenjeuet keu sel-mate atawa kanker.
hypothesis: Hanya mutasi bak sel-sel garis germinal nyang jeut ji peutamong bak aneuk miet, seudangkan mutasi bak teumpat laen jeut menyebabkan kematian sel atau kanker.

source: Nature-based tourism attracts people interested in visiting natural areas for the purpose of enjoying the scenery, including plant and animal wildlife.
reference: Teumpat jak tamasya nyang meuheut ureueng keu geusaweu teumpat jak tamasya dengön niet peurasat peumandangan, teumasok bak seulaman ngön meulatang kleut.
hypothesis: Pariwisata berbasis alam menarik ureung yang tertarik untuk mengunjungi daerah alam untuk tujuan menikmati pemandangan, termasuk flora dan fauna liar.

source: Examples of on-site activities include hunting, fishing, photography, bird watching, and visiting parks and studying information about the ecosystem.
reference: Tamsejih buet siuroe –uroe bak droe teuh teumasok jak lam uteun, jak keumawe, jak cok gamba, jak tilek cicem, ngön jak saweu seulaman ngön jak seutot beurita bah ekosistem.
hypothesis: Contoh kegiatan di situs nyan termasuk berburu, mancing, fotografi, pengamat burung, dan mengunjungi taman dan mempelajari informasi tentang ekosistem.

source: An example is visiting, photographing, and learning about organgatuangs in Borneo.
reference: Saboh tamse nakeuh jak saweu, jak cok gamba, ngön jak meurunoe bah maw’ah i Kalimantan.
hypothesis: Contoh jih adalah jak ke, mefotografer, dan meuturi tentang organgatuang di Borneo.

source: Every morning, people leave small country towns in cars to go their workplace and are passed by others whose work destination is the place they have just left.
reference: Tiep beungoeh, ureueng-ureueng geukeubah gampong ngön moto geujak bak teumpat keureuja geuh ngön geulewat ureueng laen nyan niet geuh nyankeuh teumpat nyang baro siat nyoe geu keubah.
hypothesis: Tieb-tieb beungoh, ureung-ureung di gampong-gampong ubit jiduek bak mobil untuk jak u teumpat keureuja dan ji-ile lé ureung laen nyang tujuan keureuja jih nakeuh teumpat nyang ban awak nyan tinggai.

source: In this dynamic transport shuttle everyone is somehow connected with, and supporting, a transport system based on private cars.
reference: Lam transportasi jak tueng jak intat nyang dinamis nyoe, tiep droe ureueng aleh kiban geupeugoet sinambong, ngön sapeu kheun, deungön sistim transportasi asaijih moto droe.
hypothesis: Lam kapak transportasi yang dinamis nyoe, mandum ureung na hubong ngen, dan geu dukung, sistem transportasi nyang berbasis bak mobil pribadi.

source: Science now indicates that this massive carbon economy has dislodged the biosphere from one of its stable states that has supported human evolution for the past two million years.
reference: Ilmee jinoe jipeutunyoek bahwasajih ekonomi karbon kop jai ka geucabot bak salah saboh keadaan nyang get nyang sapeu kheun ngön dukong ureueng-ureueng nibak duwa juta thon akhée.
hypothesis: Ilmu pengetahuan jinoe dipeutunyok bahwa ekonomi karbon nyang rayek nyoe ka dipeucre biosfer dari salah saboh keadaan stabil jih nyang ka mendukung evolusi manusia lam dua juta thon nyang ka u likot.

source: Everyone participates in society and uses transportation systems. Almost everyone complains about transportation systems.
reference: Tiep-tiep ureueng sapeu kheun lam ureueng jai ngön geupakek sistim transportasi. Karab mandum ureueng geupeugah hai keu sistim transportasi.
hypothesis: Bandum ureung na lam masyarakat dan meupakek sistem transportasi.

source: In developed countries you seldom hear similar levels of complaints about water quality or bridges falling down.
reference: Bak nanggroe nyang ka maju droe neuh jareung that neu deungoe keuluhan nyang lage nyan lage ie nyang get atawa reuloeh tutue.
hypothesis: Di nanggroe-nanggroe maju, hana le nyang na keluhan nyang saban deungon nyang na di nanggroe nyan keuhai kualitas ie atawa jembatan nyang reuloh.

source: Why do transportation systems engender such complaints, why do they fail on a daily basis? Are transportation engineers just incompetent? Or is something more fundamental going on?
reference: Pakoen sistim transportasi itubiet kiban hai nyang lage nyan bagoe, pakoen awak nyan taloe tiep uroe? Peu insinyur trasnportasi nyan hana caroeng? Atawa asaijih na sipue-pue?
hypothesis: Pakon sistem transportasi geu peuget keluhan lage nyan, pakon sistem nyan gagal tiep uroe? peu kheueh insinyur transportasi nyan hana kompeten? atawa na yang leubeh peunteng nyang teujadi?

source: Traffic Flow is the study of the movement of individual drivers and vehicles between two points and the interactions they make with one another.
reference: Arah Lalu lintas nyankeuh saboh ilmee keu ureueng jak bak jalan ngön kandran nibak duwa titek ngön meupakat mandum.
hypothesis: Aliran lalu lintas adalah studi tentang gerakan pengemudi individu ngen kendaraan antara dua titik ngen interaksi yeng dipeuget ngen ureung laen.

source: Unfortunately, studying traffic flow is difficult because driver behavior cannot be predicted with one-hundred percent certainty.
reference: Sayang that, meurunoe arah lalu lintas nyan payah sabab buet ureueng mee moto hana tatuoh teubak seureutoh peursen.
hypothesis: sayang jih, meupelajari aliran lalu lintas nyan sulet kareuna perilaku supir hana jeut diprediksi deungen kepastian sireutoh persen.

source: Fortunately, drivers tend to behave within a reasonably consistent range; thus, traffic streams tend to have some reasonable consistency and can be roughly represented mathematically.
reference: Meuuntong, ureueng mee moto kayem geupubeut teutap lam kategori nyang saban; makajih, arah lalu lintas kayem na keuteutapan nyang rap saban ngön seucara gasa jeuet tapeuleumah seucara matematek.
hypothesis: Untung jih, pengemudi cenderung berperilaku dalam kisaran yeng konsisten; maka, aliran lalu lintas cenderung na konsistensi yeng wajar ngen jeut direpresentasikan secara matematis.

source: To better represent traffic flow, relationships have been established between the three main characteristics: (1) flow, (2) density, and (3) velocity.
reference: Keu tapeuleumah arah lalu lintas nyang leubѐh beutoi, kaleuh jipeugoet sinambong nibak lhee boh jinѐh nyang phôn-phôn that: (1) arah, (2) muatan, (3) keucepatan.
hypothesis: Untuk meujok gambaran nyang leubeh get tentang aliran lalu lintas, hubungan ka dipeudeng antara lhee karakteristik utama: (1) aliran, (2) kepadatan, ngon (3) kecepatan.

source: These relationships help in planning, design, and operations of roadway facilities.
reference: Sinambong nyoe meubantu lam peureuncanaan, desain, ngön operasi fasilitas bak jalan rayek.
hypothesis: Hubungan nyo membantu dalam perencanaan, desain, ngen operasi fasilitas jalan.

source: Insects were the first animals to take to the air. Their ability to fly helped them evade enemies more easily and find food and mates more efficiently.
reference: Seureungga nyankeuh meulatang phôn that meunafah. Ngön jeuet ipoe mangat meubantu droe ih jihindar deungön musoh ngön meurumpok makanan ngön rakan nyang get.
hypothesis: Keuteurangan nyan jeut keu alat keu awak nyan keu ji peulheueh musoh ngon leubeh mudah, keu jimita peunajoh ngon rakan-rakan nyang leubeh get.

source: Most insects have the advantage of being able to fold their wings back along the body.
reference: Jai seureungga meuguna sabab sayeupjih jeuet jilipat u likot ban saboh tuboh.
hypothesis: Le insect na keuntungan bahwa awak nyan jeut ji lipat sayeueb jih keu awak nyan.

source: This gives them a wider range of small places to hide from predators.
reference: Nyoe ibi keu awak nyan sep jai teumpat ubeuet keu i musom nibak peumangsa.
hypothesis: Nyan geubri keu jih leubèh le teumpat ubit keu meuseusöm nibak predator.

source: Today, the only insects that cannot fold back their wings are dragon flies and mayflies.
reference: Uroe nyoe, saboh-sabohjih seureungga nyang hanjeuet i lipat sayeupjih nyankeuh langöng ngönden-den.
hypothesis: Jinoe, saboh-saboh jih serangga nyang hana hase ji lipat sayeueb jih na kheueh lalat naga dan lalat mayfly.

source: Thousands of years ago, a man called Aristarchus said that the Solar System moved around the Sun.
reference: Meuribe thon nyang ka ulikot, sidroe ureueng agam nanjih Aristarchus geupeugah bahwasajih Tata Surya meugrak-grak iputa Mata Uroe.
hypothesis: Ribuan thon nyang ka leupah, sidroe ureueng nyang nanjih Aristarchus geupeugah bahwa Tata Surya meugrak di seukeulileng Mata uroe.

source: Some people thought he was right but many people believed the opposite; that the Solar System moved around the Earth, including the Sun (and even the other stars).
reference: Padum droe ureueng geupike droegeuh beutoi tapih jai ureueng geupateh seubalekjih; Tata Surya nyan meugrak-grak iputa Bumoe, teumasok Mata Uroe (ngön bahpih bintang-bintang nyang laen).
hypothesis: Ladom ureung pike jih beutoi tapi le ureung peucaya kebalikan jih; bahwa Tata Surya bergerak di sekitar Bumo, termasuk Mata uroe (dan bahkan bintang laen).

source: This seems sensible, because the Earth doesn't feel as if it's moving, does it?
reference: Nyoe sang itamoeng lam akai, sabab Bumoe hana ta thei meugrak-grak, koen?
hypothesis: Nyan deuh jih bijaksana, kareuna bumoe hana deuh lagee meugrak, nyan?

source: The Amazon River is the second longest and the biggest river on Earth. It carries more than 8 times as much water as the second biggest river.
reference: Krueng amazon nakeuh krueng paleng panyang ngön paleng rayek i donya. Jih jipeuilee ie leubeh dari 8 goe le dari krueng keudua nyang paleng rayek.
hypothesis: Krueng Amazon nakeuh krueng nyang paleng panyang ngon paleng rayek nyang keudua di bumoe. Krueng nyoe na leubeh dari 8 goe leuh dari krueng nyang paleng rayek nyang keudua.

source: The Amazon is also the widest river on Earth, at times six miles wide.
reference: Krueng Amazon pih krueng paleng luwah i donya, na luwah meu nam mil.
hypothesis: Amazon cit krueng paleng luwah di bumoe, kadang-kadang luwah jih siploh kilometer.

source: A full 20 percent of the water that pours out of the planet's rivers into the oceans comes from the Amazon.
reference: 20 peureusen punoh ie nyang dilee lam krueng asaijih bak krueng Amazon.
hypothesis: 20% dari ie nyang ji ile u laot dari krueng-krueng planet nyoe asai jih di Amazon.

source: The main Amazon River is 6,387 km (3,980 miles). It collects water from thousands of smaller rivers.
reference: Krueng Amazon nyang utama nyankeuh 6.387 km (3.980 mil). Nyan dipeusapat ie dari meuribee krueng-krueng nyan leubѐh ubeut.
hypothesis: Krueng Amazon nyang paleng rayek na panyang jih 6.387 kilometer.

source: Although pyramid-building in stone continued until the end of the Old Kingdom, the pyramids of Giza were never surpassed in their size and the technical excellence of their construction.
reference: Adakpih piramida nyang dipeudong ngön batee nyan mantông na sampoe akhé Keurajeuen Tuha, piramida-piramida bak Giza nyan han tom dikoh bak ukoran ngön hai teknisjih nyang jroh watѐe nyan dipeudong.
hypothesis: Meskipun peudong piramida di bateu manteng sampoe akhe Keurajeuën Laen, piramida Giza hana pernah di surabaya dalam ukuran jih dan keunggulan teknis konstruksi jih.

source: New Kingdom ancient Egyptians marvelled at their predecessors monuments, which were then well over a thousand year old.
reference: Keurajeuen Baro ureueng Meuse jameun dilee nyan teukeuch’ak bak monumen endatu awak nyan, nyang teutap got sampoe siribee thon leubѐh.
hypothesis: Bangsa Mesir kuno masa Keurajaan Baroe kagum bak monumen-monumen pendahulu jih, yeng bak watee nyan lubeh dari siribée thon.

source: Vatican City's population is around 800. It is the smallest independent country in the world and the country with the lowest population.
reference: Jumlah ureueng nyang tinggai bak Kuta Vatikan nyankeuh kureueng leubѐh 800. Nyankeuh nanggroe meurdehka nyang paleng ubeut i donya ngön nanggroe nyang paleng dit ureueng tinggai.
hypothesis: Kota Vatikan na populasi sekitar 800. nyan adalah nanggroe independen paleng ubit di donya dan nanggroe deungen populasi paleng ubit.

source: Vatican City uses Italian in its legislation and official communications.
reference: Kuta Vatikan dingui Basa Itali lam kanun ngön lam buet peugah haba resmi awak nyan.
hypothesis: Kota Vatikan meupakek bahasa Italia dalam undang-undang jih dan komunikasi resmi.

source: Italian is also the everyday language used by most of those who work in the state while Latin is often used in religious ceremonies.
reference: Basa Itali pih jeuet keu basa siuroe-uroe nyang dingui le dum ureueng nyang keureuja bak nanggroe nyan seudangkan Basa Laten kayém dingui bak acara-acara agama.
hypothesis: Bahasa Italia cit bahasa sehari-hari yang dipakek le ureung yang bekerja di negara bagian nyan sementara bahasa Latin seureng dipakek dalam upacara agama.

source: All citizens of Vatican City are Roman Catholic.
reference: Mandum ureueng nyang tinggai bak Kuta Vatikan nyan Katolik Roma.
hypothesis: Bandum warga Kota Vatikan nakeuh Katolik Roma.

source: People have known about basic chemical elements such as gold, silver, and copper from antiquity, as these can all be discovered in nature in native form and are relatively simple to mine with primitive tools.
reference: Ureueng ka ditupeue teuntang punca zat-zat kimia lagѐe meuh, pirak, ngön teumaga dari jameun dilee, nyang nyoe jeuet diteumee bak alam lam beuntuk asaijih ngön biasajih mangat geukueh deungon peukakah-peukakah primitif.
hypothesis: Ureueng ka meuphom tentang unsur kimia dasar lage méuh, pirak, ngen tembaga dari jameun, kareuna mandum nyan jeut ditumeng di alam dalam bentuk asli ngen relatif mudah untuk dipeuget deungon alat primitif.

source: Aristotle, a philosopher, theorised that everything is made up of a mixture of one or more of four elements. They were earth, water, air, and fire.
reference: Aristotle, sidroe ahli filsafat, geupeugot teori bahwasajih dumpeue nyan dipeugot dari saboh rampoe dari saboh atawa leubѐh dari peuet boh zat. Nyan nyankeuh tanoh, ie, udara, ngön apui.
hypothesis: Aristoteles, sidroe filsuf, geu peubeuet bahwa mandum makhluk nyan geupeugot nibak seusaboh atawa leubeh unsur nyang phon, nyan kheueh bumoe, ié, udara, dan apui.

source: This was more like the four states of matter (in the same order): solid, liquid, gas, and plasma, though he also theorised that they change into new substances to form what we see.
reference: Nyoe leubѐh lagѐe peuet boh sipheuet dari beunda (lam susonan nyang saban): kreueh, caye, gah, ngön plasma, adak gobnyan pih geupeugot teori bahwasajih nyan meugantoe jeuet keu asoe-asoe baro meubeuntuk sipeue-peue nyang takalon.
hypothesis: Nyo leubeh lagee peut keadaan materi (dalam urutan yeng sama): padat, cair, gas, ngen plasma, meskipun jih juga berteori bahwa awak nyan meubah jeut keu zat baro untuk meu bentuk peue nyang tanyoe kalon.

source: Alloys are basically a mixture of two or more metals. Don't forget that there are many elements on the periodic table.
reference: Beuso nyang meujampu nyankeuh puncajih saboh rampoe dari duwa boh atawa leubѐh beuso. Bek tuwo bahwasajih jai that zat-zat bak meh periodik.
hypothesis: paduan nyan seucara prinsipjih adalah campuran dari dua atau leubeh logam. hanjeut lon lupa bahwa na le elemen bak tabel periodik

source: Elements like calcium and potassium are considered metals. Of course, there are also metals like silver and gold.
reference: Zat-zat lagѐe kalsium ngön kalium nyan dikheun beuso. Nyan ka mupeue, na sit beuso lagѐe pirak ngon meuh.
hypothesis: Unsur-unsur lage kalsium ngen kalium dianggap logam. Tentu, na cit logam lage pirak ngen méuh.

source: You can also have alloys that include small amounts of non-metallic elements like carbon.
reference: Gata jeuet sit neuteumee beuso nyang meujampu nyang roh zat-zat nyang koen beuso lam jumlah ubeut lagѐe karbon.
hypothesis: Droeneuh jeut na paduan yang na jumlah ubit unsur non-logam lage karbon.

source: Everything in the Universe is made of matter. All matter is made of tiny particles called atoms.
reference: Mandum nyang na bak Alam Semesta nyan dipeugot dari zat. Mandum zat nyan dipeugot dari partikel ubeut nanjih atom.
hypothesis: Bandum di alam semesta nyan teupeuget dari materi. Bandum materi nyan teupeuget dari partikel ubit nyang geuboh nan atom.

source: Atoms are so incredibly tiny that trillions of them could fit into the period at the end of this sentence.
reference: Atom nyan that brat ubeut nyang meutriliun awak nyan jeuet lot u dalam titek bak akhé kalimat nyoe.
hypothesis: Atom nyan that ubit sampoe triliun jih jeut keu bagian dari titik di akhe kalimat nyoe.

source: Thus, the pencil was a good friend to many people when it came out.
reference: Dengön lagѐe nyoe, gense nyankeuh rakan nyang get keu ureueng rame watѐe jipeutubiet.
hypothesis: Jadi, pensil nyan jeut keu rakan nyang get keu le ureung watee nyan dipeutubit.

source: Sadly, as newer methods of writing have emerged, the pencil has been relegated to lesser status and uses.
reference: Nyang seudehjih, sabab cara tuleh nyang baro ka jitubiet, gense jipeutron keu status sosial ngön manfaat nyang leubѐh jroh.
hypothesis: Teuma seudeh jih, kareuna na cara teunuléh nyang barô, pensil ka hana le peuneuguna.

source: People now write messages on computer screens, never having to come close to a sharpener.
reference: Ureueng jinoe geutuleh peusan bak layeu komputer, hana suwah peutoe droe ngön cui gense.
hypothesis: Ureueng jinoë geutuléh haba bak layar komputer, hana peureulèe geupeurab bak alat peugleh.

source: One can only wonder what the keyboard will become when something newer comes along.
reference: Ureueng jeuet keu mumang jeuetkeu pue keyboard nyan meusapue hana jitubit.
hypothesis: Sidroe jeut hanya teukeujot peue nyang keyboard jeut watee na yang baro teuka.

source: The fission bomb works on the principle that it takes energy to put together a nucleus with many protons and neutrons.
reference: Bom fisi jikeureuja meuasai bak prinsip bahwa jipeureulee keukuatan keu peusapat inti deungön proton ngön neutron.
hypothesis: Bom fisi bekerja bak prinsip bahwa dibutuhkan energi untuk meusabohkan inti deungen le proton ngen neutron.

source: Sort of like rolling a heavy cart up a hill. Splitting the nucleus up again then releases some of that energy.
reference: Lagѐe tagulong geuritan nyang geuhoen u ateuh buket. Geuplah nukleus lom teuma geupeuleuh ladom keukuatan nyan.
hypothesis: Lagee geulengkang gerbong beurat bak bukit. geuplahkan inti lom, dan geupeuleueh sebagian energi nyan.

source: Some atoms have unstable nuclei which means that they tend to break apart with little or no nudging.
reference: Padum-padum boh atom na inti nyang hana timang nyang meumakna bahwa beukah bacut atawa hana suwah tatulak.
hypothesis: Ladom atom na inti yeng hana stabil yeng meuarti bahwa awak nyan cenderung meupecah-pecah deungen bacut atau hana nudging.

source: The surface of the Moon is made of rocks and dust. The outer layer of the Moon is called the crust.
reference: Ateuh buleuen jipeugoet dari bate ngön abee. Lapeh iluwa buleuen jikheun krak.
hypothesis: Buta buleun nyan teupeuget nibak bate ngon leubeng. Lapeh lua buleun nyan geuboh nan kerak.

source: The crust is about 70 km thick on the near side and 100 km thick on the far side.
reference: Krak jih teubai sangkira 70 km i bagian nyang toe ngön teubai 100 km i bagian nyang jiohjih.
hypothesis: kerak nyan kira-kira 70 km ketebalan di sisi to ngen 100 km ketebalan di sisi u likot.

source: It is thinner under the maria and thicker under the highlands.
reference: Leubѐh lipeh imiyup maria ngown leubѐh teubai imiyup dataran manyang.
hypothesis: Leubeh tipis di miyueb maria ngen leubeh leubèh leubèh teupat di miyueb dataran tinggi.

source: There may be more maria on the near side because the crust is thinner. It was easier for lava to rise up to the surface.
reference: Mungkén na leubѐh jai maria bak arah toe sabab krakjih leubѐh lipeh. Laha leubѐh mudah jiek u ateuh tanoh.
hypothesis: mungken na leubeh maria di sisi dket karena kerak jih leubeh tipis. leubeh mudah bagi lava untuk naik ke permukaan.

source: Content theories are centered on finding what makes people tick or appeals to them.
reference: Tiori kontent pusat jih bak jitume pue nyang peugoet ureueng meugrak atawa meutarékjih.
hypothesis: Teori konten berpusat bak meurumpok peue nyang peuget ureung meugrak atawa meupeurhot keu awak nyan.

source: These theories suggest that people have certain needs and/or desires which have been internalized as they mature to adulthood.
reference: Tiori-tiori nyoe jipeutunyoek bahwa ureueng na peureulee ngön/atawa heut meuteunte nyang ka meuleukap bak droe watѐe awaknyan rayek sampoe tuha.
hypothesis: Teori-teori nyo geu sarankan bahwa ureng na kebutuhan dan/atau keinginan tertentu yeng kaleuh dipenetralisasi seulama awak nyan meuasah sampoe dewasa.

source: These theories look at what it is about certain people that make them want the things that they do and what things in their environment will make them do or not do certain things.
reference: Tiori-tiori nyoe jikaloen bak pue teuntang ureueng-ureueng meuteunte nyang peugoet awaknyan galak jipubuet hai-hai nyang awaknyan pubuet ngön hai-hai pue nyang mantông nyang i silingka awaknyan nyang neukpeugot awanyan pubuet atawa hana pubuet hai-hai meuteunte.
hypothesis: Teori-teori nyo geu pandang peu yang na tentang ureung tertentu yang peuget awak nyan meuheut hai-hai yang awak nyan peubuet dan peu hal-hal di lingkungan awak nyan akan peuget awak nyan untuk peuget atau hana peuget hai-hai tertentu.

source: Two popular content theories are Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs Theory and Hertzberg's Two Factor Theory.
reference: Duwa boh tiori konten nyang ka meuceuhu nyankeuh tiori Hirarki neuhet Maslow ngön tiori duwa faktor Hertzberg.
hypothesis: Dua teori konten yang populer adalah Hierarki Teori Kebutuhan Maslow ngen Teori Dua Faktor Hertzberg.

source: Generally speaking, two behaviors can emerge as managers begin to lead their former peers. One end of the spectrum is trying to remain “one of the guys” (or gals).
reference: Seucara umum, duwa boh peukateun jitubiet watѐe menejer geumulai pimpin ureueng keureuja nyang ilikot awaknyan. Salah saboh ujoeng spektrum jiujoe keu teutap jeuet keu salah sidroe ureueng agam” (atawa ureueng inoeng).
hypothesis: Seucara umum, dua perilaku jeut muncul seulama manajer mulai memimpin mantan rekan-rekan jih.

source: This type of manager has difficulty making unpopular decisions, performing disciplinary action, performance evaluations, assigning responsibility, and holding people accountable.
reference: Menejer tipe nyoe jirasa sosah peugot peunutoh nyang hana meuceuhu, geupubuet buet disiplin, evaluasi keureuja, jok tanggung jaweub ngön lakee tanggong jaweub ureueng.
hypothesis: Jenis manajer nyoe na kesulitan untuk meujok keputusan yang hana populer, meujok tindakan disiplin, evaluasi kinerja, meujok tanggung jawab, dan meukumat ureung keu bertanggung jawab.

source: At the other end of the spectrum, one morphs into an unrecognizable individual that feels he or she must change everything the team has been doing and make it their own.
reference: Bak ujoeng laen spektrum, sidroe-droe ureueng meu ubah-ubahjeuet keu ureueng nyang hana jituri meurasa suwah jiubah mandum nyang ka jipeugot keulompok ngön jeuet peugot ata droeih.
hypothesis: Di ujong laen dari spektrum, sidroe jiubah jeut keu individu nyang hana ji teume nyang meurasa jih harus ji ubah mandum nyang ji peuget awak nyan dan ji peuget jih keu droe jih.

source: After all, the leader is ultimately responsible for the success and failure of the team.
reference: Adak meurangkaban, peupimpin bak seuneulheuh tanggong jaweub ateuh meuhase ngön hana meuhase keu keulompok.
hypothesis: Seulaen nyan, pemimpin nyan keuh nyang bertanggung jawab keu sukses dan kegagalan tim.

source: This behavior oftentimes results in rifts between the leaders and the rest of the team.
reference: Peukateun nyoe kayém meu akibat karu antara peumimpin ngön anggota keulompok tim laenjih.
hypothesis: Perilaku nyo seureng meuakibat keu peucaroh antara pemimpin ngen sisok tim.

source: Virtual teams are held to the same standards of excellence as conventional teams, but there are subtle differences.
reference: Keulompok Virtual na keuh standar utama nyang sama deungön keulompok konvensional, tapih na peubeda bacut.
hypothesis: Tim virtual dipeuget deungen standar keunggulan yang sama deungen tim konvensional, teutapi na perbedaan yeng subtle.

source: Virtual team members often function as the point of contact for their immediate physical group.
reference: Anggota keulompok virtual kayém meufungsi sebagoe titek kontak keu keulompok fisik langsông awak nyan.
hypothesis: Anggota tim virtual seureng berfungsi seubagai titik kontak untuk kelompok fisik jih.

source: They often have more autonomy than conventional team members as their teams may meet according to varying time zones which may not be understood by their local management.
reference: Awak nyan kayém na leubѐh jai otonomi nibak anggota keulompok konvensional sabab keulompok awak nyan na meurumpok seusuai deungön zona watѐe nyang meubeda nyang mungkén han jimuphom le manajemen lokal awak nyan.
hypothesis: Awak nyan seureng na otonomi leubeh le daripada anggota tim konvensional kareuna awak nyan jeut meurumpok meunurot zona wate yeng meubeda yeng mungken hana dipahami le manajemen lokal awak nyan.

source: The presence of a true “invisible team” (Larson and LaFasto, 1989, p109) is also a unique component of a virtual team.
reference: Wujud nyang nyata dari "keulompok hana deuh" nyang seubetoijih (Larson ngön LaFasto, 1989, p109) nyan keuh komponen unik nibak keulompok virtual sit.
hypothesis: Kehadiran tim nyata yang hana deuh (Larson dan LaFasto, 1989, p109) cit merupakan komponen unik dari tim virtual.

source: The “invisible team” is the management team to which each of the members report. The invisible team sets the standards for each member.
reference: "Keulompok hana deuh" nyan keuh keulompok manajemen nyang maseng-maseng anggota peulapor. Keulompok hana deuh peuteutap standar keu tip anggota.
hypothesis: Tim yang hana deuh nyan adalah tim manajemen yang di peuget laporan keu anggota jih. Tim yang hana deuh nyan geu tentukan standar keu setiap anggota.

source: Why would an organization want to go through the time consuming process of establishing a learning organization? One goal for putting organizational learning concepts into practice is innovation.
reference: Pakon saboh organisasi nyan geutem buet peuabeh watѐe keu geupeudong saboh organisasi meureuno? Saboh tujuan geupeugot konsep organisasi meureuno keu praktek nakeuh inovasi.
hypothesis: Pakon organisasi akan ingin melalui proses yang memakan waktu untuk membangun organisasi pembelajaran? salah saboh tujuan untuk menerapkan konsep pembelajaran organisasi adalah inovasi.

source: When all available resources are effectively used across the functional departments of an organization, creativity and ingenuity can transpire.
reference: watѐe hai-hai nyang peureulee beuna nyangengui ngön get meulingke ban saboh bahagian nyang udep dari saboh organisasi, daya cipta ngön hai nyang aseuli nyanjeuet keu buet.
hypothesis: Wate mandum sumber daya nyang na secara efektif dipakek di mandum departemen fungsional organisasi, kreativitas ngen kecerdasan jeut tertransfer.

source: As a result, the process of an organization working together to overcome an obstacle can lead to a new innovative process to serve the customer's need.
reference: Nyanjeuet wase, buet dari saboeh organisasi nyang dikeureuja sama ban mandum keu geupeuthen meubagoe hai nyang meulinteng akan geuba lam saboh buet inovasi nyang baro keu tajok pue nyang dipeureule le ureueng nyang ngui.
hypothesis: Akibat jih, proses organisasi yang bekerja sama untuk mengatasi hambatan jeut meupeulaku proses inovatif baro untuk meupeutimang kebutuhan pelanggan.

source: Before an organization can be innovative, leadership must create a culture of innovation as well as shared knowledge and organizational learning.
reference: Sigolom saboh organisasi nyan jeuet geu inovasi, peumimpin suwah geupeuna saboh budaya inovasi saban cit keu meubagi euleume ngön meureuno organisasi.
hypothesis: Seugolom organisasi jeut inovatif, kepemimpinan harus geu peuget budaya inovasi seureuta pengetahuan bersama dan pembelajaran organisasi.

source: Angel (2006), explains the Continuum approach as a method being used to help organizations reach a higher level of performance.
reference: Angel (2006), geupeutrang akan cara nyang hana putoh keu saboh cara keu tulong organisasi keu meureumpok level nyang leubѐh manyang bak buet.
hypothesis: Angel (2006), geupeutrang pendekatan Kontinuum seubagai metode nyang dipakek untuk membantu organisasi mencapai tingkat kinerja nyang leubeh manyang.

source: Neurobiological data provide physical evidence for a theoretical approach to the investigation of cognition. Therefore it narrows the research area and makes it much more exact.
reference: Data euleume saraf biologi nyan geupeuna bukti nyang nyata keu cara saboh teori keu geu kalon wase. Nyankeuh nyoe di peu ubit wilayah keu geumeusetot ngön nyoe jeuet keu leubѐh teupat.
hypothesis: Data neurobiologi geubi bukti fisik keu pendekatan teoritis keu penyelidikan kognisi.

source: The correlation between brain pathology and behaviour supports scientists in their research.
reference: Hubongan nibak euleume peunyaket utak ngön peukateun nyankeuh nyang tulong para euleumewan lam geumeusetot ureuengnyan.
hypothesis: Hubungan antara patologi otak ngen perilaku geu dukung le ilmuwan dalam penelitian awak nyan.

source: It has been known for a long time that different types of brain damage, traumas, lesions, and tumours affect behaviour and cause changes in some mental functions.
reference: Nyoe ka diteupue nibak jameun koen bahawa meubeudaluka nyang keunong lam utak, trauma, luka, ngön tumor nyan na peungaroh keu peukateun ureueng ngön jeuet keu seubab bak fungsi mental.
hypothesis: Ka treb that dituri bahwa jenis luka otak, trauma, lesi, ngen tumor meubantu perilaku ngon meupeulaku perubahan bak fungsi mental.

source: The rise of new technologies allows us to see and investigate brain structures and processes never seen before.
reference: Dengön dibeudoh euleume teknologi ka geupeujeuet tanyoe keu takalon ngön ta meureuno bentuk utak ngön cara nyang hana tom na takalon awai.
hypothesis: Muncul jih teknologi baro memungkinkan geutanyoe untuk melihat dan menyelidiki struktur dan proses otak yang hana pernah dilihat sebelumnya.

source: This provides us with a lot of information and material to build simulation models which help us to understand processes in our mind.
reference: Nyoe keuh nyang geubrie keu geutanyoe jai that euleueme ngön meubago benda keujeuet tabangun saboh model keu peuleumah nyang akan geutulong geutanyoe bak ta meuphom akan pue nyang keujadian nyang na lam utak geutanyo.
hypothesis: Nyo geubri kamoe le informasi ngon bahan untuk peuget model simulasi nyang membantu kamoe meuphom proses lam pikiran tanyoe.

source: Although AI has a strong connotation of science fiction, AI forms a very important branch of computer science, dealing with behavior, learning and intelligent adaptation in a machine.
reference: Adakpi AI nyan nah ai nyang kong lam euleume sains hayal, AI nyan jipeudong saboh cabeung lam euleume sains komputer, nyang meuhubong noen peukateun, meureuno ngön caroengjih saboh meusen lam adaptasi.
hypothesis: Meskipun AI na konotasi yang kuat dari fiksi sains, AI geu bentuk cabang yang that peunteng nibak ilme komputer, meupeuget perilaku, pembelajaran ngon adaptasi cerdas lam saboh mesin.

source: Research in AI involves making machines to automate tasks that require intelligent behavior.
reference: Geumeusetot lam AI nyan na roh keu peuget meusen nyan beu jipubuet buet keu otomatis nyang peureulee keu peukaten nyang hayeu.
hypothesis: Penelitian dalam AI na meulibat peuget mesin keu mengotomatisasi tugas yeng perle perilaku cerdas.

source: Examples include control, planning and scheduling, the ability to answer customer diagnoses and questions, as well as handwriting recognition, voice and face.
reference: Tamsejih na roh keu kontrol, reuncana ngön boh jadwal, jeuet keu i jaweub diagnosa ngön pertanyaan ureueng nyang geungui, lagѐe cit meuphom kheuet ngön jaro, su atawa wajah.
hypothesis: Contoh jih termasuk kontrol, perencanaan ngen penjadwalan, kemampuan untuk meujawab diagnosis pelanggan ngen pertanyaan, seurta pengenalan tulisan tangan, suara ngen wajah.

source: Such things have become separate disciplines, which focus on providing solutions to real life problems.
reference: Hai-hai lagѐe nyan kajeuet keu cabeung euleume nyang meubeda, lage takalon beu timang bak ta brie jawaban keu masalah nyang na lam udep.
hypothesis: Hal-hal lage nyan ka jeut keu disiplin yang terpisah, yang berfokus bak peuget solusi keu masalah kehidupan nyata.

source: The AI ​​system is now often used in the fields of economics, medicine, engineering and the military, as has been built in several home computer and video game software applications.
reference: Sistem AI nyoe jino kayém dingui lam bideung ekonomi, ubat, meusen ngön militer, lage nyang ka dipeugot le ladomkomputer rumoh ngön aplikasi software video keumeu’en.
hypothesis: Sistem AI jino seureng dipakek di bidang ekonomi, kedokteran, teknik ngen militer, lage ka dibangun lam padum boh aplikasi perangkat lunak komputer rumoh ngen video game.

source: Field trips are a large part of any classroom. Quite often a teacher would love to take her students places to which a bus trip is not an option.
reference: Jak meu’en nyan nakeuh bahagian nyang rayeuk lam dum glah. Kayém that sidroe guree galak geuba murid u teumpat-teumpat nyang hana dijak moto bes sebagoe saboh pilehan.
hypothesis: Ureueng-ureueng nyang na di rumoh-rumoh nyan hana galak keu peurunoe, sabab nyan kheueh nyang jeuet keu alasan keu awaknyan mangat jeuet jijak u rumoh-rumoh nyang hana jipeuna peurunoe.

source: Technology offers the solution with virtual field trips. Students can look at museum artifacts, visit an aquarium, or admire beautiful art while sitting with their class.
reference: Tehnologi geupeutaba solusi deungon saweu lapangan virtual. Peulajarjeuet meukalon artefak meuseum artefak, saweu akuarium, atawa takjub keu seni nyang ceudah sira duek deungon tingkat awak nyan.
hypothesis: Teknologi na solusi deungon perjalanan lapangan virtual. Siswa jeut melihat artefak museum, kunjungi akuarium, atawa mengagumi seni indah seulama duduk bersama kelas mereka.

source: Sharing a field trip virtually is also a great way to reflect a on a trip and share experiences with future classes.
reference: Geubri saweu lapangan virtual nakeuh saboh cara nyang get keu heut bak saboh saweu ngön geubri peungalaman deungön tingkat ukeu.
hypothesis: Meugesa-gesa saboh kunjungan lapangan secara virtual cit cara yang get untuk meupeuleumah saboh perjalanan dan meubagi pengalaman deungen kelas masa ukeu.

source: For example, each year students from Bennet School in North Carolina design a website about their trip to the State Capital, each year the website gets remodeled, but old versions are kept online to serve as a scrapbook.
reference: Miseujih, tip thon peulajar nibak Sikula Bennet bak Carolina Utara geupeugot saboh situs web teuntang saweu awak nyan u ibu kuta nanggroe, tip thon situs web jipeubaro teuma, tapih bagoe awai dikeubah seucara online keu jipeugot saboh kliping.
hypothesis: Miseu jih, tiep thon mahasiswa dari Bennet School di Carolina Utara geu desain website tentang perjalanan awak nyan u ibu kota negara bagian, tiep thon website nyan geu ubah, tapi versi jameun jih dipeutahan online untuk jeut keu scrapbook.

source: Blogs can also help improve student writing. While students often begin their blog experience with sloppy grammar and spelling, the presence of an audience generally changes that.
reference: Blogjeuet cit geubantu meutamah get peulajar geuteumuleh. Seudangkan peulajar kayém peuphôn peungalaman blog awak nyan deungön tata basa ngön ejaan nyang beurangkaho, geujak ureueng kaloen umumjih meuubah nyan.
hypothesis: Blog jeut cit membantu peunyaket siswa. seudangkan mahasiswa seureng that memulai pengalaman blog jih deungen tata bahasa dan ejaan yang hana teupat, kehadiran penonton umum jih meubah.

source: Since students are often the most critical audience, the blog writer begins to strive to improve writing to avoid criticism.
reference: watѐe peulajar kayém jeuet keu ureung kaloen paleng kritis, peunuleh blog mulai geumeurenoe keu meutamah get teumuleh bah hana jikritek.
hypothesis: Kareuna mahasiswa seureng that jeut keu penonton yang paleng kritis, penulis blog mulai meu usaha untuk meu peubaroh tulisan jih mangat hana ji kritik.

source: Also blogging "forces students to become more savvy about the world around them." The need to feed the interest of the audience inspires students to be clever and interesting (Toto, 2004).
reference: Pih blog "geupaksa peulajar keu leubѐh meuphom teuntang donya silingka awak nyan." Peurle keu geujok minat ureueng kalon jitubiet seumangat peulajar keu caroeng ngön meunarek (Toto, 2004).
hypothesis: Meunan cit blogging "meukreuh aneuk miet keu jeut leubeh bijaksana tentang donya di sekitar jih". Keperluan untuk meupeutroe minat penonton menginspirasi aneuk miet untuk cerdas dan menarik (Toto, 2004).

source: Blogging is a tool that inspires collaboration, and encourages students to extend learning well beyond the traditional school day.
reference: Blog nakeuh saboh peukakah nyang woe seumangat kolaborasi, ngön geupeuseumangat peulajar keu geupeulwuah meurenoe jioh leupah uroe sikula tradisional.
hypothesis: Blogging nyan adalah alat nyang menginspirasi kolaborasi, dan geu peukhong mahasiswa untuk meulangkah leubeh leupah dari hari sekolah tradisional.

source: Appropriate use of blogs "can empower students to become more analytical and critical; through actively responding to Internet materials, students can define their positions in the context of others' writings as well as outline their own perspectives on particular issues (Oravec, 2002).
reference: Geungui blog nyang seusuai "jeuet geupeudaya peulajar keu jeuet leubѐh analitis ngön kritis; rhot aktif geutanggapi materi internet, peulajar jeuet peutente teupat awak nyan lam kontek ureueng laen’ geuteumuleh cara geukaloen awak nyan bak haba-haba meuteunte (Oravec, 2002).
hypothesis: "Penggunaan blog nyang paih jeut geupeukong siswa untuk jeut leubeh analitis dan kritis; melalui bereaksi aktif keu materi Internet, siswa jeut geu tentukan posisi awak nyan dalam konteks tulisan ureung laen seureuta geu garis-garis perspektif awak nyan keudroe teuntang isu-isu tertentu (Oravec, 2002).

source: Ottawa is Canada's charming, bilingual capital and features an array of art galleries and museums that showcase Canada's past and present.
reference: Ottawa nakeuh Kanada nyang ceudah, ibu kuta duwa basa ngön geupeukaleon mandum teumpat keuneubah seuni ngön museum nyang geupeuleumah Kanada awai ngön jinoe.
hypothesis: Ottawa adalah ibu kota Kanada yang indah, bilingual, dan na le galeri seni dan museum yang memamerkan masa lalu dan masa kini Kanada.

source: Farther south is Niagara Falls and the north is home to the untapped natural beauty of the Muskoka and beyond.
reference: Leubѐh jioh u tunong nakeuh ie terjun Niagara ngön blah baroh nakeuh rumoh alam nyang ceudah Muskoka ngön alheueh nibak nyan.
hypothesis: Teungoh u selatan na Niagara Falls dan di utara na keindahan alam nyang gohlom ji use di Muskoka dan di luwa jih.

source: All these things and more highlight Ontario as what is considered quintessentially Canadian by outsiders.
reference: Mandum hai nyoe ngön leubѐh geupeurayeuk Ontario seubagoe peu nyang jipeusangka muasaih Kanada le ureueng luwa.
hypothesis: Bandum hal nyo ngen leubeh le geu peuleumah Ontario seubagai peue nyang dianggap seucara khas Kanada le ureung luwa.

source: Large areas further north are quite sparsely populated and some is nearly uninhabited wilderness.
reference: Wilayah luwah leubѐh jioh u baroh jareung ureueng tinggai ngön meupadum nakeuh uteun nyang hana ureueng tinggai.
hypothesis: Wilayah rayek di utara lubeh hana le penduduk jih dan padum-padum boh wilayah nyan hampir hana ureung duek.

source: For a comparison of population that surprises many: There are more African Americans living in the US than there are Canadian citizens.
reference: Keu geubandeng populasi nyang peukeujot le ureueng: na leubѐh jai ureueng Afrika Ameurika tinggai bak AS nibak ureueng nanggroe Kanada.
hypothesis: Untuk peubandeng populasi nyang mengejutkan le ureung: na leubeh le ureung Afrika Amerika nyang tinggai di Amerika Serikat daripada na rakyat Kanada.

source: The East African Islands are in the Indian Ocean off the eastern coast of Africa.
reference: Pulo-pulo Afrika Timue nakeuh bak Samudra Hindia bak meuhalak Pasi Afrika Timue.
hypothesis: Pulo-pulo Afrika Timu na di La'ot Hindia di seupanyang pantai timu Afrika.

source: Madagascar is by far the biggest, and a continent on its own when it comes to wildlife.
reference: Madagaskar nyankeuh nyang paleng rayeuk ngön beunua droe ih lam hai meulatang kleut.
hypothesis: Madagaskar adalah nyang paleng rayek, dan saboh benua yang leubeh rayek dari pada binatang liar.

source: Most of the smaller islands are independent nations, or associated with France, and known as luxury beach resorts.
reference: Ladom pulo-pulo ubeut nyankeuh nanggroe ka meurdeka, atawa meusangkot ngön basa Prancis, teumpat eh bineh pasi ngön ceudah lagoina.
hypothesis: Sebagian rayek pulau-pulau ubit nyan adalah bansa nyang independen, atawa meuhubong deungen Prancis, dan diteupeu seubagoe resor pantai mewah.

source: The Arabs also brought Islam to the lands, and it took in a big way in the Comoros and Mayotte.
reference: Ureueng Arab pih geume Islam u bumoe, ngön geupeureulee seucara meugah i Comoros ngön Mayotte.
hypothesis: Ureueng Arab cit geuba Islam u nanggroe nyan, dan Islam nyan that meutabu di Comoros ngon Mayotte.

source: European influence and colonialism began in the 15th century, as Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama found the Cape Route from Europe to India.
reference: Peungaroh ngön peunjajahan Eropa ka jimulai bak abad keu-15, watee ureueng Portugeh Vasco da Gama geutumee Cape Route dari Eropa u India.
hypothesis: Pengaruh Eropa ngen kolonialisme dimulai bak abad keu-15, kareuna penjelajah Portugis Vasco da Gama geu teume Rute Cape dari Eropa keu India.

source: In the north the region is bounded by the Sahel, and in the south and west by the Atlantic Ocean.
reference: Blah wilayah baroh nyoe jiboh ceu le Sahel, tunoeng ngön barat le samudra Atlantik.
hypothesis: Di utara wilayah nyan meuceue deungen Sahel, ngen di selatan ngen barat deungen Samudra Atlantik.

source: Women: It is recommended that any women travellers say that they are married, regardless of actual marital status.
reference: Ureueng inoeng: nyoe jisurat bahwasajih tiep jamѐe inoeng geupeugah droe geuh kalheueh geu meukawen, leupah nibak status beutoi kalheueh geumeunikah.
hypothesis: Wanita: Disarankan bahwa mandum ureung inong nyang jak peugah bahwa awak nyan ka meukawen, hana peunteng status perkawinan nyata.

source: It is helpful to also wear a ring (just not one that looks too expensive.
reference: Nyoe meutuloeng sit keu geusok encin (nyan sit hana deuh meuhai that).
hypothesis: Nyan na guna cit keu meubabah cincin (teuma hana saboh nyang deuh jih that meuhai.

source: Women should realize that cultural differences may result in what they would consider harassment and it is not uncommon to be followed, grabbed by the arm, etc.
reference: Ureueng inoeng peureulee beu geuthee droe geuh bahwasajih parak budaya nyan jeut ku musabab pue nyang jikira seubagoe seumalee, jium, dsj.
hypothesis: Wanita harus sadar bahwa perbedaan budaya jeut mengakibatkan yang akan mereka anggap pelecehan dan tidak jarang untuk diikuti, dipegang lengan, dll.

source: Be firm in turning down men, and don't be afraid to stand your ground (cultural differences or not, it doesn't make it ok!).
reference: Beugap bak taglhoeng gaki, bek geusuen keu ta peutheun droe (parak budaya atawa hana, nyan hanajeuet keu hai nyang jroeh!).
hypothesis: Beutoi-beutoi dalam geu peulheuh ureung agam, dan han takot keu teutap teutap (peubeda budaya atawa hana, nyan hana jeut oke!).

source: The modern city of Casablanca was founded by Berber fishermen in the 10th century BCE, and was used by the Phoenicians, Romans, and the Merenids as a strategic port called Anfa.
reference: Kuta nyang ka maju Casablanca geupeudoeng le ureueng meulaot Barber bak abad keu-10 SM, ngön geucok le Fanisia, Romawi, ngön Merenid seubagoe peulabuhan nyang pah teumpat nyang geukheun Anfa.
hypothesis: Kota modern Casablanca didirikan le nelayan Berber bak abad keu-10 SM, ngen dipakek le bangsa Fenisia, Romawi, ngen Merenid seubagai pelabuhan strategis nyang geuboh nan Anfa.

source: The Portuguese destroyed it and rebuilt it under the name Casa Branca, only to abandon it after an earthquake in 1755.
reference: Portugis jipeuancoe ngön jipeudoeng lom nyan nanjih Casa Branca, sit keu jikubah lheueh geumpa bumoe thon 1755.
hypothesis: Portugis dipeubateu dan dipeudong lom di miyueb nan Casa Branca, hanya untuk dipeulahe lheuh gempa bumoe bak thon 1755.

source: The Moroccan sultan rebuilt the city as Daru l-Badya and it was given the name Casablanca by Spanish traders who established trading bases there.
reference: Raja Maroko geupeudoeng lom kuta nyan sebagoe Daru I-Badya ngön geuboh nan Casablanca le ureueng Spanyol nyang meukat nyang geupeudoeng asai bloe publoe hinan.
hypothesis: Sultan Maroko geupeudong lom kota nyan seubagoe Daru l-Badya dan nan nyan dijok keu nyan Casablanca le pedagang Spanyol yang geupeudong pangkalan dagang di sinan.

source: Casablanca is one of the least interesting places to shop in all of Morocco.
reference: Casablanca nyankeuh salah saboh teumpat nyang paleng lagak bak tajak meubloe ubena i Maroko.
hypothesis: Casablanca nakeuh salah saboh teumpat nyang paleng hana menarik keu ta bloe di mandum Maroko.

source: Around the old Medina it's easy to find places selling traditional Moroccan goods, such as tagines, pottery, leather goods, hookahs, and a whole spectrum of geegaws, but it's all for the tourists.
reference: Silingka Madinah tuha, mangat tatumee teumpat-teumpat jipubloe dabeuh-dabeuh tradisiaonal Maroko, lagѐe tajin, tembikar, sibeurangkapue muasai kulet, hookah, ngön meubagoe jinѐh geegaw, tapih mandum keu jamѐe troek.
hypothesis: Di sekitar Medina kuno mudah untuk meurumpok tempat-tempat nyang jipeubloe barang-barang tradisional Maroko, lage tagines, keramik, barang-barang kulit, narwastu, dan mandum macam barang-barang geegaw, tapi mandum nyan keu wisatawan.

source: Goma is a tourist city of the Democratic Republic of Congo in the extreme east near Rwanda.
reference: Goma nyan kuta urosan teumaca bak Nanggroe Republik Kongo bagian paleng timu toe ngon nanggroe Rwanda.
hypothesis: Goma nakeuh saboh banda wisata di Republik Demokratik Kongo di timu luwa di seukitaran Rwanda.

source: In 2002 Goma was destroyed by lava from the Nyiragongo volcano which buried most of the town’s streets, particularly the town centre.
reference: Bak thon 2002 Goma ka anco le larva gunong apui Nyiragongo watee ulak meuhamboe u taloe jalan leubeh lom bak pusat kuta.
hypothesis: Bak thon 2002 Goma ka geupeuhanco le lava nibak gunung berapi Nyiragongo nyang ka geupeuburu leubèh rayek rot-rot di banda nyan, terutama pusat kota.

source: While Goma is reasonably safe, any visits outside of Goma should be researched to understand the state of the fighting that persists in the North Kivu province.
reference: Adak pih Goma nyan sep aman, tiep-tiep ureueng kunjong di luwa Goma wajeb di seulidei keu meuphom nyang bahwa prang mantong na nibak provinsi Kivu blah Utara.
hypothesis: Seudangkan Goma relatif aman, peu jak nyang na di luwa Goma harus dipeureksa mangat jeut ta peujeut keuadaan prang nyang mantong na di propinsi Kivu Utara.

source: The city is also the base to climb the Nyiragongo volcano along with some of the cheapest Mountain Gorilla tracking in Africa.
reference: Kuta nyan nakeuh pih uram keu ek gunong apui Nyiragongo nyan ngon teumaca keu kalon Gorila Gunong dengon yum murah bak Afrika.
hypothesis: Banda nyoe cit merupakan pangkalan untuk meuek di gunung berapi Nyiragongo seiring dengan beberapa trek Gorila Gunong termahal di Afrika.

source: You can use boda-boda (motorcycle taxi) to get around Goma. The normal (local) price is ~500 Congolese Francs for the short ride.
reference: Droeneuh jeut neungui boda-boda (honda siwa) keu wet-wet lingka Goma. Biasa ongkohjih (lokal) 500 Francs Kongo miseue neuk jak nyang toe-toe.
hypothesis: Droeneuh jeut neungui boda-boda (taxi motor) keu neujak ke Goma. Harga biasa (lokal) adalah ~ 500 franc Kongo untuk perjalanan singkat.

source: Combined with its relative inaccessibility, "Timbuktu" has come to be used as a metaphor for exotic, distant lands.
reference: Ijampue ngön bit hanjeuet jipeutubiet, "Timbuktu" ka jipeuguna seubagoe metafora keu nanggroe-nanggroe nyang jioh nyang ceudah lagoina.
hypothesis: Seiring deungen relatif hana terjangkau jih, "Timbuktu" ka jeut dipakek seubagoe metafora untuk nanggroe-nanggroe eksotik, yang lubeh jaoh.

source: Today, Timbuktu is an impoverished town, although its reputation makes it a tourist attraction, and it has an airport.
reference: Uroe nyoe, Timbuktu nakeuh kuta nyang gasien, adakpih martabatjih jeuet keu kuta seubagoe teumpat jak tamasya, ngön na saboh bandara.
hypothesis: Jinoe, Timbuktu nakeuh saboh banda nyang gasien, bah pih nan jih nyang meusyeuhu nyan jeuet keu daya tarek wisatawan, dan na bandara.

source: In 1990, it was added to the list of world heritage sites in danger, due to the threat of desert sands.
reference: Bak thon 1990, ka geutamah bak dafta situs waresan donya lam bahya, sabab ancaman cot meu anoe.
hypothesis: Bak thon 1990, jih ditamah keu daftar situs warisan donya yang lam bahaya, kareuna ancaman pasir padang pasi.

source: It was one of the major stops during Henry Louis Gates' PBS special Wonders of the African World.
reference: Nyankeuh salah saboh nyang phôn jitheun nibak Keuajaiban Meuteunte Donya Afrika Hery Luois Gate’PBS.
hypothesis: Nyan salah saboh halte utama seulama spesial PBS Henry Louis Gates, Wonders of the African World.

source: The city is in stark contrast to the rest of the country's cities, because it has more of an Arabic flair than of an African.
reference: Kuta nyoe sep brat deuh deungön kuta-kuta nyang laenjih bak abad nyoe, sabab ureueng Arab leubѐh jai bakat nibak ureueng Afrika.
hypothesis: Banda nyoe meubeda that deungon banda-banda la'én di nanggroe nyoe, kareuna na leubeh le rasa Arab nibak Afrika.

source: The Kruger National Park (KNP) lies in the north-east of South Africa and runs along the border of Mozambique in the east, Zimbabwe in the north, and the southern border is the Crocodile River.
reference: Kruger National Park (KNP) i baroh-timue Afrika Tunoeng ngön meuhalak ubena ceu Mozambik blah timue, Zimbabwe na roet baroh, ngön bak ceu blah tunoeng nakeuh Krueng Buya.
hypothesis: Taman Nasional Kruger (KNP) na di timur laut Afrika Selatan ngen meulinteung perbatasan Mozambik di timu, Zimbabwe di utara, ngen perbatasan selatan adalah Sungai Buaya.

source: The park covers 19,500 km² and is divided in 14 different ecozones, each supporting different wildlife.
reference: Keu seuneulheueh taman 19.500 km² ngön ibahgi keu 14 wilayah mangat takaloen nyang meuulaen, tiep-tiep droe sapue kheun keu meubagoe meulatang kleut nyan.
hypothesis: Taman nyan jimat 19.500 km2 dan dibagi jeut 14 ekozone nyang berbeda, yang masing-masing na kehidupan liar nyang berbeda.

source: It is one of the main attractions of South Africa and it is considered the flagship of South African National Parks (SANParks).
reference: Nyan nakeuh saboh antara piyasan-piyasan nibak Afrika Tunoeng ngön nyan dikheun hai nyang teuleubѐh nibak Taman Nasional Afrika Tunoeng (SANParks).
hypothesis: Nyan salah saboh atraksi utama Afrika Selatan ngen dianggap sebagai flagship Taman Nasional Afrika Selatan (SANParks).

source: As with all South African National Parks, there are daily conservation and entry fees for the park.
reference: Deungon mandum Taman Nasional Afrika Tunoeng, nyan na buet keumiet siuroe-uroe ngön euungkoh tamoeng bak taman nyan.
hypothesis: Lage mandum Taman Nasional Afrika Selatan, na biaya konservasi dan biaya tamong harian keu taman.

source: It may also be beneficial for one to buy a Wild Card, which provides entry to either selections of parks in South Africa or all of the South African National Parks.
reference: Nyan pih jeuet keu paidah keu sidroe ureueng nyang bloe saboh Keureutu Kleuet, nyan seudiya rauh tamong u pue keuh taman bak Afrika Tunoeng nyang ka geupileh atawa mandum Taman Nasional Afrika Tunoeng.
hypothesis: Nyo cit jeut bermanfaat keu sidroe untuk meubeuli Wild Card, yeng meumiliki akses keu salah saboh pilihan taman di Afrika Selatan atau mandum Taman Nasional Afrika Selatan.

source: Hong Kong Island gives the territory of Hong Kong its name and is the place that many tourists regard as the main focus.
reference: Pulo Hong Kong dibri dairah Hong Kong nyan nanjih ngön nyankeuh teumpat nyang jai turis peujeuet keu pusat nyang phôn.
hypothesis: Pulo Hong Kong geubri nan keu wilayah Hong Kong dan teumpat nyang le wisatawan anggap sebagai fokus utama.

source: The parade of buildings that make the Hong Kong skyline has been likened to a glittering bar chart that is made apparent by the presence of the waters of Victoria Harbour.
reference: Geudoeng-geudoeng nyang meubareh nyan peugot gareh langet Hong Kong nyan dipeusaban deungön gamba balok meucahya nyang dipeugot deuh deungon ie nyang troeh nibak Peulabohan Victoria.
hypothesis: Bintéh-bintéh nyang meupeugot skyline Hong Kong ka ji peusaban deungon grafik bar nyang meukilat nyang deuh jih nibak laot Victoria Harbour.

source: To get the best views of Hong Kong, leave the island and head for the Kowloon waterfront opposite.
reference: Keu meutumee peumandangan nyang paleng got bak Hong Kong, neuminah nibak Pulo ngön neujak u Kowloon blahdeh pasi.
hypothesis: Untuk meumandang Hong Kong nyang paleng get, tinggai pulo nyan dan jak u pantai Kowloon di meurandeh.

source: The great majority of Hong Kong Island's urban development is densely packed on reclaimed land along the northern shore.
reference: Nyang paleng jai nibak cara dipeugot dairah kuta Pulo Hong Kong nyang hayeu nyan nyankeuh dipeusapat deungon punoh bak tanoh nyang jireklamasi seupanyang pasi blah baroh.
hypothesis: Sebagian rayek pembangunan perkotaan Pulo Hong Kong teususon bak tanoh yang ka dipeuget ulang di seulatan pantai utara.

source: This is the place the British colonisers took as their own and so if you are looking for evidence of the territory's colonial past, this is a good place to start.
reference: Nyoe teumpat nyang peunjajah asai Inggreh cok seubagoe atra droe ngön meunyoe gata mita keu peuninggai jameun masa peunjajah, nyoekeuh saboh teumpat nyang got keu neupeuphôn.
hypothesis: Nyoe keuh teumpat peududukan Inggris yang dipeudeng keu droe jih dan meunyo awak mita bukti masa lam kolonial wilayah nyoe, nyoe keuh teumpat yang get untuk dimulai.

source: The Sundarbans are the largest littoral mangrove belt in the world, stretching 80 km (50 mi) into the Bangladeshi and Indian hinterland from the coast.
reference: Sundarbans nakeuh dairah pasi bak bangka nyang paleng rayek i donya, meubeunteueng 80 km (50 mi) u dairah dalam Bangladesh ngön India dari pasi.
hypothesis: Sundarbans adalah sabuk mangrove pantai paleng rayek di donya, meuluah 80 km (50 mi) u daerah dalam Bangladesh dan India dari pantai.

source: The Sundarbans has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The part of the forest within Indian territory is called Sundarbans National Park.
reference: Sundarbans ka dipeunyata keu Teumpat Wareh Donya UNESCO. Dairah uteun lam wilayah India nyan dikheun Taman Nasional Sundarbans.
hypothesis: Sundarbans ka geupeuturi seubagoe Situs Warisan Donya UNESCO. Bagian uteun di wilayah India geuboh nan Taman Nasional Sundarbans.

source: The forests aren't just mangrove swamps though — they include some of the last remaining stands of the mighty jungles which once covered the Gangetic plain.
reference: Uteunjih nyan pih koen alue bakau sagai — nyan ditamong ladom dari rimba-rimba kha nyang tinggai nyang dilee dikhop tanoh luwah Gangetic.
hypothesis: Hutan nyoe kon hanya paya mangrove, tapi na cit yang tinggai dari gle raya nyang pernah meulambong dataran Gange.

source: The Sundarbans cover an area of 3,850 km², of which about one-third is covered in water/marsh areas.
reference: Sundarbans dikhop saboh wilayah 3.850 km², sangkira sa per lhee nyan dikhop ngön ie/wilayah paya.
hypothesis: Sundarbans na luas 3.850 km2, nyang kira-kira seutiga jih na di daerah ie/ paya.

source: Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.
reference: Nibak thon 1966 Sundarbans jeuet keu saboh suaka keu meulatang juwah, ngön nyan keunira jinoe na 400 rimueng Royal Bengal ngön sangkira 30.000 rusa nyang deuh bak wilayah nyan.
hypothesis: Seumeunjak 1966 Sundarbans ka jeut keu tempat perlindungan binatang liar, dan diperkirakan jinoe na 400 macan Bengal dan kira-kira 30.000 rusa bercak di daerah nyan.

source: Buses depart the inter-district bus station (across the river) throughout the day, though most, especially those heading to the east and Jakar/Bumthang leave between 06:30 and 07:30.
reference: Moto Bus dibungka tasiyon moto bes lingkeue dairah (meukoh krueng) seupanyang uroe, adak kayémjih, khususjih nyang meujak u timu ngön Jakar/Bumthang jipeuhah antara poh 06:30 ngön poh 07:30.
hypothesis: Bus berangkat dari stasiun bus antar kabupaten (di seubréh krueng) seulama uroe, meskipun sebagian besar, terutama yang menuju ke timur dan Jakar/Bumthang berangkat antara 06:30 dan 07:30.

source: As the inter-district buses are often full, it is advisable to purchase a ticket a few days in advance.
reference: Seubap moto bes lingkeue dairah nyan kayém peunoh, nyan dibrithee keu neubloe karcih bak padum uroe sigohlomjih.
hypothesis: Kareuna bus antar distrik seureng that bek, leubeh get ta blo tiket padum uroe leubeh awai.

source: Most districts are served by small Japanese Coaster Buses, which are comfortable and sturdy.
reference: Dum dairah-dairah nyan diseudiya Moto Bus Peluncur Jeupang, nyang sanyum ngön kong.
hypothesis: Le distrik dilee le Bus Coaster Jepang ubit, yeng nyaman ngen teukuat.

source: Shared taxis are a quick and comfortable means to travel to nearby places, such as Paro (Nu 150) and Punakha (Nu 200).
reference: Moto taksi sajan nyankeuh saboh hai nyang bagah ngön sanyum keu jak u teumpat-teumpat lam seulingka, lagѐe Paro (Nu 150) ngön Punakha (Nu 200).
hypothesis: Taksi bersama adalah cara yeng cepat ngen nyaman untuk meujak u teumpat-teumpat yeng to, lage Paro (Nu 150) ngen Punakha (Nu 200).

source: The Oyapock River Bridge is a cable-stayed bridge. It spans the Oyapock River to link the cities of Oiapoque in Brazil and Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock in French Guiana.
reference: Tutue Krueng Oyapock nyankeuh tutue yang dipeudong ngoen taloe. Nyan di lingkeue krueng Oyapock meuhubong ngon kuta-kuta di Oipoque di Brazil ngon Saint-Georges de l’Oyapock di French Guiana.
hypothesis: Jambatan Krueng Oyapock nakeuh saboh jambatan nyang geupeudong le kabel. Jambatan nyoe meuhubông Krueng Oyapock keu meuhubông banda Oiapoque di Brasil ngon Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock di Guiana Peurancih.

source: The two towers rise to a height of 83 meters, it's 378 meters long and it has two lanes of 3.50 m wide.
reference: Dua boh meunara manyang u ateuhjih 83 mete, panyang u sampengjih 378 mete ngon na dua boh rot nyang luwahjih 3.50 mete.
hypothesis: Dua meunara nyan manyang jih 83 meter, panyang jih 378 meter ngon luwah jih 3,50 meter.

source: The vertical clearance under the bridge is 15 meters. Construction was completed in August 2011, it didn't open to traffic until March 2017.
reference: Ceue keu manyang di yup tutue nyan 15 mete. Buet peugot tutue nyan lheueh bak Agustus 2011, nyan han dibuka keu ureueng jak sampoe Maret 2017.
hypothesis: Jaroe nyan geupeudong bak buleuen Agustus 2011, dan hana geupeugöt keu peudeng sampoe Maret 2017.

source: The bridge is scheduled to be fully operational in September 2017, when the Brazilian customs checkpoints are expected to be finished.
