reference: Tutue nyan reuncanajih dibuka peunoh keu operational bak September 2017, watë teumpat-teumpat keu peutren dabeuh ureueng Brazil nyan ka lheueh dipeugot.
hypothesis: Jambatan nyan di peugöt keu beroperasi bak buleuen September 2017, watee pos pemeriksaan bea cukai Brasil diharap dipeuseuleusoe.

source: The Guaraní were the most significant indigenous group inhabiting what is now Eastern Paraguay, living as semi-nomadic hunters who also practised subsistence agriculture.
reference: Guarani nyankeuh keulompok asai nyang paleng peunteng nyang jiduek bak teumpat nanjih jinoe Timu Paraguay, meuudep ban meupinah-pinah sira jak let meunatang meurunoe nyang geupubuet meugo keuudep cit.
hypothesis: Guaraní adalah kelompok pribumi paleng peunteng yang tinggai di bagian yang jinoe jeut keu Paraguay Timu, udep seubagoe pemburu semi-nomad yang juga mengamalkan pertanian subsisten.

source: The Chaco region was home to other groups of indigenous tribes such as the Guaycurú and Payaguá, who survived by hunting, gathering and fishing.
reference: Dairah Chaco nyankeuh rumoh keu keulompok suku asai lagee Guaycuru ngoen Payagua, nyang udep deungon meuburu, meukumpoi ngoen keumawe.
hypothesis: Wilayah Chaco nyan adalah rumoh bagi kelompok-kelompok suku asli laen lagee Guaycurú ngen Payaguá, yeng bertahan deungen berburu, meupeurhot ngen mancing.

source: In the 16th century Paraguay, formerly called "The Giant Province of the Indies", was born as a result of the encounter of Spanish conquerors with the native indigenous groups.
reference: Lam abad keu-16 Paraguay, sigohlomjih dikheuen "Provinsi Raya Nyang Jiduek le Ureueng India", nyan lahe dari hase peukara peunjajah Spanyol deungon keulompok asai nyang disinan.
hypothesis: Bak abad keu-16, Paraguay, nyang awai jih dikhen "Provinsi Rayeuk India", lahé seubab meurumpok lé peumeunang Spanyol deungon kelompok adat aseuli.

source: The Spaniards started the colonization period which lasted for three centuries.
reference: Bansa Spanyol geupuphon watë meujajah nyang trepjih sampoe lhee abad.
hypothesis: Ureueng Spanyol mulai masa kolonialisasi yang berlangsung lhee abad.

source: Since the foundation of Asunción in 1537, Paraguay has managed to keep a lot of its indigenous character and identity.
reference: Watë dipeudong Asunción bak thon 1537, Paraguay jeuet dipeutheun dum peurangeui ureueng asai ngoen identitahjih.
hypothesis: Seujak pendirian Asunción bak thon 1537, Paraguay ka berhasil meusiati le karakter dan identitas pribumi jih.

source: Argentina is well known for having one of the best polo teams and players in the world.
reference: Argentina nyan got dituri seubap na salah saboh tim polo ngoen peumeu’en nyang paleng got i dônya.
hypothesis: Argentina terkenal na salah saboh tim polo ngon peunari paleng get di donya.

source: The largest tournament of the year takes place in December at the polo fields in Las Cañitas.
reference: Turnamen sithon sigo nyang paleng rayeuk dipeugot lam buleuen Desember bak lapangan polo i Las Cañitas.
hypothesis: Turnamen paleng rayek thon nyan geupeuget bak buleuen Desember bak lapangan polo di Las Cañitas.

source: Smaller tournaments and matches can also be seen here at other times of the year.
reference: Turnamen ngoen acara tadong nyang leubeh ubeut jeuet sit neukalon hinoe bak laen watë lam saboh thon.
hypothesis: Turnamen ngen pertandingan yeng lubeh ubit jeut cit ditonton di sini bak watee laen dari thon.

source: For news on tournaments and where to buy tickets for polo matches, check Asociacion Argentina de Polo.
reference: Keu haba teuntang turnamen ngoen pat dipubloe tiket keu acara tadong polo, neukalon bak Asociacion Argentina de Polo.
hypothesis: Untuk berita tentang turnamen ngon pat jeut ta bloe tiket keu pertandingan polo, buka Asociacion Argentina de Polo.

source: The official Falklands currency is the Falkland pound (FKP) whose value is set equivalent to that of one British pound (GBP).
reference: Mata peng resmi Falklands nyankeuh Falkland pound (FKP) nyang yumjih dipeugot saban lagee sa Inggris pound (GBP).
hypothesis: Mata uang resmi Falkland adalah Pound Falkland (FKP) yeng nilai jih ditetapkan setara deungen saboh Pound Britania (GBP).

source: Money can be exchanged at the only bank in the islands which is located in Stanley across from the FIC West store.
reference: Peng jeuet dituka bak saboh beng sagai lam pulo nyan nyang teumpatjih di Stanley blahdeh toko FIC West.
hypothesis: Uengkang jeut ji tukang bak saboh-saboh bank di pulo-pulo nyan nyang na di Stanley di seubarong toko FIC Barat.

source: British pounds will generally be accepted anywhere in the islands and within Stanley credit cards and United States dollars are also often accepted.
reference: Inggris pounds umumjih diteurimong dumpat lam pulo ngoen dalam keureutu kredit Stanley ngoen Amerika Serikat dollar pih kayem diteurimong.
hypothesis: Pound Inggris umum jih akan diterimeng di mandum pulau dan lam kartu kredit Stanley dan dolar Amerika Serikat cit seureng diterimeng.

source: On the outlying islands credit cards will probably not be accepted, although British and United States currency may be taken; check with the owners in advance to determine what is an acceptable payment method.
reference: Bak pulo-pulo nyang jeuoh mungken keureutu kredit han diteurimong, adakpih Inggris ngoen mata peng Ameurika Seurikat nyang dicok; neupareksa deungon po geuh dilee keu peuteuntee peue cara bayeue nyang diteurimong.
hypothesis: Bak pulo-pulo nyang luwah, kartu kredit mungken hana ji teurimong, bah pih mata uang Inggreh ngon Amerika Serikat mungken ji cok; tanyong bak nyang na bak pulo nyan leubeh ilée keu neuteupeue metode pembayaran nyang jeut ji teurimong.

source: It is nearly impossible to exchange Falklands currency outside of the islands, so exchange money prior to leaving the islands.
reference: Nyan karap han mungken keu neutuka mata peng Falklands di luwa pulo, jadi neutuka peng nyan sigohlom neujak dari pulo.
hypothesis: Nyak mustahil untuk meubah mata uang Falkland di lua pulau, jadi meubah mata uang seugolom meungungse pulau.

source: Since Montevideo is south of the Equator, it is summer there when it's winter in the Northern Hemisphere and vice versa.
reference: Seubap Montevideo nyan blah tunong dari Equator, hinan musem seuuem watë musem leupie bak Wilayah Utara Bumoe ngoen seubalekjih.
hypothesis: Kareuna Montevideo na di selatan Khatulistiwa, nyan adalah musim panas di sinan seudangkan nyan adalah musim dingin di belahan bumi utara dan sebaliknya.

source: Montevideo is in the subtropics; in the summer months, temperatures above +30°C are common.
reference: Montevideo nyan lam subtropik; lam buleuen-buleuen musem seuuem, temperature hinan biasajih di ateueh +30°C.
hypothesis: Montevideo na di subtropis; bak buleuen musim panas, suhu di ateuh +30°C umum.

source: The winter can be deceptively chilly: temperatures rarely go below freezing, but the wind and humidity combine to make it feel colder than what the thermometer says.
reference: Musem leupie biasajih leubeh leupie dari nyang ta rasa: temperatures han kayem di yup leupie that, tapi angen ngoen angen juem meugabong nyang peugot nyan leubeh leupie nibak peue nyang dipeuleumah bak termometer.
hypothesis: Musim dingin jeut keu dingin yang meumikat: suhu jarang that di bawah titik beku, tapi angén dan kelembaban meujampu untuk membuat terasa leubèh dingin dari yang dikheun le termometer.

source: There are no particular "rainy" and "dry" seasons: the amount of rain stays roughly the same throughout the year.
reference: Hana musem "ujen" ngoen "tho" nyang ka teuntee: jumlah ujeuen kira-kira teutap saban seupanyang thon.
hypothesis: Hana musim "meu ujeun" ngon "gleh": jumlah ujeun tinggai sama seulama thon.

source: Though many of the animals in the park are used to seeing humans, the wildlife is nonetheless wild and should not be fed or disturbed.
reference: Adakpi jai meunatang bak taman nyang ladom i kaloen ureueng, meunatang kleut teutap kleut ngoen bek geu bi eumpeuen atawa jipeukaru.
hypothesis: Meskipun le binatang di taman nyan biasa jih keu manusia, binatang nyan pih seucara liar dan hana jeut dipeumangat atawa dipeugadoh.

source: According to park authorities, stay at least 100 yards/meters away from bears and wolves and 25 yards/meters from all other wild animals!
reference: Meunurot otoritas taman, dong seukureungjih 100 trah/mete dari cagee ngon seurigala ngon 25trah/mete dari mandum meunatang kleut nyang laen!
hypothesis: Meunurot peumeurintahan taman, tinggai kureueng jih 100 yard/met nibak beruang dan srigala dan 25 yard/met nibak mandum binatang liar laen jih!

source: No matter how docile they may look, bison, elk, moose, bears, and nearly all large animals can attack.
reference: Hana meudaleh kiban seuit meunatang nyan deuh, bison, rusa rayeuk, rusa rayeuk (rusa rayeuk ngoen rusa rayeuk, duwa rusa nyang beda), cagee, ngoen karab mandum meunatang raya rayek jeuet jiseurang.
hypothesis: Padum pih jih nyan leumoh, bison, rusa, rusa, beruang, dan hampir mandum binatang rayeuk jeut jiseurang.

source: Each year, dozens of visitors are injured because they didn't keep a proper distance. These animals are large, wild, and potentially dangerous, so give them their space.
reference: Tip thon, meuploh jamee luka kareuna ureueng nyan han dijaga ceu nyang pah. Meunatang – meunatang rayeuk, kleut, ngoen jeuet keu paloe, jadi tapeujioh bacut droeteuh keu awaknyan.
hypothesis: Tieb thon, le that pengunjung luka karena awak nyan hana jijaga jarak yang paih. binatang nyoe rayek, liar, dan berpotensi berbahaya, jadi bri kheueh awak nyan ruang.

source: In addition, be aware that odors attract bears and other wildlife, so avoid carrying or cooking odorous foods and keep a clean camp.
reference: Seubagoe tamah, beu teugoh that bahwasajih bhe galak ih cagee ngoen meunatang kleut nyang laen, jadi taceugah mee atawa magun peunajoh ngoen beu gleh teumpat dom.
hypothesis: Seulaén nibak nyan, ingat kheueh bahwa bée-bée nyang hana haröm nyan jipeuhireuen beruang dan beulatang-beulatang kleut nyang laén, jadi bék gata ba atawa gata peugét peunajoh nyang na bau nyan dan jaga kheueh khimah-khimah gata keu gleh.

source: Apia is the capital of Samoa. The town is on the island of Upolu and has a population of just under 40,000.
reference: Apia nakeuh ibu kuta Samoa. Kuta nyoe bak pulo Upolu ngoen masyarakat kureueng nibak 40.000.
hypothesis: Apia nakeuh nang nanggroe Samoa. Banda nyan na di pulo Upolu ngon na populasi nyang kureung that dari 40.000 droë.

source: Apia was founded in the 1850s and has been the official capital of Samoa since 1959.
reference: Apia dipeudong bak thon 1850 ngoen ka jeuet keu ibu kuta reusmi Samoa nibak thon 1959.
hypothesis: Apia didirikan bak thon 1850-an dan ka jeut keu ibu kota resmi Samoa seujak thon 1959.

source: The harbor was the site of an infamous naval standoff in 1889 when seven ships from Germany, the US, and Britain refused to leave the harbor.
reference: Peulabohan nyan teumpat angkatan laot hana get thon 1889 wate tujoh kapai ie nibak German, US, ngoen Inggreh geutolak keu peutinggai peulabohan.
hypothesis: Pelabuhan nyan adalah lokasi teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang teuntang

source: All the ships were sunk, except for one British cruiser. Nearly 200 American and German lives were lost.
reference: Mandum kapai lham, seulaen saboh kapai penjelajah Inggreh. Karap 200 ureueng Ameurika ngoen Jerman gadoh.
hypothesis: Bandum kapai ka lham, kecuali saboh kruiser Britania. Hampir 200 Amerika ngen Jerman ka meuninggai.

source: During the struggle for independence organised by the Mau movement, a peaceful gathering in the town resulted in the killing of the paramount chief Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.
reference: Watë peurjuangan keu meurdeka geuato le gerakan Mau, Meurumpok keu damai bak kuta meuhase teupoh mate Ulee teumanyang Tupua Tamasese Lealofi lll.
hypothesis: Seulama perjuangan kemerdekaan yang geuorganisasi le gerakan Mau, saboh rapat damai di kota nyan meuakibat keu teupoh gob panglima utama Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.

source: There are many beaches, due to Auckland's straddling of two harbours. The most popular ones are in three areas.
reference: Na le pante di sinan, kareuna Auckland na di antara dua peulabohan. Nyang paleng geutupeue na di lhee area.
hypothesis: Na le pantai, kareuna Auckland na dua pelabuhan. yang paleng populer na di lhee daerah.

source: North Shore beaches (in North Harbour district) are on the Pacific Ocean and stretch from Long Bay in the north to Devonport in the south.
reference: Pante North Shore (di distrik North Harbor) na di Samudra Pasifik ngon meuleueng dari Long Bay di utara sampoe Devonport di selatan.
hypothesis: Pantai North Shore (di distrik North Harbour) na di Laot Pasifik dan meuluah dari Long Bay di utara sampoe Devonport di seulatan.

source: They are almost all sandy beaches with safe swimming, and most have shade provided by pohutukawa trees.
reference: Rap mandum pante meupasi deungon meulango yang aman, ngon seubagian rayek na tumpat mat yang diseudiakan le bak kaye pohutukawa.
hypothesis: Hampir mandum nyan pantai pasi ngen aman untuk berenang, ngen sebagian rayek na na bubayang yang dipeuget le kayee pohutukawa.

source: Tamaki Drive beaches are on the Waitemata Harbour, in the upmarket suburbs of Mission Bay and St Heliers in Central Auckland.
reference: Pante Tamaki Drive na di Pelabuhan Waitemata, di bineh kuta glah ateueh Mission Bay ngon St Heliers di Auckland Teungoh.
hypothesis: Pantai Tamaki Drive na di Pelabuhan Waitemata, di pinggiran kota mewah Mission Bay ngon St Heliers di pusat Auckland.

source: These are sometimes-crowded family beaches with a good range of shops lining the shore. Swimming is safe.
reference: Nyoe nakeuh pante keluarga nyang teukadang rame nacit meubagoe toko nyang meubanja di bineh pante. Meulango pih aman.
hypothesis: Nyan kadang-kadang pantai keluarga nyang rame deungon le toko di teungeh pantai.

source: The main local beer is 'Number One', it is not a complex beer, but pleasant and refreshing. The other local beer is called "Manta".
reference: Ie mabok lokal phôn nakeuh 'Number One', Nyoe kon saboh ie mabok kompleks, tapih meusenang ngoen phui. Ie mabok lokal laen jiboh nan "Manta".
hypothesis: Bir lokal utama nakeuh 'Nomer Satu', nyan kon bir nyang kompleks, tapi nyang mangat dan segar.

source: There are many French wines to be had, but the New Zealand and Australian wines might travel better.
reference: Na le boh ie anggo Peuranceh nyang jeuet meuteume, tapi ata Seulandia Baro ngoen Australi mungken leubeh mangat.
hypothesis: Na le that-that anggur Prancis nyang jeut ta pajoh, tapi nyang na di Selandia Baru ngon Australia mungken leubeh get.

source: The local tap water is perfectly safe to drink, but bottled water is easy to find if you are fearful.
reference: Ie kran lokal nakeuh aman keu geujep. Tapi ie lam botol mudah meurumpok miseu gata yo.
hypothesis: Ié kran lokal nyan aman that keu iem, teuma ié nyang na lam kaca nyan mudah meurumpok meunyoe gata teumakot.

source: For Australians, the idea of 'flat white' coffee is foreign. A short black is 'espresso', cappuccino comes heaped high with cream (not froth), and tea is served without milk.
reference: Keu ureueng Australi, ide kupi 'flat white' nakeuh aseng. Kupi pancong nakeuh 'espresso', cappuccino dipeugot deungon krim di ateuh (kon busa), ngon te dipeugot hana susu.
hypothesis: Keu ureung Australia, ide kopi 'puteh rata' nyan hana asing. saboh kopi itam nyang paneuk nyan 'espresso', cappuccino nyan na dilee ngon krim (kon busa), dan teh nyan ji peuget hana meulisan.

source: The hot chocolate is up to Belgian standards. Fruit juices are pricey but excellent.
reference: Coklat suum nakeuh standar bak Belgia. Jus boh kayee meuhai tapi leubeh get.
hypothesis: Coklat geumbira nyan sesuai standar Belgia. Jus buah nyan meuhareuta tapi that get.

source: Many trips to the reef are made all year around, and injuries due to any of these causes on the reef are rare.
reference: Lee peurjalanan keu terumbu kareung dipeugot tip thon, ngoen ceudera keu salah saboh peunyebab nibak teurumbu kareung jareueng.
hypothesis: Le that-that kunjungan u karang nyan di peuget seulama thon, dan luka akibat salah saboh dari alasan-alasan nyan di karang nyan jarang terjadi.

source: Still, take advice from authorities, obey all signs, and pay close attention to safety warnings.
reference: Mantong, neu ikot saran nibak pomeurintah, beu tapateh mandum tanda, ngoen takalon peuringatan beuseulamat.
hypothesis: Bah pih meunan, neuseutôt kheueh naseuhat nyang geubri lé peugawée, taát kheueh ubak banmandum tanda-tanda, dan peurati kheueh that-that peuingat-peuingat nyang na.

source: Box jellyfish occur near beaches and near river estuaries from October to April north of 1770. They can occasionally be found outside these times.
reference: Kotak ubur-ubur hudep toe bineh laot ngoen bineh krueng nibak Oktober keu April bak baroh nibak 1770. Awak nyan kadang-kadang jeuet ta meurumpok dilua watë nyan.
hypothesis: Medusa kotak na di seupanyang pantai ngen di seupanyang muara krueng dari Oktober sampoe April 1770 di utara.

source: Sharks do exist, however they rarely attack humans. Most sharks are scared of humans and would swim away.
reference: Eungkotyee cit na, adakpih awak nyan jareung ipoh manusia. Lee eungkot yee yoe keu manusia ngoen keuneuk meulangu jioh.
hypothesis: Hiu na, tapi nyan jarang that ji peukawan manusia.

source: Saltwater Crocodiles do not actively live in the ocean, their primary habitat is in river estuaries north from Rockhampton.
reference: Buya ie masen hana sereng udep di laot, teumpat hudep phôn awak nyan nakeuh bak muara krueng baroh nibak Rockhampton.
hypothesis: Buaya ie masam hana aktif tinggai di laot, habitat utama jih na di muara krueng di utara dari Rockhampton.

source: Booking in advance gives the traveller peace of mind that they will have somewhere to sleep once they arrive at their destination.
reference: Dipeusan diphon dile geujok keutenangan ulee bak jamee awak nyan na teumpat eh watë awak nyan sampoe bak meulangkah.
hypothesis: Meunyoe ureuëng nyan ka geukeubah rumoh, gobnyan jeuet keu aman ngon aman sabab gobnyan ka na teumpat éh meunyoe ka trok u teumpat nyang geutuju.

source: Travel agents often have deals with specific hotels, although you may find it possible to book other forms of accommodation, like camping grounds, through a travel agent.
reference: Agen peurjalanan kayem na keuseupakatan deungoen hotel meuteunte, adakpih gata mungken jeuet jipeusan akomodasi laen, lage teumpat meukemah, rot agen peurjalanan.
hypothesis: Agen perjalanan seureng na kesepakatan deungen hotel-hotel tertentu, meskipun awak jeut meurumpok kemungkinan untuk memesan bentuk-bentuk akomodasi laen, lage tempat berkemah, melalui agen perjalanan.

source: Travel agents usually offer packages that include breakfast, transportation arrangements to/from the airport or even combined flight and hotel packages.
reference: Agen peurjalanan biasajih geupeutaba paket nyang na pajoh bu beungoh, geuato transportasi u/nibak bandara atawa dipeusapat paket peunerbangan ngoen hotel.
hypothesis: Agen perjalanan biasa jih na paket yang na termasuk sarapan, pengaturan transportasi keu/dari bandara atau bahkan paket penerbangan dan hotel.

source: They can also hold the reservation for you if you need time to think about the offer or procure other documents for your destination (e.g. visa).
reference: Awak nyan pih jeuet geutheun peusan keu gata miseu gata peurlee watë keu seumike teuntang geupeutaba atawa peungadaan dokumen laen keu tujuan gata (tamsejih visa).
hypothesis: Awak nyan jeut cit ji simpan peuseumahan keu awak nyan meunyoe awak nyan peureulèe watee keu pike teuntang peuseumahan nyan atawa keu peuseudia dokumen laen keu tujuan awak nyan (misaljih visa).

source: Any amendments or requests though should be coursed through the travel agent first and not directly with the hotel.
reference: Tip peurubahan atawa geulake adakpih seharusjih liwat agen peurjalanan phôn-phôn ngoen hana langsong bak hotel.
hypothesis: Peubah-peubah atawa permintaan akan diproses phon-phon le agen perjalanan dan han langsung deungen hotel.

source: For some festivals, the vast majority of the attendants to music festivals decide to camp on site, and most attendants consider it a vital part of the experience.
reference: Keu padum boh festival, jai nyang idang musik neuk meudom bak teumpat nyan, ngoen jai ureueng geuanggap nyan seubagoe peungalaman nyang peunteng.
hypothesis: Bak padum boh festival, sebagian rayek ureung nyang jak bak festival musik nyan geupiléh keu geupeudong khimah bak teumpat nyan, dan le ureueng nyan meurasa nyan bagian nyang peunteng dari pengalaman nyan.

source: If you want to be close to the action you're going to have to get in early to get a camping site close to the music.
reference: Meusue droeneuh neuk toe dengoen geulagat droeneuh wajeb jak beu phôn nak meutume teumpat dom toe deungoen musik.
hypothesis: Meunyo droeneuh keuneuk toengkat bak aksi, droeneuh akan ta jak awai keu tapeuget saboh teumpat berkemah nyang toengkat bak musik.

source: Remember that even though music on the main stages may have finished, there may be sections of the festival that will keep playing music until late into the night.
reference: Ingat bahpih musik bak panggong phôn ka seulesoe, mungken na festival teutap jimeu’en musik oh malam jula.
hypothesis: Ingat bahwa bah pih musik di panggung utama mungken ka seuleusoe, na bagian nibak festival nyan nyang mungken mantong meu-en sampoe malam.

source: Some festivals have special camping areas for families with young children.
reference: Padum boh festival na teumpat dom khas keu keuluwarga dengoen aneuk manyak.
hypothesis: Na festival na daerah khusus keu berkemah keu keluarga yang na aneuk miet.

source: If crossing the Northern Baltic in winter, check the cabin location, as going through ice causes quite horrible noise for those most affected.
reference: Meunyo takoh u Baltic Tunong bak musem lupie, pareksa teumpat kabin, seubab neuk lewat eeh nyang peugot gabuek nyang yo that teuh keu ureueng nyang teu peungaroh.
hypothesis: Meunyo meulintasi Laot Baltik Utara bak musem, pareksa lokasi kabin, kareuna meulintasi ie meujampu suara nyang that parah keu ureung nyang paleng keunong.

source: Saint Petersburg cruises include time in town. Cruise passengers are exempted from visa requirements (check the terms).
reference: Kapai ie peusiar Saint Petersburg ka itamong bak kuta. Mandumpenumpang kapai ie peusiar han payah syarat visa (acie neutilek syarat).
hypothesis: Kruis Saint Petersburg termasuk watee di kota. penumpang kruis dikecualikan dari persyaratan visa (peuleumah syarat-syarat).

source: Casinos typically make many efforts to maximize time and money spent by guests. Windows and clocks are usually absent, and exits can be hard to find.
reference: Kasino biasajih abeh upaya ngoen abeh watë keu ureueng nyang neuk peuhabeh peng. Tingkap ngoen jeum hana biasajih, ngoen exits susah that ta tume.
hypothesis: Kasino biasa jih geu peuget le that upaya keu geu peuget lee lee lee watee ngon peng yang ji peuguna le tamong. tingkap ngon jam biasa jih hana, dan jalan keluar mungken payah that ji teumeng.

source: They usually have special food, drink and entertainment offers, to keep guests in a good mood, and keep them at the premise.
reference: Awak nyan biasajih na makanan khusus, ie jep ngoen ipeutaba piasan, keu jamee nak nyaman geuh, ngoen keu jaga awak nyan bak premis.
hypothesis: Awak nyan biasa jih na makanan, minuman dan peuneugasan spesial, untuk menjaga tamu dalam suasana yang jroh, dan menjaga mereka di premis.

source: Some venues offer alcoholic beverages on the house. However, drunkenness impairs judgement, and all good gamblers know the importance of staying sober.
reference: Na padum boh tempat ipeutaba ie alkohol bak rumoh nyan. Adakpih, mabok peureuloh meupike, ngoen mandum awak meujudi nyang get peunteng that keu hana mabok.
hypothesis: Na teumpat nyang jibri ié jieb nyang hana seuharôh jih. Teuma, mabök nyan meuakibat jih hana hase tapeuteun hai-hai nyang hana meumakna, dan mandum ureuëng nyang galak keu meu-én geunantoe-geunantoe nyan jiteupeue peunteng jih keu teutab jijaga droe jih.

source: Anyone who's going to drive at high latitudes or over mountain passes should consider the possibility of snow, ice, or freezing temperatures.
reference: Soe mantong nyang ek manyang that atawa leubeh nibak gunoeng beuna tingat keu salju, eeh, atawa suhu beuku.
hypothesis: Soe-soe yang akan mengendara di latitud tinggi atawa di ateuh gunung harus mempertimbangkan kemungkinan salju, es, atawa suhu beku.

source: On icy and snowy roadways, friction is low and you cannot drive as if you were on bare asphalt.
reference: Bak jalan rayek nyang meusalju, teupehjih haloh nyan droeneuh han jeuet neume moto lagee ateueh aspal soh.
hypothesis: Bak rot nyang ie jih meu-ileh ngon salju, hana le beukarueng dan awak nyan hana jeuet jiplueng deungon cara nyang saban lagée awak nyan jiplueng ateueh aspal.

source: During blizzards, enough snow to get you stuck can fall in very little time.
reference: Nibak trep bade salju, sep deungoen salju mantoeng jeuet peugot droeneuh reubah lam watë siklep mata.
hypothesis: Lam badai salju, salju nyang cukop that mangat awak nyan teutap jeut jitreun lam watee nyang that singkat.

source: Visibility may also be restricted by falling or blowing snow or by condensation or ice on vehicle windows.
reference: Deuh takalon jiboh ceu le rhot atawa meugule salju atawa kondesasi atawa eh bak tingkap moto.
hypothesis: Visibilitas cit jeut dibatasi le salju nyang rhot atawa jiyueb atawa le kondensasi atawa ie di tingkap kendaraan.

source: On the other hand, icy and snowy conditions are normal in many countries, and traffic goes on mostly uninterrupted all year round.
reference: Nibak seulaen nyan, cuwaca sijuek ngoen meusalju nyan hai biasa bak le nanggroe-nanggroe, ngoen keundaraan bak jalan jeuet di jak biasajih hana gangguan lam sithon peunoh.
hypothesis: Di sisi laen, kondisi es dan salju biasa di le nanggroe, dan peudengeh jalan meujalan seucara hana terganggu seulama thon.

source: Safaris are perhaps the greatest tourism draw in Africa and the highlight for many visitors.
reference: Jak meu safari nyankeuh mungken hai nyang paleng le meukawot wisatawan u Afrika ngoen jeuet keu peunanda keu ramee peungunjong.
hypothesis: Safaris mungken adalah daya tarik wisata nyang paleng rayek di Afrika dan peungalaman bagi le pengunjung.

source: The term safari in popular use refers to overland travel to view the stunning African wildlife, particularly on savanna.
reference: Istilah safari nyan kayem geu kheun keu rujukan keu jak meu’en meukalon Afrika tutong nyang lagak nyan, teuleubeh lom keu wilayah savanna.
hypothesis: Istilah safari nyang that umum dipeuturi keu peuneujak darat keu jak kalon binatang liar Afrika nyang meugah, terutama di padang-padang.

source: Some animals, such as elephants and giraffes, tend to approach closely to cars and standard equipment will allow good viewing.
reference: Ladom meunatang, lagee gajah danjeurapah, galak diputoe u moto ngoen na alat nyang standar ka jeuet keu geutanyoe jeuet takalon peumandangan nyang lagak.
hypothesis: Padum boh binatang, lage gajah ngen jerapah, cenderung meukaraet bak mobil dan peurangkat standar akan meumungkenkan pengamatan yang get.

source: Lions, cheetahs and leopards are sometimes shy and you will see them better with binoculars.
reference: Singa, citah ngön rimueng kadang malee ngön gata jeuet neukalon meunatang nyan dum leubeh jeulaih ngön teropong.
hypothesis: Singa, cheetah ngon macan tutul kadang-kadang that malée dan awak jeut takalon jih leubeh get ngon binocular.

source: A walking safari (also called a "bush walk", "hiking safari", or going "footing") consists of hiking, either for a few hours or several days.
reference: Jak meusafari (kadang dikheun seubagoe "jak lam beulueka", "jak jioh meusafari", atawa jak "ngoen tapak") nyang na roeh jak jioh, jeuet padum jeuem atawa padum uroe.
hypothesis: Safari meulaye (disebut cit "jalan-jalan di uteun", "safari meulaye", atawa "meulaye") terdiri dari meulaye, nyan jeut keu padum-padum jam atawa padum uroe.

source: The Paralympics will take place from 24 August to 5 September 2021. Some events will be held in other locations throughout Japan.
reference: Paralimpik nak dimeu’en dari 24 Agustus sampoe 5 September 2021. Ladom lumba nak dimeu’en di ube na dairah-dairah laen nyang na di Jepang.
hypothesis: Paralimpiade akan di peuget nibak 24 Agustus sampoe 5 September 2021. Padum boh acara akan di peuget di teumpat-teumpat laen di seluruh Jepang.

source: Tokyo will be the only Asian city to have hosted two summer Olympics, having hosted the games in 1964.
reference: Tokyo nak jeuet keu saboh-sabohjih kuta di Asia nyang ka dipeugot duwa go summer Olimpiade, keuneulheueh dipeugot lumba inan nyankeuh bak thon 1964.
hypothesis: Tokyo akan jeut keu saboh-saboh kota di Asia nyang ka geu tuan tuan dua boh Olimpiade musim panas, lheuh geu tuan tuan game nyan bak thon 1964.

source: If you booked your flights and accommodation for 2020 before the postponement was announced, you may have a tricky situation.
reference: Meunyo gata neu pesan tiket kapai pho ngoen akomodasi keu 2020 sigohlom watë tunda nyan dibrithee, gata mungken na bak saboh keadaan nyang sosah.
hypothesis: Meunyo droeneuh ka neukeubah tiket ngon teumpat tinggai keu thon 2020 seugolom peungumuman penundaan, droeneuh mungken na lam situasi nyang sulet.

source: Cancellation policies vary, but as of late March most coronavirus-based cancellation policies don't extend to July 2020, when the Olympics had been scheduled.
reference: Aturan peubatai nyan na macam-macam, tapi bak akhe buleuen Maret dum aturan nyang peubatai seubap virus corona nyan han dipeupanyang sampoe Juli 2020, watë Olimpiade nyan ka di boh jadwal.
hypothesis: Kebijakan pembatalan meubeda, teutapi bak akhe Maret, kebijakan pembatalan nyang berbasis koronavirus hana meulanjut sampoe Juli 2020, wate Olimpiade ka teucetet.

source: It's expected that most event tickets will cost between ¥2,500 and ¥130,000, with typical tickets costing around ¥7,000.
reference: Jeuet ta kira bahwasajih dum yum tiket keu acara nyan antara ¥2,500 ngoen ¥130,000, ngôn nyang biasajih yum tiket nyan ¥7,000.
hypothesis: Diharapkan bahwa sebagian rayek tiket acara akan meu biaya antara ¥2,500 ngon ¥130,000, ngen tiket khas meu biaya sekitar ¥7,000.

source: Ironing damp clothes can help them dry. Many hotels have an iron and ironing board available for loan, even if one is not present in the room.
reference: Neugeusok bajee nyang juem jeuet peugot nyan tho. Le hotel nyang na geusok ngoen papeun geusok nyang dipeusewa, meuseuki hana meusaboh pih dipuduek lam kama.
hypothesis: Beureukat baju basah jeut membantu awak nyan keu meupeugleh. le hotel na beureukat dan papan beureukat nyang jeut dipinjam, bahkan meunyoe hana saboh di dalam kamar.

source: If an iron isn't available, or if you don't fancy wearing ironed socks, then you can try using a hairdryer, if available.
reference: Meunyo meusaboh geusok hana disinan, atawa meunyo gata hana biasa bak neusok kawoh gaki nyang meugeusok, nyan jeuet gata cuba ngoenpeutho ok (hairdryer), meunyo na teuseudiya.
hypothesis: Meunyo hana beusi, atawa meunyo hana galak pakee kaus kaki nyang beusi, jeut neu coba pakei pengering rambut, meunyo na.

source: Be careful not to allow fabric to become too hot (which can cause shrinkage, or in extreme cases, scorch).
reference: Beutegoh mangat ija lipeh bek jeuet seuuem that (nyang jeuet keu seubap baje susot, atawa lam keujadian nyang brat, tutong).
hypothesis: Waspada kheueh mangat ija hana jeuet keu seu-uem that (nyan jeut keu sabab peunyaket, atawa lam kasus ekstrim, peungéut).

source: There are different ways of purifying water, some more effective against specific threats.
reference: Na le macam cara nyang meubeda keu ta peugleh ie, ladom meuhase keu lawan sipeue-peue peunyaket.
hypothesis: Na cara nyang berbeda untuk meupeugleh ie, na nyang leubeh efektif keu geu peulheuh ancaman tertentu.

source: In some areas boiling water for a minute is enough, in others several minutes are needed.
reference: Lam ladom dairah peuseuuem ie lam seuminet nyan kasep, lam ladom dairah laen peureulee padum-padum minet.
hypothesis: Di padum-padum teumpat, iboh ie seudangkan seukitaran mantong cukup, di teumpat laen le that-that.

source: Filters vary in effectiveness, and should you have a concern, then you should consider buying your water in a sealed bottle from a reputable company.
reference: Peusareng nyan na macam-macam lam hai toh nyang leubeh meuhase, ngoen gata beu neupike keunan, oh lheueh nyan gata beu neupike keu neubloe ie lam kaca nyang meutop rapat dari pabrek nyang ka dituri.
hypothesis: Efisiensi filter meu ruwah, dan meunyoe gata na masalah, gata harôh tapike keu tapeubloe ie lam saboh botol nyang teuseupôt nibak saboh perusahaan nyang teupujoe.

source: Travellers may encounter animal pests that they are not familiar with in their home regions.
reference: Ureueng nyang jak kunjong nyan mungken meurumpok ngoen binatang hama nyang awak nyan hana dituri lom bak dairah asai awak nyan.
hypothesis: Peuneujak mungken meurumpok ngon hama binatang nyang hana awaknyan turi di daerah awak nyan.

source: Pests can spoil food, cause irritation, or in a worse case cause allergic reactions, spread venom, or transmit infections.
reference: Hama jeuet peureuloh peunajoh, peugot gatai, atawa nyang leubeh brat lom peugot wap gatai-gatai, meusipreuek bisa, atawa meukumeun.
hypothesis: Beulatang buih nyan jeuet jipeurusak peunajoh, jipeukeujot, atawa nyang leubeh parah lom, jeuet keu sabab reaksi alergi, jipeucrebre racun, atawa jipeuteuka infeksi.

source: Infectious diseases themselves, or dangerous animals that can injure or kill people by force, do not usually qualify as pests.
reference: Peunyaket nyang meujangket nyan, atawa meunatang nyang meupaloe nyang jeuet peuluka atawa jikapeulut atawa jipoh matee ureueng ngoen jipaksa, biasajih han ditamoeng lam keulompok hama.
hypothesis: Penyakit infèksi nyan keudroe, atawa binatang nyang berbahaya nyang jeut meupeusakét atawa geupoh manusia ngon paksa, biasa jih hana layak keu hama.

source: Duty free shopping is the opportunity to buy goods exempted from taxes and excises at certain locations.
reference: Beulanja pree nyankeuh ruweung neubloe barang nyang han keunong wase ngoen cukai bak saboh-saboh teumpat.
hypothesis: Belanja bebas pajak adalah kesempatan untuk meuli barang nyang dipeubeubaih dari pajak dan accises di lokasi tertentu.

source: Travellers bound for countries with heavy taxation can sometimes save a considerable amount of money, especially on products such as alcoholic beverages and tobacco.
reference: Jamee nyang geusaweu u nanggroe deungon wase nyang brat kadang jeuet geukeubah jai peng, phôn that bak dabeuh lagee ie mabok ngôn bakong.
hypothesis: Ureueng meuneujak nyang jak u nanggroe-nanggroe nyang na pajak rayek kadang-kadang jeut jipeubateu le that-that, terutama nibak barang-barang lage minuman alkohol ngon tembakau.

source: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain.
reference: Gareh toe-toe titek Marison ngoen Fairmont jipeuleumah nyang paleng meunantang bak Kuebeu-Jalan Rayeuk Pittsburgh, kayem leupah u dairah uteuen nyang jioh.
hypothesis: Bagian antara Point Marion ngen Fairmont na kondisi pengemudi yang paleng tantangan di jalan raya Buffalo-Pittsburgh, yang sering melewati medan hutan terpencil.

source: If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate.
reference: Meunyoe gata hana kayem neume moto bak jalan gampong, beutathee lam pikeran droeneuh: jalan nyang ubeut, ngoen tikongan tajam jai that.
hypothesis: Meunyo droeneuh hana biasa neujak bak jalan-jalan gampong, neuseupôt kheueh droe: rot-rot nyang meujeumeulah tajam, jalur-jalur nyang ubit, dan tikek-tikek nyang tajam.

source: Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise.
reference: Ceu bagah diplueng moto nyang dipeudeuh nyan meudum trep that nibak bagoe sigohlomjih ngoen nyang ‘oh lheueh nyan — biasajih 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — ngoen beubrat tapateh keu awakjih nyan leubeh peunteng nibak buet laen.
hypothesis: Batasan kecepatan nyang dipeuteubiet lubeh rhet nibak bagian awai ngon seulanjut jih  umum jih 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h)  dan patuh nyang ketat bak nyan bahkan leubeh peunteng nibak laen jih.

source: Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.
reference: Adakpih, bingoeng, layanan talipun biyasa hinoe leubeh teuga, dibandeng teumpat laen seupanyang jalan, tamsejih Uteun Rimba Pennsylvania.
hypothesis: Namun, yang aneh jih, layanan telepon seluler jauh leubeh kuat di sini daripada di seutara rute laen jih, misalnya di Pennsylvania Wilds.

source: German pastries are quite good, and in Bavaria, are quite rich and varied, similar to those of their southern neighbor, Austria.
reference: Peunajoh kueh asai Jerman nyan cukop mangat, ngoen nyang na di Bavaria, ladom meumacam rasa ngoen meumacam bagoe, rap saban lagee jiran awaknyan nyang na i tunoeng, Austria.
hypothesis: Kue-kue Jerman nyan get that, dan di Bavaria, nyan cukop kaya dan meupeuran, saban lagee di tetangga di selatan, Austria.

source: Fruit pastries are common, with apples cooked into pastries year round, and cherries and plums making their appearances during the summer.
reference: Peunajoh kueh dari boh kayee nyan ka jeuet keu hai nyang lazem, ngon boh apel nyang ditaguen lam peunajoh kueh lam sithon punoeh, ngon boh ceri ngon boh plum na deuh ta kaloen watee musem seuuem.
hypothesis: Kue buah biasa, deungon apel nyang dipeumasak keu kue siram seulama thon, dan ceri ngon plum nyang meumada bak musem siuroe.

source: Many German baked goods also feature almonds, hazelnuts, and other tree nuts. Popular cakes often pair particularly well with a cup of strong coffee.
reference: Jai ureueng Jeurman nyang tot peunajoh kuweh na cit geuboh kacang almond, kacang hazelnut, ngon meubagoe kacang dari bak kayee nyang laen. Peunajoh kuweh nyang dituri nyan kayem mangat dipajoh sira ngon tajep saboh glah ie kupi nyang kreuh.
hypothesis: Le that peuneugöt nyang geupeugot di Jerman nyang na cit meubagoe rupa boh kacang-kacangan, kacang-kacangan, dan kacang-kacangan.

source: If you want some small though rich pastries, try what depending on region are called Berliner, Pfannkuchen or Krapfen.
reference: Meunnyoe gata hawa keu peunajoh kue kreuh nyang mangat rasa, Aci neu ujoe rasa nyang na i dairah nyang dikheun Berliner, Pfannkuchen atawa Krapfen.
hypothesis: Meunyo droeneuh keuneuk kue-kue ubit nyang kaya, cuba kheueh peue nyang geupeunan Berliner, Pfannkuchen atawa Krapfen.

source: A curry is a dish based on herbs and spices, together with either meat or vegetables.
reference: Peunajoh kari nyang na keuh saboh teumon bu dari meubagoe oen kayee ngoen dabeuh maguen, geujampu ngoen eungkot sie atawa gulee.
hypothesis: Kari adalah sajian nyang geupeuget nibak ramuan ngon bumbu, meusama ngon sie atawa sayuran.

source: A curry can be either "dry" or "wet" depending on the amount of liquid.
reference: Peunajoh kari nyan na nyang "tho" atawa "meukuwah" nyan dipeuteunte ile dum na jai ie.
hypothesis: Kari jeut "kaco" atawa "ka basah" tergantung bak jumlah cairan.

source: In inland regions of Northern India and Pakistan, yogurt is commonly used in curries; in Southern India and some other coastal regions of the subcontinent, coconut milk is commonly used.
reference: Dairah nyang meugampong i bahgian India Utara ngoen Pakistan, yogurt nyan lazem diboih lam peunajoh kari, i India Tunong ngoen ladom daerah pantee i bahgian beunua, ie santan lazem di boih lam atra nyan.
hypothesis: Di daerah dalam daratan India Utara ngen Pakistan, yogurt biasa dipakek dalam kari; di India Selatan ngen padum boh daerah pantai subbenua, susu kelapa biasa dipakek.

source: With 17,000 islands to choose from, Indonesian food is an umbrella term covering a vast variety of regional cuisines found across the nation.
reference: Ngoen 17.000 pulo nyang jeuet tapileh, Peunajoh Indonesia nyan lagee ban tamselan payong nyang khop wilayah nyang luwah that nibak meubagoe macam peunajoh nyang jeuet ta tumee ban saboh nanggroe.
hypothesis: Ngon 17.000 pulo keu teupileh, makanan Indonesia nyan adalah istilah umum nyang meupeutrang le macam-macam masakan regional nyang na di ban saboh nanggroe.

source: But, if used without further qualifiers, the term tends to mean the food originally from the central and eastern parts of the main island Java.
reference: Tapih, meunyoe hana ta nilai leubeh jioh, tamselan nyan jeuet keu diboih makna peunajoh nyang troh nibak wilayah bahgian teungoh ngoen timue pulo Jawa sagai.
hypothesis: Teuma, meunyo dipakek tanpa kualifikasi laen, istilah nyoe cenderung meuarti makanan asai jih dari bagian pusat ngon timu pulau utama Jawa.

source: Now widely available throughout the archipelago, Javanese cuisine features an array of simply seasoned dishes, the predominant flavorings the Javanese favor being peanuts, chillies, sugar (especially Javanese coconut sugar) and various aromatic spices.
reference: Jinoe dum pat na ban mandum pulo, Peunajoh ureueng Jawa nyan na saboh peukateun nyang deuh nibak cara geuboh dabeuh magun nyang seudang, dabeuh magun nyang paleng jai geu boih le ureueng Jawa na keuh boh kacang tanoh, campli, saka (teuleubeh lom saka boh u Jawa) ngoen meubagoe debeuh magun nyang meubhee harom.
hypothesis: Jinoe le that di ban saboh Nusantara, masakan Jawa na macam-macam hidangan nyang hanya diasah, bahan-bahan yang paleng galak di Jawa nakeuh kacang, cabe, gula (khusus jih gula kelapa Jawa) dan macam-macam bumbu aromatik.

source: Stirrups are supports for the rider's feet that hang down on either side of the saddle.
reference: Sanggrudi nyan na keuh ngoen puduek tapak gaki sidroe ureueng nyang ek guda nyang na di miyup ban duwa blah teumpat duek ateuh guda.
hypothesis: Stirrup adalah dukungan keu gaki peungendara nyang meugantung di dua sisi sadara.

source: They provide greater stability for the rider but can have safety concerns due to the potential for a rider's feet to get stuck in them.
reference: Atra duwa nyan jeuet keuh sabagoe peukakah keu peuaman ureueng nyang ek guda tapi jeuet cit keu meupaloe kareuna mungken gaki ureueng nyang ek guda jeuet meusangkot lam atra duwa nyan.
hypothesis: Awaknyan meujok stabilitas nyang leubeh rayek keu peungendara teutapi jeut na masalah keamanan kareuna potensi keu gaki peungendara jeut teutap di dalam jih.

source: If a rider is thrown from a horse but has a foot caught in the stirrup, they could be dragged if the horse runs away. To minimize this risk, a number of safety precautions can be taken.
reference: Meunyoe sidroe ureueng nyang ek guda nyan rhot dari guda tapih siblah gaki gobnyan mantoeng meusangkot lam sanggrudi, ureueng nyan meubahue ateuh tanoh meunyoe guda teuga diplung. Keu tatheun bahya nyan, ladom cara keu peuaman droe jeuet ta cok seugohlom nyan.
hypothesis: Meunyoe sidroe ureuëng meuguda teutiek nibak guda teuma gaki jih teudrob lam tanggong, awak nyan jeut ji tarek lom meunyoe guda nyan jiplueng.

source: First, most riders wear riding boots with a heel and a smooth, quite narrow, sole.
reference: Keuphôn, dum ureueng nyang ek guda suwah sok sipatu nyang na tumet ngoen tapak sipatu nyang haloh, ubit bacut.
hypothesis: Phon-phon, le peungendara geungui bot peungendara deungen tumet ngon seulob nyang lipeh, that sampiek.

source: Next, some saddles, particularly English saddles, have safety bars that allow a stirrup leather to fall off the saddle if pulled backwards by a falling rider.
reference: Lheuhnyan, ladom teumpat duek ateuh guda, teuleubeh lom teumpat duek Inggreh, na kayee keu peuaman nyang jeuet di peu rhot taloe teumpat meusangkot sanggrudi meunyoe meutarek u likot watë rhot ureueng nyang ba guda.
hypothesis: Seulaen nyan, padum boh sadel, terutama sadel Inggreh, na bar pengaman yang memungkinkan kulit yang ditarik dari sadel jika ditarik ke belakang oleh penunggang yang jatuh.

source: Cochamó Valley - Chile's premier climbing destination, known as the Yosemite of South America, with a variety of granite big walls and crags.
reference: Jeureulong Cochamó - saboh teumpat ek cot numboi sa nyang na di Chili dituri cit ngoen nan Yosemite di Ameurika Tunong, ngoen meubagoe binteh ngoen kareung dari granit.
hypothesis: Lembah Cochamó - tujuan pendakian utama Chili, nyang jituri seubagoe Yosemite Amerika Selatan, deungen macam-macam bintéh granit rayeuk ngon teuntra.

source: Summits include breath-taking views from peaks. Climbers from all parts of the world are continually establishing new routes amongst its endless potential of walls.
reference: Puncak na peumandangan nyang lagak dari ateuh. Ureueng nyang ek cot nyang teuka dari meubagoe bahgian bumoe tiep sabee na geupeuna jalan baro u meubagoe binteh nyang hana akhe nyan.
hypothesis: Meunjoë nyan na pandangan nyang that indah nibak pucak-pucak. Peurjueng dari mandum bagian donya sabe jipeugöt rot-rot barô di antara potensi beuton-beuton nyan nyang hana meupeukara.

source: Downhill snowsports, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular sports involving sliding down snow-covered terrain with skis or a snowboard attached to your feet.
reference: Ulahraga salju u arah troen buket, nyang na keuh ski ngon seluncoe salju, nyan keuh ulahraga nyang jituri nyang na roh meuluncoe u arah miyup i tanoeh nyang meutop ngon salju ngon ski atawa ngon seuluncoe salju nyang meusangkot ngon gaki gata.
hypothesis: Meunjoë-meunjoë di barôh, nyang meu'en ski ngon snowboard, nakeuh olahraga nyang that populer nyang meu'en glis di tanoh nyang meu'en salju deungon ski atawa snowboard nyang teutap bak gaki.

source: Skiing is a major travelling activity with many enthusiasts, occasionally known as "ski bums," planning entire vacations around skiing at a particular location.
reference: Meu’en ski na keuh keu tujuan utama dari jak meu’en nyang rame ureueng galak, kadang na jiboh nan seubagoe "ureueng nyang udep keu ski", nyang ka geu peugoet reuncana jak watë pre keu meu’en ski bak saboh teumpat meuteunte.
hypothesis: Ski adalah aktivitas perjalanan utama deungen le peugalak, kadang-kadang dikhen "ski bums", yang dipeurancang mandum liburan seputar ski di lokasi tertentu.

source: The idea of skiing is very old — cave paintings depicting skiers date back as far as 5000 BC!
reference: Asai dari ski nyan ka tuha that — gamba nyan jigamba i guha geu peugah nibak ureueng nyang meu’en ski dari jameun ka trep that 5000 BC!
hypothesis: Gagasan ski nyan that tuha  lukisan guha nyang meupeudeuh para peunari nyan seujak 5000 SM!

source: Downhill skiing as a sport goes back to at least the 17th century, and in 1861 the first recreational ski club was opened by Norwegians in Australia.
reference: Ski u arah tron buket seubagoe saboh ulahraga ka mulai na paleng kureung wateë abad keu-17, ngon wateë 1861 teumpat keu meu’en ski nyang keu-phôn that i buka le ureueng Norwegia di Australia.
hypothesis: Ski downhill seubagai olahraga meuwoe bak abad keu-17, ngen bak thon 1861 klub ski rekreasi phon ji buka le Norwegia di Australia.

source: Backpacking by ski: This activity is also called backcountry ski, ski touring or ski hiking.
reference: Meuba tah raya sira meu’en ski: Buet nyoe jeuet cit dikheun ski u alam luwa, ski sira jak jioh atawa ski sira ek gunong.
hypothesis: Backpacking ngen ski: Kegiatan nyoe cit dikhen backcountry ski, ski touring atau ski hiking.

source: It is related to but usually not involving alpine style ski touring or mountaineering, the latter ones done in steep terrain and requiring much stiffer skis and boots.
reference: Nyoe meusangkot tapih hana roeh ngôn jak jioh ski aleh alpine atawa jak ek gunong, nyang keuneuleuh nyoe ipubuet i wilayah tanoh nyang meureuleueng ngoen peureulee keu alat ski ngoen sipatu nyang kreuh.
hypothesis: Nyo meuhubong deungen tapi biasa jih hana melibatkan ski alpine atau mendaki gunung, yang keudua nyan dilakukan di medan curam ngen meuminta ski ngen sepatu bot yang leubeh kaku.

source: Think of the skiing route as of a similar hiking route.
reference: Neupikee mantoeng rauh jak ski nyang saban cit lagee jalan jak ek gunong.
hypothesis: Pike rot ski nyan lagee rot meulangkah nyang saban.

source: In good conditions you will be able to cover somewhat greater distances than walking – but only very seldom you will get the speeds of cross country skiing without a heavy backpack in groomed tracks.
reference: Lam watë nyang get gata keuneuk troh u teumpat nyang leubeh jioh lom nibak neujak ngoen tapak – tapi jareung that gata keuneuk troh bagah lagee tajak ngoen ski i alam luwa ngoen hana tah geuhon sajan watë i jalan nyang biyasa.
hypothesis: Lam kondisi nyang get awak nyan jeut keu ji peuget jarak nyang leubeh rayek nibak ji jak  tapi hanya seucara jarang awak nyan jeut keu ji peuget kecepatan ski lintas nanggroe tanpa tasek nyang brat bak jalur nyang ka dipeusiap.

source: Europe is a continent that is relatively small but with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, travelling through multiple countries would mean having to go through visa applications and passport control multiple times.
reference: Eropa nakeuh saboh benua nyang relatif ubeut teutapi deungoen le nanggroe meurdehka. Jimiyub keadaan normal, meujak-jak rhot padum boh nanggroe wajeb liwat aplikasi visa ngoen geupareksa paspor padum go.
hypothesis: Eropa adalah benua nyang relatif ubit teuma na le nanggroe nyang independen. lam keadaan normal, meuneujak meulinteung le nanggroe akan meuarti meulanggeh aplikasi visa dan kontrol paspor meupadum goe.

source: The Schengen zone, however, works somewhat like one country in this respect.
reference: Wilayah Schengen, adak pih, keureuja karab lage saboh nanggroe lam geuhormati nyoe.
hypothesis: Namun, wilayah Schengen, lam hai nyoe, meuubuet lagee saboh nanggroe.

source: As long as you stay in this zone, you can generally cross borders without going through passport control checkpoints again.
reference: Watë gata tinggai lam wilayah nyoe, gata biasajih jeuet liwat peurbatasan hana jak rhot poh peupareksa paspor dile.
hypothesis: Seulama awak tinggai di zona nyo, awak umum jih jeut meulintasi bata tanpa meulinteh pos kontrol paspor lom.

source: Similarly, by having a Schengen visa, you do not need to apply for visas to each of the Schengen member countries separately, hence saving time, money and paperwork.
reference: Lage nyan cit, na poe visa Schengen, gata hana peurlee ngui visa keu maseng-maseng nanggroe anggota Schengen, jeuet keubah watë, peng ngoen beureukas.
hypothesis: Meunan cit deungon na visa Schengen, awak nyan hana peureulée geulakee visa keu tieb-tieb nanggroë anggota Schengen secara terpisah, deungon nyan meuhasekan watee, peng ngon keureuja peuneupah.

source: There is no universal definition for which manufactured items are antiques. Some tax agencies define goods older than 100 years as antiques.
reference: Hana difinisi umum keu bagoe dabeuh-dabeuh nyang jipeugoet dikheun keu dabeuh antik. Ladom agen pajak geuteutapkan dabeuh nyang sep brat trep ka dari 100 thon seubagoe dabeuh antik.
hypothesis: Hana definisi universal untuk barang-barang nyang dipeuget adalah barang antik. padum boh lembaga pajak geu definisikan barang nyang leubeh tuha dari 100 thon seubagai barang antik.

source: The definition has geographic variations, where the age limit might be shorter in places such as North America than in Europe.
reference: Difinisi nyan nakeuh meubagoe macam meuhubong ngôn wilayah, nibak ceu umu mungken paneuk that i teumpat – teumpat lage Ameurika Tunong dari i Ierupa.
hypothesis: Definisi na variasi geografis, di pat batas umur mungken leubeh paneuk di teumpat-teumpat lage Amerika Utara daripada di Eropa.

source: Handicraft products might be defined as antiques, though they are younger than similar mass-produced goods.
reference: Buet jaroe jeuet jikheun seubagoe dabeuh antik, adakpi atranyan leubeh ban na nibak peuneugot ureueng ramee nyang sama hi.
hypothesis: Produk kerajinan jeut didefinisikan seubagai barang antik, meskipun jih leubeh muda dari barang produksi massal nyang sama.

source: Reindeer husbandry is an important livelihood among the Sámi and the culture surrounding the trade is important also for many with other professions.
reference: Peularha rusa nyan keuh cara mita raseuki i seulingka ureueng Sámi ngoen budaya seulingka bloe meubloe nyankeuh cara mita raseuki peunteng sit keu ureueng ramee ngoen pangkat laen.
hypothesis: Pemeliharaan rusa adalah cara peuriwaian yang peunteng di antara bangsa Sami dan budaya nyang meupeukara ngen perdagangan nyan peunteng cit keu le ureung yang na profesi laen.

source: Even traditionally, though, not all Sámi have been involved in big scale reindeer husbandry, but lived from fishing, hunting and similar, having reindeer mostly as draft animals.
reference: Bahpih seucara tradisional, adakpi, hana mandum ureueng Sámi rhoh lam peularha rusa lam jumlah nyang jai, tapih udep ngoen geukeumawe, jak lam uteun ngoen seujeunehjih, na rusa na ladom nyang jai meunatang teumarek.
hypothesis: Bahkan secara tradisional, teutapi, hana mandum Sami ka teurlibat dalam penggembalaan rusa skala rayek, teutapi udep dari mancing, perburuan dan seubaroih, na rusa seubagian rayek seubagai binatang tarek.

source: Today many Sámi work in modern trades. Tourism is an important income in Sápmi, the Sámi area.
reference: Uroe nyoe jai ureueng Sámi keureuja bak bloe peubloe nyang moderen. Ureueng jak tamasya nyankeuh wase nyang peuteng i Sámi.
hypothesis: Jinoe le ureung Sam bekerja bak buet-buet modern. pariwisata adalah pendapatan yang peunteng di Sápmi, daerah Sam.

source: Though it is widely used, especially among non-Romani, the word "Gypsy" is often considered offensive because of its associations with negative stereotypes and inaccurate perceptions of Romani people.
reference: Bahpih nyan jai jiboh, keu phôn that bak kalangan non-Romani, kata "gipsi" kayem jianggap teupeh kareuna meusapatjih ngoen nilai hana get ngoen pandangan nyang hana trang keu awak Romani.
hypothesis: Meskipun jih kayem dipakek, terutama di antara non-Roma, kata "Gypsy" seureng dianggap menyinggung karena hubongan jih deungen stereotip negatif dan persepsi nyang hana akurat tentang ureung Roma.

source: If the country you will be visiting becomes subject to a travel advisory, your travel health insurance or your trip cancellation insurance may be affected.
reference: Meunyoe nanggroe nyang droeneuh jak saweu tundok keu haba peuingat bak rauh, asuransi keusihatan peurjalanan droeneuh mungken teupeungaroh bak asuransi peubateu peurjalanan droeneuh.
hypothesis: Meunyo nanggroe nyang akan neujak nyan jeut keu subjek peunasihat perjalanan, asuransi kesehatan perjalanan atau asuransi pembatalan perjalanan jeut keunong.

source: You may also wish to consult the advice of governments other than your own, but their advice is designed for their citizens.
reference: Droeneuh mungken jeuet sit neuteumanyoeng deungoen saran pomeurintah selaen droe teuh, tapih saranjih nyankeuh nyang jirancang keu ureueng gampongjih.
hypothesis: Gata mungken pih keuneuk neuseulidek naseuhat peumeurintah nyang laén, teuma naseuhat awaknyan geukeuneuk peubantu rakyat.

source: As one example, American citizens in the Middle East might face different situations from Europeans or Arabs.
reference: Lage saboh miseu, awak nanggroe Ameurika i timu teungoeh mungken geuhadapi keuadaan nyang meubeda nibak ureueng Eropa ngoen ureueng Arab.
hypothesis: Sebagai saboh contoh, warga Amerika di Timur Tengah mungken menghadapi situasi yang berbeda dari Eropa atau Arab.

source: Advisories are merely a brief summary of the political situation in one country.
reference: Nasihat nakeuh saboh ceurita tuet bak keuadaan politek i saboh nanggroe.
hypothesis: Peunasihat nyan hanya saboh ringkasan singkat dari situasi politik di saboh nanggroe.

source: The views presented are often cursory, general and oversimplified compared to the more detailed information available elsewhere.
reference: Tampilan nyang jiseudiya kayem sigoe ble, umum ngoen jipeupah jeuet keu haba nyang leubeh trang jiseudiya bak teumpat laen.
hypothesis: Pendapat nyang geu peutrang nyan seureng that seucara seucara seucara seucara umum dan geu peusaboh leubeh le daripada informasi nyang leubeh teuliti nyang na di teumpat laen.

source: Severe weather is the generic term for any dangerous weather phenomenon with the potential to cause damage, serious social disruption, or loss of human life.
reference: Cuwaca brok nyankeuh istilah umum keu tip fenomena cuwaca nyang meupaloe nyang teubit sabap reulhoh, keubit peugabuk dum ureueng, atawa gadoh nyawoeng ureueng.
hypothesis: Cuaca parah adalah istilah umum untuk fenomena cuaca berbahaya yeng berpotensi menyebabkan kerusakan, gangguan sosial serius, atau kehilangan nyawa manusia.

source: Severe weather can occur anywhere in the world, and there are different types of it, which can depend on geography, topography, and atmospheric conditions.
reference: Cuwaca hana get keu neukjeuet dumpat lam dônya, ngoen meubagoe jeuneh, nyan jeuet meusangkot bak geografi, topografi, ngoen keuadaan atmosfir.
hypothesis: Cuaca parah jeut terjadi di pat mantong di donya, dan na macam-macam jenis jih, yeng jeut bergantung bak geografi, topografi, ngen kondisi atmosfer.

source: High winds, hail, excessive precipitation, and wildfires are forms and effects of severe weather, as are thunderstorms, tornadoes, waterspouts, and cyclones.
reference: Angen bade, ujeun eh, ujeun raya, ngoen tutoeng uteun sabap cuwaca hana get, lage bade geulanteu, angen topan, angen puteng beuliyong, ngoen angen meuputa.
hypothesis: Angén raya, ujeuen éeh, ujeuen ujeun nyang lumpah that brat, dan apui gle na kheueh meubagoe rupa cuaca nyang parah, lagée angén badée, ribut, angén badée, dan topan.

source: Regional and seasonal severe weather phenomena include blizzards, snowstorms, ice storms, and dust storms.
reference: Fenomena cuwaca hana get ngoen teumpat teumasok bade salju, bade-bade salju, bade eh, ngoen bade abee.
hypothesis: Fenomena cuaca parah regional ngen musem termasuk badai salju, badai salju, badai es, ngen badai debu.

source: Travellers are strongly advised to be aware of any risk of severe weather affecting their area as they may affect any travel plans.
reference: Ureueng jak tamasya sep brat geubi nasihat beu teugoh that meuresiko cuwaca hana get nyang meupeungaroh teumpat awak nyan kareuna jeuet keu mepeungaroh dumpue peurjalanan.
hypothesis: Peuneunjangan geu sarankan beu sadar keu resiko cuaca parah yang meupeungaroh wilayah awak nyan kareuna nyan jeut meupeungaroh rencana perjalanan.

source: Anyone planning a visit to a country that could be considered a war zone should get professional training.
reference: Sibeurangkasoe nyang keuneuk saweu u nanggroe nyang ka jianggap teumpat meuprang suwah meutume peulatihan profisional.
hypothesis: Soe mantong nyang na rencana jak u nanggroe nyang jeut dianggap sebagai zona prang, harus mendapat pelatihan profesional.

source: A search of the Internet for 'Hostile environment course' will probably provide the address of a local company.
reference: Seutot bak internet keu 'Meurunoe bak teumpat nyang na musoh' mungken jibi alamat peurusahaan lam wilayah droe.
hypothesis: Seumita bak internet untuk 'Kursus lingkungan nyang hana ramah' mungken akan meujok alamat perusahaan lokal.

source: A course will normally cover all the issues discussed here in far greater detail, usually with practical experience.
reference: Jak meurunoe biasajih neuk teumasok ban mandum peukara nyang jipeugah hinoe ngoen abeh mandum, biasajih ngoen peungalaman pubuet langsong.
hypothesis: Saboh kursus akan meujok mandum masalah nyang dibahas di sini deungon leubeh that detail, biasa jih deungon pengalaman praktis.

source: A course will normally be from 2-5 days and will involve role play, a lot of first aid and sometimes weapons training.
reference: Jak meurunoe biasajih teumasok 2-5 uroe ngoen roh meu’en droe, jai soe tuloeng bak phôn ngoen meurunoe seunjata.
hypothesis: Kursus biasa jih 2-5 uroe dan akan meupeurleun peran, le bantuan phon dan kadang-kadang latihan senjata.

source: Books and magazines dealing with wilderness survival are common, but publications dealing with war zones are few.
reference: Buku ngoen majalah nyang meusangkot ngoen udep uteuen beulantara nyankeuh hai ladem, tapi publikasi nyang meusangkot bacut ngoen wilayah prang.
hypothesis: Buku ngon majalah nyang meupeutrang keuhai cara udeb di padang pasi ka kayém that, teuma hana le nyang meupeutrang keuhai daerah-daerah nyang keunong prang.

source: Voyagers planning sex reassignment surgery abroad must ensure they're carrying valid documents for the return trip.
reference: Ureueng tamasya nyang niet geuneuk operasi meunale iluwa nanggroe suwah geu peuteunte bahwasajih awaknyan jiba beureukah nyang geuakui keu peurjalanan woe.
hypothesis: Traveler nyang na rencana operasi peubah jenis kelamin di lua nanggroe harus memastikan awak nyan na dokumen nyang sah untuk perjalanan pulang.

source: The willingness of governments to issue passports with gender not stated (X) or documents updated to match a desired name and gender varies.
reference: Geutem pomeurentah peutubiet paspor ngoen jeuneh keulamin nynag hana geuseubot (X) atawa beureukah jipeubaro nak saban ngoen nan nyang galak geuh ngoen meubagoe jeuneh keulamin.
hypothesis: Keukeuhatan pemerintah untuk meujok paspor deungen jenis kelamin hana dituri (X) atau dokumen yang diperbarui untuk sesuai deungen nan dan jenis kelamin yang diinginkan bervariasi.

source: Willingness of foreign governments to honour these documents is just as widely variable.
reference: Geutem poemeurentah luwa keu geupeuyum buereukah-beureukah nyan sit sep meumacam bagoe.
hypothesis: Keukeuheundak pemerintah lua keu menghormati dokumen nyoe cit that meubeda.

source: Searches at security checkpoints have also become far more intrusive in the post-September 11, 2001 era.
reference: Taseutoet bak pos peumeuriksaan keuamanan pih meutamah brat gabuek bak lheuh 11 September, masa 2001.
hypothesis: Pencarian bak pos-pos keamanan pih ka leubeh brat bak era seujak 11 September 2001.

source: Pre-operative transgender people should not expect to pass through the scanners with their privacy and dignity intact.
reference: Ureueng transgender Lheuh-Operasi jeuet han jiharap keu leupah peumindai deungoen privasi ngoen matabat awaknyan keunong.
hypothesis: Ureueng transgender nyang ka lheueh operasi han jeut ta harap jeut lewat scanner deungon privasi dan martabat jih hana rusak.

source: Rip currents are the returning flow from waves breaking off the beach, often at a reef or similar.
reference: Ie meuguloeng nyankeuh riyeuk meuhambo i bineh pasi, kayem i ateuh bate kareung atawa ngoen seujeunehjih.
hypothesis: Rip currents adalah aliran nyang geuwoe dari gelombang nyang meucre nibak pantai, seureng that bak karang atawa nyang serupa.

source: Due to the underwater topology the return flow is concentrated at a few deeper sections, and a fast current to deep water may form there.
reference: Kareuna topologi imiyup ie, ilee ie meuriwang le bak padit boh bahgian nyang lhok, ngoen ilee ie nyang sep bagah u ie nyang lhok mungken asai phôn jisinan.
hypothesis: Kareuna topologi di miyueb ie, aliran pulang geu konsentrasi bak padum boh bagian nyang leubeh dalam, dan arus bagah keu ie dalam jeut geu bentuk di sinan.

source: Most deaths happen as result of fatigue trying to swim back against the current, which may be impossible.
reference: Dum ureueng meuninggai kareuna hek meulangue geutheun ie, nyang mungken mustahe.
hypothesis: Le that-that ureuëng maté sabab ka hék that-that ji meuheut ji ék u likot, nyang mungken hana hase.

source: As soon as you get out of the current, swimming back is no more difficult than normally.
reference: Lam sigra lheuh tatubiet nibak ie, tameulangue kop payah dari biasajih.
hypothesis: Meunan awak nyan ka teubiet nibak arus, awak nyan pih hana payah lom keujiwoe.

source: Try aiming somewhere where you are not caught again or, depending on your skills and on whether you have been noticed, you might want to wait for rescue.
reference: Ci neujak u arah bak saboh teumpat dipat gata han le roeh lam nyan atawa, meugantong bak keuahlian gata ngoen pue gata peuratie, gata mungken neupreh jituloeng.
hypothesis: Cuba kheueh gata peugöt sasaran mangat gata hana jiteumé lom, atawa, tergantung bak keuahlian gata dan peu kheueh gata ka deuh jikalon lé gob, mungken gata leubeh galak tapreh ureuëng laén jijak tulông gata.

source: Re-entry shock comes on sooner than culture shock (there's less of a honeymoon phase), lasts longer, and can be more severe.
reference: Teukeujot aleuh geutamong teuma leubeh bagah teujadi dari teukeujot budaya (hana had buleun phon), leubeh trep ngoh leubeh brat.
hypothesis: Keukeujaman re-entry terjadi leubeh awai dari keukeujaman budaya (na fase bulan madu nyang leubeh bacut), meuteun leubeh treb, dan jeut leubeh parah.

source: Travellers who had an easy time adjusting to the new culture sometimes have a particularly hard time readjusting to their native culture.
reference: Awak galak jak nyang na watee mangat geupeusaban droegeuh ngon adat baro meujan-jan payah that roh geupeusaban droe ngon budaya droegeuh.
hypothesis: Ureuëng nyang ka meujak u nanggroe laén nyang hana hase jibantu lé budaya nyang barô nyan, kadang-kadang payah that jibantu lé budaya nanggroe nyan.

source: When returning home after living abroad, you've adapted to the new culture and lost some of your habits from your home culture.
reference: Watee woe u rumoh lheuh geuduek iluwa nanggroe, droe neuh ka neu peubiasa droe ngon adat baro ngon gadoh adat droe neuh dari nanggroe asai.
hypothesis: Wate neuwoe nibak tinggai di lua nanggroe, awak ka ta adaptasi deungen budaya baroe dan ka hana le kebiasaan dari budaya rumoh awak.

source: When you went abroad at first, people were probably patient and understanding, knowing that travellers in a new country need to adapt.
reference: Watee dron neuh phon trok u luwa nanggroe, ureueng mungken saba ngon meuphom, awaknyan jitupeue awak galak jak bak nanggroe baro peureule peusaban droe.
hypothesis: Watée gata meujak u nanggroe laén, ureuëng-ureuëng nyan mungken leubeh saba dan leubeh muphom keu gata, sabab awaknyan jiteupeue bahwa ureuëng nyang jijak u nanggroe nyang barô nyan harôh jituri keu hai-hai nyang ka jirasa.

source: People may not anticipate that patience and understanding are also necessary for travellers returning home.
reference: Ureueng mungken hana geutupeue bahwa saba ngon meuphom nyan peureulee keu awak galak jak-jak nyang woe u rumoh.
hypothesis: Ureuëng-ureuëng nyan mungken hana jipike bahwa awaknyan pih peureulée that saba dan muphom keu ureuëng-ureuëng nyang teungoh jiwoe u nanggroe jih.

source: The pyramid sound and light show is one of the most interesting things in the area for kids.
reference: Su meulagu ngoen cahya piramida nyankeuh saboh hai nyang sep lagak bak teumpat nyan keu aneuk miet.
hypothesis: Piramid nyan na kheueh saboh acara nyang paleng menarik keu aneuk miet.

source: You can see the pyramids in the dark and you can see them in silence before the show begins.
reference: Gata jeut taeu piramida nyan lam seupôt ngön lam seungap sigohlom piasan nyan dipuphôn.
hypothesis: Neupeuleumah piramid lam seupôt ngon neupeuleumah awaknyan lam teunang sigohlom acara nyan dimulai.

source: Usually you always here the sound of tourists and vendors. The story of the sound and light is just like a story book.
reference: Biasajih gata sabèe tadeungoe su ureueng meukunjông ngön ureueng meukat. Calitra su ngön calitra cahya nyan lagèe saboh buku calitra.
hypothesis: Biasa awak nyan sabe tadeungo su wisatawan dan peubloe. Kisah su ngon cahya nyan saban lagee buku dongeng.

source: The Sphinx is set as the backdrop and the narrator of a long story.
reference: Sphinx nyan dipeujeut keu layeu di likôt ngön keu nyang peugah saboh calitra nyang panyang.
hypothesis: Sphinx dipeuget seubagai latar ngon narator saboh kisah panyang.

source: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids and the different pyramids are lit up.
reference: Gamba-gamba dipeudeuh bak piramida nyan, ngön piramida-piramida laén dipeuhu cahya.
hypothesis: Adean nyan ditampilkan bak piramida dan piramida yang berbeda di peutrang.

source: South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several nations and have the most bases, with sixteen active in 2020.
reference: Pulo Shetland Seulatan, nyang diteumèe bak thôn 1819, diakui lé padum boh nanggroe, pulo nyan na paléng lë markah teuntra, deungön nam blah nyang manteng aktif lam thôn 2020.
hypothesis: Pulo Shetland Selatan, yeng ditumeng bak thon 1819, diklaim le padim boh negara ngen na pangkalan paleng le, deungen nam blah aktif bak thon 2020.

source: The archipelago lies 120 km north of the Peninsula. The largest is King George Island with the settlement of Villa Las Estrellas.
reference: Pulo nyan meuleueng 120 km u baroh di ujông. Nyang paléng rayek nakeuh Pulo King George deungön pemukiman Villa Las Estrellas.
hypothesis: Nusantara nyoë na 120 km di utara Semenanjung. Pulo Raja George nyang paleng rayek na di pulo nyan ngon teumpat tinggai Villa Las Estrellas.

source: Others include Livingston Island, and Deception where the flooded caldera of a still-active volcano provides a spectacular natural harbour.
reference: Pulo nyang laén nakeuh Pulo Livingston, ngön pulo Deception nyang ile kaldera dari gunong meuapui yang manteng aktif, atranyan peugot peulabohan deuh lagak.
hypothesis: Laen laen termasuk Pulau Livingston, ngen Deception di pat kaldera nyang ka lheueng dari gunung berapi yang manteng aktif menyediakan pelabuhan alami yang spektakuler.

source: Ellsworth Land is the region south of the Peninsula, bounded by the Bellingshausen Sea.
reference: Ellsworth Land nakeuh dairah blah tunong ujông tanjong, diceue lé Laôt Bellingshausen.
hypothesis: Tanoh Ellsworth adalah wilayah di selatan Semenanjung, yang dibatasi le Laot Bellingshausen.

source: The mountains of the Peninsula here merge into the plateau, then re-emerge to form the 360 km chain of the Ellsworth Mountains, bisected by the Minnesota Glacier.
reference: Gunong-gunong bak wilayah tanjong disinoe meusapat jeut keu tanoh manyang, ‘oh lheueh nyan meusapat lom jeut keu 360 km rante gunong Ellsworth, diplah lé Glacier Minnesota.
hypothesis: Gunong-gunong di Semenanjung di sini meupeugab lam dataran tinggi, lheuh nyan meuluah lom untuk meupeuget rantai 360 km dari Gunong-gunong Ellsworth, dipeukeh le gletser Minnesota.

source: The northern part or Sentinel Range has Antarctica's highest mountains, the Vinson Massif, peaking at 4892 m Mount Vinson.
reference: Dairah blah baroh atawa Sentinel Range na gunong nyang paléng manyang di Antartika, nanjih Vinson Massif, manyang puncakjih Gunong Vinson 4892 m.
hypothesis: Bagian utara atau Sentinel Range na gunong paleng manyang di Antartika, Massif Vinson, puncak jih 4892 m.

source: In remote locations, without cell phone coverage, a satellite phone may be your only option.
reference: Bak teumpat nyang jioh, hana jangkauan télépon, saboh télépon sateulit mungkén jeut keu pilehan gata.
hypothesis: Di teumpat nyang jiôh, hana sinyal ponsel, telepon satelit mungken saboh-saboh jih pilihan.

source: A satellite phone is not generally a replacement for a mobile phone, as you have to be outdoors with clear line of sight to the satellite to make a phone call.
reference: Saboh télépon sateulit umumjih kon saboh geulantoe keu télépon seluler, gata suah na i luwa deungön pandangan nyang trang mangat jeut peugot saboh panggelan télépon.
hypothesis: Telepon satelit hana umum jih jeut keu pengganti keu ponsel, kareuna awak harus di lua ngen garis pandang yang jelas keu satelit untuk meupeuget panggilan telepon.

source: The service is frequently used by shipping, including pleasure craft, as well as expeditions who have remote data and voice needs.
reference: Layanan nyoe leubéh kayem dingui lé meulayeu, teumasok kapai peusiar, ngön ekspedisi nyang peurlèe data dari jioh ngön peurlèe su.
hypothesis: Layanan nyoe seureng dipakek le peuneurah, termasuk peuneurah rekreasi, seureuta ekspedisi yang na data jarak jauh dan kebutuhan suara.

source: Your local telephone service provider should be able to give more information about connecting to this service.
reference: Layanan télépon lokal gata seharohjih jeut dijok haba bah meusambông keu layanan nyoe.
hypothesis: Peubantu layanan telepon lokal droeneuh akan jeut geubri informasi leubeh le teuntang peutaba keu layanan nyo.

source: An increasingly more popular option for those planning a gap-year is to travel and learn.
reference: Hai nyang ka mulai di turi sabagoe saboh pilihan bagi nyang meu rencana dalam sithôn nakeuh jak travel sira jak meuruno.
hypothesis: Pilihan nyang meutamah populer keu ureung nyang peugöt gap-year adalah untuk meujak-jak dan meurunoe.

source: This is especially popular with school leavers, allowing them to take a year out before university, without compromising their education.
reference: Nyoe leubéh lom di turi lé awak nyang barô tamat sikula, jeuet keu urueng nyan untuk cok watèe keu sithôn sigolom jak tameng universitas, tanpa harus peutinggai peundidekan.
hypothesis: Nyo terutama populer bak ureung yang ka seuleusoe sekolah, yang memungkinkan awak nyan untuk mengambil setahun sebelum universitas, tanpa kompromi pendidikan awak nyan.

source: In many cases, enrolling on a gap-year course abroad can actually improve your chances of moving into higher education back in your home country.
reference: Dalam le kasus, tadaftar untuk sithôn jak sikula u luwa naggroe jeuet meutamah kesempatan bagi droeteuh untuk tapinah sikula nyang leubéh hayeu lom di nanggroe droe.
hypothesis: Dalam le kasus, meuruleh bak kursus gap-year di lua nanggroe jeut keu peunyaket keu kesempatan awak keu meuubah keu pendidikan tinggi di nanggroe awak.

source: Typically there will be a tuition fee to enroll in these educational programs.
reference: Biasajih akan na biaya peundidekan untuk ta daftar program-program peundidekan nyan.
hypothesis: Biasa jih na biaya kuliah untuk meujok daftar bak program pendidikan nyo.

source: Finland is a great boating destination. The "Land of a thousand lakes" has thousands of islands too, in the lakes and in the coastal archipelagos.
reference: Finlandia nakeuh tujuan meupeuraho yang lagak. “Nanggroe Siribee Dano” cit na meuribee pulo, di dano ngon di kepulauan peusise.
hypothesis: Finlandia nakeuh saboh tujuan nyang that get keu neujak u laot. "Bumi Seuleubé laot" na cit meuribé pulo, di laot ngon di pulo-pulo panté.

source: In the archipelagos and lakes you do not necessarily need a yacht.
reference: Di pulo-pulo ngon dano droen hana peurele kapai peusiar.
hypothesis: Lam pulo-pulo ngon danau-lango, gata hana peureulèe na kapai.

source: Although the coastal archipelagos and the biggest lakes are indeed big enough for any yacht, smaller boats or even a kayak offer a different experience.
reference: Bah pih kepulauan peusiser ngon danau nyang paleng rayek memang cukop rayek keu kapai peusiar toh mantong, peuraho nyang leubeh ubit atawa bahkan kayak peureulee peungalaman yang meubeda.
hypothesis: Meskipun kepulauan pesisir dan danau-danau rayek nyan memang that rayek untuk jaket, peurahô ubit atawa kayak pih na pengalaman nyang laén.

source: Boating is a national pastime in Finland, with a boat to every seven or eight people.
reference: Meupeuraho nakeuh hobi nasional di Finlandia, deungon saboh peuraho keu tiep tujoh atau lapan ureueng.
hypothesis: Meulayeue nyan adalah hobi nasional di Finlandia, deungen saboh peurahô keu tieb-tieb tujoh atawa lapan droe.

source: This is matched by Norway, Sweden and New Zealand, but otherwise quite unique (e.g. in the Netherlands the figure is one to forty).
reference: Nyoe cocok deungon Norwegia, Swedia ngon Selandia Baro, teutapi sibalekjih cukop unik (miseujih di Belanda angka jih sa bandeng peut ploh).
hypothesis: Nyoe ji sampo le Norwegia, Swedia ngon Selandia Baru, teutapi laen jih sangat unik (misal jih di Belanda angka nyan saboh keu peuet ploh).

source: Most of the distinct Baltic Cruises feature an extended stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.
reference: Le dari kapai-kapai pesiar mewah Baltic Cruises dipiyoh dalam watèe nyang trep di St. Petersburg, Russia.
hypothesis: Sebagian rayek Cruise Baltik na tinggai panyang di St. Petersburg, Rusia.

source: This means you can visit the historic city for a couple of full days while returning and sleeping on the ship at night.
reference: Nyoe berarti droeneuh jeuet neukunjông kuta nyang meusejarah lam padup uroe sira neuwo ngön neueh dalam kapai watèe malam.
hypothesis: Nyan meuarti awak jeut jak kalon kota bersejarah nyan seulama padum uroe seulama awak nyan jiwoe ngon geu éh bak kapai bak malam uroe.

source: If you only go ashore using shipboard excursions you will not need a separate visa (as of 2009).
reference: Meunyoe droeneuh neu tingoh u darat deungön paket piknik dari kapai droeneuh hana peureulèe lé keu visa nyang laén (mulai thôn 2009).
hypothesis: Meunyoe awak nyan hanya geujak u darat ngen peuneujak u kapal awak nyan hana perle visa yang tapisah (meunjak 2009).

source: Some cruises feature Berlin, Germany in the brochures. As you can see from the map above Berlin is no where near the sea and a visit to the city is not included in the price of the cruise.
reference: Ladom kapai pesiar na dipeuroh Berlin, German dalam brosur-brosur. Lage nyang deuh neu kalen dari map nyang na di ateuh Berlin nyan hana toe meubacut pih deungön laôt ngön jak meukeunjong u kutanyan hana roeh dalam biaya sewa kapai pesiar.
hypothesis: Na padum boh krueng nyang na gambar Berlin, Jerman lam brosur. Lagee nyang jeut neu kalon nibak peuta di ateuh Berlin hana di teumpat nyang rab laot dan kunjungan u kota hana termasuk lam harga krueng.

source: Travelling by plane can be a scary experience for people of all ages and backgrounds, particularly if they've not flown before or have experienced a traumatic event.
